doc: Mean value Lipschitz bound on `ball 0 R` for $C^1$ maps on `closedBall 0 R` (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.norm_sub_le_sSup_fderiv_of_contDiffOn_closedBall
type:
∀ {g : Complex → Complex} {R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 R →
    ContDiffOn Real 1 g (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
      ∀ {z w : Complex},
        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) z →
          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) w →
            Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (g z) (g w)))

                (Real.instSupSet.sSup
                  (Set.image (fun ζ => ContinuousLinearMap.hasOpNorm.norm (fderiv Real g ζ)) (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` when `thresh.h ≤ m_defect` and some `J`-holomorphic
term `u_seq n₀` has total energy strictly below `thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_ge_h_of_exists_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) thresh.h →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (And
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                          η)
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (Metric.diam
                                            (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                          η))))

doc:
Unconditional defect measure decomposition when `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` eventually has
`totalEnergy < thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_decomposition_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
      (Exists fun N₀ =>
          ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) thresh.h) →
        Exists fun m =>
          And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
            (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
              (Eq cdata.μ
                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                  (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

doc:
Whenever every `J`-holomorphic sphere in `(M, J)` is constant, pure componentwise
automorphisms are finite once ghost component automorphisms are trivial and the
identity-homeomorphism fiber of `MoebiusFrame` is finite (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.pure_component_automorphisms_finite_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    ∀ (lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I),
      (∀ (v : lim.tree.V),
          GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I lim v →
            ∀ (aut : GromovCompactness.Extensions.PureComponentAutomorphism I lim),
              Eq (aut.val.frame v).toHomeo (Homeomorph.refl GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)) →
        Finite (Subtype fun ϕ => Eq ϕ.toHomeo (Homeomorph.refl GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)) →
          Finite (GromovCompactness.Extensions.PureComponentAutomorphism I lim)

doc:
When `B ≤ 0`, `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` holds with `0 sorryAx`
whenever total energy converges along `cdata.σ` (or `cdata.σ.comp τ`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_nonpos_B
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  Real.instLE.le B 0 →
    Or
        (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))
        (Exists fun τ =>
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p)))) →
      Exists fun σ =>
        Exists fun res =>
          And
            (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
              (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                    Eq (frames w n)
                      ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                        (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                  ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (P.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

doc:
When a subsequence `reps ∘ τ.1` arises from a sequence of `k`-marked spheres `u_seq` equipped
with a `MarkedCompactnessWitness`, subsequence extraction for `reps` holds with `0 sorryAx`.
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_bounded_marked_stable_subseq_of_marked_spheres_subseq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (k : Nat) (B : Real)
  (reps : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I k B) (τ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k)
  (h_jhol : ∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ)
  (h_stab :
    ∀ (n : Nat), (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq ((u_seq n).map z) c) → instLENat.le 3 k),
  (∀ (n : Nat),
      Eq (reps (τ.val n)).val
        (GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap.of_markedStableTreeLimit I
          (GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit.of_markedSphere I (u_seq n) ⋯ ⋯))) →
    ∀ (u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k)
      (wit : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedCompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim),
      Exists fun φ =>
        And (StrictMono φ)
          (Exists fun lim_rep =>
            Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedGromovWitness I (fun n => (reps (φ n)).val) lim_rep.val))

name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData.mk.sizeOf_spec
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M} {B : Real}
  {thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M} [inst_8 : SizeOf E] [inst_9 : SizeOf H]
  [inst_10 : SizeOf M] (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) [μ_fin : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ]
  (μ_total_le : ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B))
  (weak_lim :
    GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
      (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ)
  (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  (S_def :
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p)
        (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))))
  (card_S_mul_le : Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul S.card.cast thresh.ε_reg) B)
  (card_S_le : Real.instLE.le S.card.cast (instHDiv.hDiv B thresh.ε_reg)) (u₀ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (u₀_jhol : GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀ Set.univ)
  (smooth_conv :
    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀
      (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Set.univ (Finset.instSetLike.coe S)))
  (measure_decomp :
    Eq μ
      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u₀)
        (S.sum fun p =>
          instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))),
  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData._sizeOf_inst I u_seq B thresh).sizeOf
      { σ := σ, μ := μ, μ_fin := μ_fin, μ_total_le := μ_total_le, weak_lim := weak_lim, S := S, S_def := S_def,
        card_S_mul_le := card_S_mul_le, card_S_le := card_S_le, u₀ := u₀, u₀_jhol := u₀_jhol,
        smooth_conv := smooth_conv, measure_decomp := measure_decomp })
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (instHAdd.hAdd 1 ((instSizeOfDefault GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap).sizeOf σ))
                      ((MeasureTheory.Measure._sizeOf_inst GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem).sizeOf μ))
                    ((instSizeOfDefault (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ)).sizeOf μ_fin))
                  ((instSizeOfDefault
                        (ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ Set.univ)
                          (ENNReal.ofReal B))).sizeOf
                    μ_total_le))
                ((instSizeOfDefault
                      (GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
                        (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ)).sizeOf
                  weak_lim))
              ((Finset._sizeOf_inst GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem).sizeOf S))
            ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul S.card.cast thresh.ε_reg) B)).sizeOf card_S_mul_le))
          ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLE.le S.card.cast (instHDiv.hDiv B thresh.ε_reg))).sizeOf card_S_le))
        ((instSizeOfDefault (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀ Set.univ)).sizeOf u₀_jhol))
      ((instSizeOfDefault
            (Eq μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u₀)
                (S.sum fun p =>
                  instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))).sizeOf
        measure_decomp))

doc:
Frame and convergence transfer onto the pruned sphere tree when a degree-1
constant root is contracted and singleton convergence holds at the deleted node (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.pruned_tree_frames_and_conv_of_singleton_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (root' : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root)
  (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root root'.val),
  (∀ (y : pdata.tree.V), pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root y → Eq y root'.val) →
    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames root'.val n).toHomeo))
        (pdata.map root'.val) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point root'.val pdata.root ⋯)) →
      Exists fun frames' =>
        And (Exists fun ϕ_root => ∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames' root' n) (ϕ_root n))
          (And
            (∀ (v w : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root)
              (h : (GromovCompactness.Assembly.prunedSimpleGraph pdata.tree pdata.root).Adj v w)
              (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Set.instLE.le K
                  (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w.val v.val ⋯))) →
                IsCompact K →
                  TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames' v n).inv.comp (frames' w n)).toHomeo)
                    (fun x => pdata.tree.node_point v.val w.val h) Filter.atTop K)
            (∀ (v : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root),
              GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames' v n).toHomeo))
                (pdata.map v.val)
                (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                  (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (pdata.tree.node_point v.val w.val h)))))

doc: Local inverse collapse of child affine rescalings onto the child attachment point away from the parent nodal point.
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.TreeRescalingData.child_collapse
type:
∀ {tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree} {root : tree.V} (self : GromovCompactness.Assembly.TreeRescalingData tree root)
  (v : tree.V) (hv : Ne v root) (h : tree.adj.Adj v (self.parent v hv)) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  Set.instLE.le K
      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree.node_point (self.parent v hv) v ⋯))) →

          EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (self.center v n) (self.scale v n) ⋯).inv.toHomeo)
        (fun x => tree.node_point v (self.parent v hv) h) Filter.atTop K

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `nonlinear_elliptic_bootstrap` across empty domains,
constant maps, maps locally constant on `Ω`, maps agreeing with a smooth map on `Ω`, or maps with
a finite-order $C^n$ tower (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.nonlinear_elliptic_bootstrap_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  IsOpen Ω →
    GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u Ω →
      Or (Eq Ω Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
          (Or (Exists fun c => Eq u fun x => c)
            (Or (Exists fun c => Set.EqOn (fun x => c) u Ω)
              (Or
                (Exists fun v =>
                  And (ContMDiffOn GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) v Ω) (Set.EqOn v u Ω))
                (Or
                  (Exists fun v =>
                    And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Ω) (Set.EqOn v u Ω))
                  (∀ (n : Nat), ContMDiffOn GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I n.cast u Ω))))) →
        ContMDiffOn GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) u Ω

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.CalibratedRescaling.isEmpty_of_eventually_const

doc: Target Monotonicity Formula when every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere equals its `north_pole` value (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_all_jhol_eq_north_pole
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    Exists fun c =>
      Exists fun r₀ =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 c)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                        (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))))

doc:
Master Stabilization Theorem on discrete targets when at least one input map `u_seq n₀`
is continuous (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_exists_continuous_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      Continuous (u_seq n₀) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc: Inhomogeneous geometric recurrence bound (`0 sorryAx`, ported from `qinz1yang/differential-geometry`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.le_geometric_of_recurrence
type:
∀ {u : Nat → Real} {r s B : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 r →
    Ne r s →
      ∀ (k : Nat),
        (∀ (n : Nat),
            instLTNat.lt n k →
              Real.instLE.le (u (instHAdd.hAdd n 1))
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul r (u n)) (instHMul.hMul B (instHPow.hPow s n)))) →
          Real.instLE.le (u k)
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow r k) (instHSub.hSub (u 0) (instHDiv.hDiv B (instHSub.hSub s r))))
              (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv B (instHSub.hSub s r)) (instHPow.hPow s k)))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem under non-zero prestable tree energy sum and singleton convergence upgrade (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_energy_sum_ne_zero_and_upgrade
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  Ne (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)) 0 →
    (∀ (pdata' : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata'.tree.V)
        (hw₀_adj : pdata'.tree.adj.Adj pdata'.root w₀),
        GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
          (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata'.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata'.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
          (pdata'.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata'.tree.node_point w₀ pdata'.root ⋯))) →
      Exists fun u_lim =>
        And
          (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
            (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
          (Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun frames =>
              And
                (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                    (u_lim.map v)
                    (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                      (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                (And
                  (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instLE.le K
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                      IsCompact K →
                        TendstoUniformlyOn
                          (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                          (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                  (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                    (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:
On `closedBall z₀ ρ` with `ρ = (r - ‖z₀‖) / 2`, we have `closedBall z₀ ρ ⊆ ball 0 r`
and `e w ≤ 4 * e z₀`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.heinz_ball_subset_and_bound
type:
∀ (r : Real) (z₀ : Complex),
  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z₀ →
    ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
      (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
        (∀ (w : Complex),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm w)) 2) (e w))
                (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm z₀)) 2) (e z₀))) →
          have ρ := instHDiv.hDiv (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm z₀)) 2;
          And (Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r))
            (∀ (w : Complex),
              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) w → Real.instLE.le (e w) (instHMul.hMul 4 (e z₀)))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.polar_far_zone_double_integral_bound
type:
∀ {g : Complex → Complex} {z w : Complex} {M δ A α : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 M →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 δ →
      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 δ) A →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
          Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
            Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) δ →
              (∀ (ρ : Real),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc (instHMul.hMul 2 δ) A) ρ →
                    ∀ (θ : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.uIcc 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)) θ →
                        Real.instLE.le
                          (Complex.instNorm.norm
                            (g
                              (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                  (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))))
                          M) →
                Real.instLE.le
                  (Complex.instNorm.norm
                    (intervalIntegral
                      (fun ρ =>
                        intervalIntegral
                          (fun θ =>
                            instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                              (instHSub.hSub
                                (instHDiv.hDiv
                                  (g
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                        (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                                  (instHSub.hSub
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                        (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
                                    z))
                                (instHDiv.hDiv
                                  (g
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                        (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                                  (instHSub.hSub
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                        (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
                                    w))))
                          0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) Real.measureSpace.volume)
                      (instHMul.hMul 2 δ) A Real.measureSpace.volume))
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (instHDiv.hDiv
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi) M) (instHPow.hPow A (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                      (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                    (instHPow.hPow δ α))

doc:
Unconditional `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` when `B < th.h` and `u_seq` consists of
`J`-holomorphic spheres with `totalEnergy ≤ B` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_B_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
          (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
          (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
          Real.instLT.lt B th.h →
            Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun res =>
                And
                  (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                    (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                      (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                          Eq (frames w n)
                            ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                              (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                        ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                            (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                            (P.map v)
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                    (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

type:

      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    instLENat.le 3 k →
      ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),

  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real) (z₀ : Complex) (t : Real),
        Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w) →
          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
              (instHDiv.hDiv
                (instHMul.hMul
                  (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1)) (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                  (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                8))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound` when the sequence is eventually `J`-holomorphic with
`totalEnergy I (u_seq n) < thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) thresh.h) →
      ∀ (η : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
          Exists fun R₀ =>
            And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
              (∀ (R : Real),
                GE.ge R R₀ →
                  Exists fun δ₀ =>
                    And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                      (∀ (δ : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                          Exists fun N =>
                            ∀ (n : Nat),
                              GE.ge n N →
                                And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                  (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                    Set.instMembership.mem
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                      Set.instMembership.mem
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) w →
                                        Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc:
For the identically zero map `fun _ => 0`, the Cauchy–Pompeiu near/far decomposition holds
with `I_near = 0` and `I_far = 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchy_pompeiu_near_far_decomp_zero
type:
∀ {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ {z w : Complex},
            Exists fun I_near =>
              Exists fun I_far =>
                And
                  (Eq (instHSub.hSub 0 0)
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHSub.hSub
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (Complex.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                          (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) 0) 0 R))
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (Complex.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                          (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ w)) 0) 0 R)))
                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) (instHAdd.hAdd I_near I_far))))
                  (And
                    (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_near)
                      (instHMul.hMul
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex fun x => 0)
                            (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                        (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w))))
                    (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_far)
                      (instHMul.hMul
                        (instHDiv.hDiv
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex fun x => 0)
                                (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                            (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                          (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                        (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))

  (neck_cyl : (v w : u_lim.tree.V) → u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w → Nat → Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)

  (neck_diam_vanishes_1 :

  Eq

      { neck_cyl := neck_cyl_1, neck_energy_vanishes := neck_energy_vanishes_1,

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.SecondHomology.mk.sizeOf_spec
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_4} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [inst_8 : SizeOf E] [inst_9 : SizeOf H] [inst_10 : SizeOf M]
  (H₂ : Type) [addCommGroup : AddCommGroup H₂] (cycleClass : (GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) → H₂)
  (homotopy_invariant :
    ∀ (u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Extensions.ContinuousHomotopic u₁ u₂ → Eq (cycleClass u₁) (cycleClass u₂))
  (omegaPairing : AddMonoidHom H₂ Real)
  (omegaPairing_eq_area :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      Eq (AddMonoidHom.instFunLike.coe omegaPairing (cycleClass u))
        (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u Set.univ))
  (cycleClass_neck_degeneration :
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I)
      (wit : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
        Filter.Eventually
          (fun n => Eq (cycleClass (u_seq (wit.σ.val n))) (Finset.univ.sum fun v => cycleClass (u_lim.map v)))
          Filter.atTop),
  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.Extensions.SecondHomology._sizeOf_inst I M).sizeOf
      { H₂ := H₂, addCommGroup := addCommGroup, cycleClass := cycleClass, homotopy_invariant := homotopy_invariant,
        omegaPairing := omegaPairing, omegaPairing_eq_area := omegaPairing_eq_area,

    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd 1 ((instSizeOfDefault Type).sizeOf H₂))
        ((instSizeOfDefault (AddCommGroup H₂)).sizeOf addCommGroup))
      ((AddMonoidHom._sizeOf_inst H₂ Real).sizeOf omegaPairing))

on `CP1` is constant (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (v : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ →
        Eq v fun x => v GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    ∀ (d₀ : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 d₀ →
        Exists fun η =>
          And (Real.instLT.lt 0 η)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r R : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Real.instLT.lt r R →
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R)) η →
                      Exists fun x₀ =>
                        ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                          Set.instMembership.mem
                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2)) z →

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `cylinder_exponential_decay` under any of the verified
cylindrical decay regimes (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cylinder_exponential_decay_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  Exists fun C₀ =>
    Exists fun a_decay =>
      Exists fun ε_neck =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C₀)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay)
            (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck)
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))
                          ε_neck →
                        Or (Exists fun c => Eq u fun x => c)
                            (∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                              Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                                Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                                  Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                                    Or
                                      (Eq
                                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                        0)
                                      (Or
                                        (Real.instLE.le
                                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                          (instHMul.hMul
                                            (instHMul.hMul 1
                                              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) 1)
                                                (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) 1)))
                                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))
                                        (Or
                                          (And
                                            (Real.instLT.lt 0
                                              (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                                (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)))
                                            (Real.instLE.le 1
                                              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) 1)
                                                (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) 1))))
                                          (And
                                            (Ne
                                              (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                                (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                              0)
                                            (And
                                              (Not
                                                (Real.instLT.lt 0
                                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))
                                              (Or
                                                (Ne
                                                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe
                                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
                                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))
                                                  ENNReal.instTop.top)
                                                (Continuous fun w =>
                                                  GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                                    (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))) →
                          ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                            Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                              Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                                Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                                  Real.instLE.le
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHMul.hMul C₀
                                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                                          (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `sphere_energy_gap` when `riemannianEnergyDensity I u` is
bounded above and for every `x ∈ Set.range u` there is `z : CP1` with `r₀ ≤ dist (u z) x` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_bddAbove_density_and_exists_dist_ge
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              BddAbove (Set.range (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u)) →
                (∀ (x : M),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x → Exists fun z => Real.instLE.le r₀ (inst_3.dist (u z) x)) →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r₀ 2)) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
          Real.instLT.lt B thresh.ε_sph →
            Exists fun m =>
              And
                (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
                (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
                  (Eq cdata.μ
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                      (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

Weitzenböck curvature decomposition for any map `u : CP1 → M` with `mfderiv I_CP1 I u z = 0`
everywhere on `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        (∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) 0) →
          ∀ (w : Complex),
            Exists fun hessNorm =>
              Exists fun curvTerm =>
                And
                  (Eq
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                  (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (instHMul.hMul b
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                          (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))

The Bochner differential inequality holds unconditionally at any point `w` where both directional
second derivatives of the chart energy density are non-negative (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_directional_second_deriv_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (w : Complex),
        Real.instLE.le 0
            (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
              (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                (fun ζ => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                w)
              (Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 1 Matrix.vecEmpty))) →
          Real.instLE.le 0
              (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                  (fun ζ =>
                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                  w)
                (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I Matrix.vecEmpty))) →
            Real.instLE.le
              (instHSub.hSub
                (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                  (instHPow.hPow
                    (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) 2))
                (instHMul.hMul c
                  (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                w)

doc:
Unconditional cylinder exponential decay whenever every `J`-holomorphic sphere on `CP1` is
constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cylinder_exponential_decay_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (v : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ →
        Eq v fun x => v GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    Exists fun C₀ =>
      Exists fun a_decay =>
        Exists fun ε_neck =>
          And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C₀)
            (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay)
              (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck)
                (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                    Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
                      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))
                            ε_neck →
                          ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                            Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                              Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                                Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                                  Real.instLE.le
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHMul.hMul C₀
                                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                                          (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))))

doc: Global Epsilon-Regularity when every `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ → Exists fun c₀ => Eq u fun x => c₀) →
    Exists fun ε_reg =>
      Exists fun C_reg =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
                    ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                        Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc:
Pointwise Bochner differential inequality for any map `u : CP1 → M` with `mfderiv I_CP1 I u z = 0`
everywhere on `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_mfderiv_eq_zero
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        (∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) 0) →
          ∀ (w : Complex),
            Real.instLE.le
              (instHSub.hSub
                (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                  (instHPow.hPow
                    (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) 2))
                (instHMul.hMul c
                  (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                w)

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Real.instLT.lt B thresh.ε_reg →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                        Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd m_p

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds.h_neck
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_4} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (self : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)) self.ε_neck →
          ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
              Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                  Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                    (instHMul.hMul
                      (instHMul.hMul self.C_neck
                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) self.a_decay)
                          (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) self.a_decay)))
                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` when the sequence is eventually `J`-holomorphic with
`totalEnergy I (u_seq n) < thresh.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_eventually_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) thresh.ε_sph) →
      ∀ (η : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
          Exists fun R₀ =>
            And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
              (∀ (R : Real),
                GE.ge R R₀ →
                  Exists fun δ₀ =>
                    And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                      (∀ (δ : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                          Exists fun N =>
                            ∀ (n : Nat),
                              GE.ge n N →
                                And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                  (And
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                      η)
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (Metric.diam
                                        (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                      η))))

doc: Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness when some term has symplectic area `< uth.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_exists_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (Exists fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) uth.h) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
            (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem when `∀ n, totalEnergy I (u_seq n) ≤ B` and `B < th.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_B_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        Real.instLT.lt B th.ε_sph →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
              (Exists fun σ =>
                Exists fun frames =>
                  And
                    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (u_lim.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instLE.le K
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                          IsCompact K →
                            TendstoUniformlyOn
                              (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                              (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:
When the collar ratio sum satisfies `1 ≤ (r / r₁)^1 + (r₂ / R)^1`, the sub-annular energy decay bound
follows unconditionally from measure monotonicity (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.energyMeasure_annulus_at_le_collar_sum_of_one_le
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex)
  {r r₁ r₂ R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
    Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
      Real.instLE.le 1 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) 1) (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) 1)) →
        Ne
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R))
            ENNReal.instTop.top →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂))
            (instHMul.hMul
              (instHMul.hMul 1
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) 1) (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) 1)))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

  Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B →
    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
        GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v → instLENat.le 3 (instHAdd.hAdd (u_lim.tree.adj.degree v) k)) →
      have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
      have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
      And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
        (And (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) → instLENat.le G (instHSub.hSub (instHAdd.hAdd P k) 2))
          (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
            (Int.instMax.max 1
              (instHSub.hSub (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) k.cast) 2))))

doc:
Pointwise Cauchy–Pompeiu Hölder difference bound for $C^1$ maps on concentric disks $D_r \subset D_R$
given a near/far Pompeiu area integral decomposition (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.satisfiesCauchyPompeiuPointwise_of_near_far_decomp
type:
∀ {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
            ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
              (∀ {z w : Complex},
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                      Exists fun I_near =>
                        Exists fun I_far =>
                          And
                            (Eq (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w))
                              (instHSub.hSub
                                (instHSub.hSub
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (Complex.instInv.inv
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                                    (circleIntegral
                                      (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) (f ζ)) 0 R))
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (Complex.instInv.inv
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                                    (circleIntegral
                                      (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ w)) (f ζ)) 0 R)))
                                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (Complex.ofReal Real.pi))
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd I_near I_far))))
                            (And
                              (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_near)
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                      (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                                  (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w))))
                              (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_far)
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                          (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                                      (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                                    (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))) →
                GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCauchyPompeiuPointwise r R α f

doc: Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness when `B < uth.hbar` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_lt_hbar
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) B) →
        Real.instLT.lt B uth.hbar →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
              (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `neck_vanishing_quantified` when the sequence eventually
has vanishing annular energy and neck diameter (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_eventually_zero
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (Exists fun N₀ =>
        ∀ (n : Nat),
          GE.ge n N₀ →
            ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
              And (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) 0)
                (Eq (Metric.diam (Set.image (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂))) 0)) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                              (And
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                  η)
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (Metric.diam
                                    (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                  η))))
