doc: Stabilization of prestable tree limits when the root component is stable (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_stable_root
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  ((Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      instLENat.le 3 (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root)) →
    Exists fun u_lim =>
      And
        (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
        (Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun frames =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                  (u_lim.map v)
                  (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                    (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
              (And
                (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  Set.instLE.le K
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                    IsCompact K →
                      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                        (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc: $J$-invariance of the symmetrized metric: $g_J(Jv, Jw) = g_J(v, w)$ (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.symmetrizedMetric_J_invariant
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (ω :
    (x : M) →
      ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x)
        (ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) Real)),
  (∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace I x),
      Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ω x) v) w)
        (Real.instNeg.neg (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ω x) w) v))) →
    ∀ (J : (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x)),
      (∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
          Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) v))
            (SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass.neg v)) →
        ∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace I x),
          Eq
            (GromovCompactness.Extensions.symmetrizedMetric I ω J x (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) v)
              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) w))
            (GromovCompactness.Extensions.symmetrizedMetric I ω J x v w)

doc:

fixed `north_pole` value, and converging distinct marked points (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat} (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M),
  instLENat.le 3 k →
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map) B) →
          ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
            (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) th.h) →
              ∀ (c₀ : M),
                (∀ (n : Nat), Eq ((u_seq (σ.val n)).map GromovCompactness.north_pole) c₀) →
                  ∀ (pts : Fin k → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),

type:

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M}

  (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (frames : tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)

  (ghost_root_deg_one_conv :
    Eq (tree.adj.degree root) 1 →
      (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map root z) c) →
        ∀ (w₀ : tree.V) (hw₀_adj : tree.adj.Adj root w₀),

  (energy_ident :

      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (map v))))
  (tree_1 : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root_1 : tree_1.V) (map_1 : tree_1.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol_1 : ∀ (v : tree_1.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map_1 v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match_1 :

      Eq (map_1 v (tree_1.node_point v w h)) (map_1 w (tree_1.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (stable_off_root_1 :

      Ne v root_1 →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map_1 v z) c) → instLENat.le 3 (tree_1.adj.degree v))
  (σ_1 : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (frames_1 : tree_1.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (root_frame_id_1 : Exists fun ϕ_root => ∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames_1 root_1 n) (ϕ_root n))
  (frame_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (v w : tree_1.V) (h : tree_1.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree_1.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames_1 v n).inv.comp (frames_1 w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => tree_1.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (smooth_conv_1 :
    ∀ (v : tree_1.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ_1.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 v n).toHomeo)) (map_1 v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (tree_1.node_point v w h))))
  (ghost_root_deg_one_conv_1 :
    Eq (tree_1.adj.degree root_1) 1 →
      (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map_1 root_1 z) c) →
        ∀ (w₀ : tree_1.V) (hw₀_adj : tree_1.adj.Adj root_1 w₀),
          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
            (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ_1.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 w₀ n).toHomeo)) (map_1 w₀)
            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree_1.node_point w₀ root_1 ⋯)))
  (energy_ident_1 :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ_1.val n))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (map_1 v)))),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { tree := tree, root := root, map := map, is_jhol := is_jhol, nodal_match := nodal_match,
        stable_off_root := stable_off_root, σ := σ, frames := frames, root_frame_id := root_frame_id,
        frame_collapse := frame_collapse, smooth_conv := smooth_conv,
        ghost_root_deg_one_conv := ghost_root_deg_one_conv, energy_ident := energy_ident }
      { tree := tree_1, root := root_1, map := map_1, is_jhol := is_jhol_1, nodal_match := nodal_match_1,
        stable_off_root := stable_off_root_1, σ := σ_1, frames := frames_1, root_frame_id := root_frame_id_1,
        frame_collapse := frame_collapse_1, smooth_conv := smooth_conv_1,
        ghost_root_deg_one_conv := ghost_root_deg_one_conv_1, energy_ident := energy_ident_1 })
    (And (Eq tree tree_1) (And (HEq root root_1) (And (HEq map map_1) (And (Eq σ σ_1) (HEq frames frames_1)))))

doc:
Asymptotic neck energy and diameter decay when the sequence eventually has annular energy `< η`
and maps each neck annulus into a target ball of radius `η / 3` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_annular_energy_and_diam_of_mapsTo_ball
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (Exists fun N₀ =>
        ∀ (n : Nat),
          GE.ge n N₀ →
            ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
              And
                (Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) η)
                (Exists fun x =>
                  ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂) z →
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x (instHDiv.hDiv η 3)) (u_seq n z))) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                  (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                η)
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (Metric.diam
                                  (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                η)))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.polar_far_zone_subinterval_integral_le
type:
∀ {M δ a A α : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 M →
    Real.instLE.le 0 δ →
      Real.instLE.le 0 a →
        Real.instLE.le a A →
          Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
            Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
              Real.instLE.le
                (intervalIntegral
                  (fun ρ =>
                    instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi) M) (instHPow.hPow δ α))
                      (instHPow.hPow ρ (Real.instNeg.neg α)))
                  a A Real.measureSpace.volume)
                (instHMul.hMul
                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi) M) (instHPow.hPow A (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                    (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                  (instHPow.hPow δ α))

doc:
Asymptotic neck energy and diameter decay when the sequence eventually has annular energy
and neck diameter bounded by `< η` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_annular_energy_and_diam_of_eventually_lt
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

              (Real.instLT.lt (Metric.diam (Set.image (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂))) η)) →
    Exists fun R₀ =>
      And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
        (∀ (R : Real),

                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →

                            (Real.instLT.lt

doc:
Unconditional 2D quadratic-gauge subharmonic mean-value bound for `c = 0`:
for a $C^2$ function `e ≥ 0` satisfying `Δe ≥ -b e²` on `ball 0 r` and `e(w) ≤ 4 e(z₀)` on `closedBall z₀ ρ`,
modifying `e` by `K |w - z₀|² / 4` with `K = 16(b+1)e(z₀)²` yields
`π t² e(z₀) ≤ ∫_{B(z₀,t)} e + π K t⁴ / 8` for all `t ∈ (0, ρ]`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_c_zero
type:
∀ (r b : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
      (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
        ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
          ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
            (∀ (z : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
              ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                  ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                      Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                        (∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) w →
                              Real.instLE.le (e w) (instHMul.hMul 4 (e z₀))) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                              (MeasureTheory.integral
                                (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                              (instHDiv.hDiv
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd b 1)) (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                  (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                8))

doc: Boundary circle integral Hölder difference bound in terms of `supNormOn f (ball 0 R)` (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.boundary_circleIntegral_scaled_holder_est_supNormOn
type:
∀ {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
            ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
              ∀ {z w : Complex},
                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                    Real.instLE.le
                      (Complex.instNorm.norm
                        (instHSub.hSub
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (Complex.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                            (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) (f ζ)) 0
                              R))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (Complex.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                            (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ w)) (f ζ)) 0
                              R))))
                      (instHMul.hMul
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul R (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                            (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 2))
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                        (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))

doc: Pointwise Bochner differential inequality when `u = fun _ => u north_pole` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:

with `m = 0` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem when `totalEnergy I (u_seq n) < th.h` eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) th.h) Filter.atTop →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.boundary_circleIntegral_holder_est
type:
∀ {r R α M : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          Real.instLE.le 0 M →
            ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
              ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R) →
                (∀ (ζ : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.sphere 0 R) ζ → Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (f ζ)) M) →
                  ∀ {z w : Complex},
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                        Real.instLE.le
                          (Complex.instNorm.norm
                            (instHSub.hSub
                              (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) (f ζ)) 0
                                R)
                              (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ w)) (f ζ)) 0
                                R)))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHDiv.hDiv
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) R)
                                  (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                                (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 2))
                              M)
                            (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))

  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le ε (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n))) →
      (∀ (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata.tree.V)

            (pdata.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
        ∀ (k : Nat) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),

            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And
                (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
                (Exists fun σ =>
                  Exists fun frames =>
                    And
                      (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                        GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                          (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                          (u_lim.map v)
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                      (And
                        (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                          Set.instLE.le K
                              (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                                (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                            IsCompact K →
                              TendstoUniformlyOn
                                (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                                (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                        (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                          (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem when some input map `u_seq n` has energy `< th.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_exists_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (Exists fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) th.h) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:
Fundamental algebraic identity: For any $J$-holomorphic curve, the Riemannian energy density
with respect to $g_J$ identically equals the symplectic area density $u^* \omega$ (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.energy_density_with_J_eq_omega
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (ω :
    (x : M) →
      ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x)
        (ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) Real)),
  (∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace I x),
      Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ω x) v) w)
        (Real.instNeg.neg (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ω x) w) v))) →
    ∀ (J : (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x)),
      (∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
          Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) v))
            (SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass.neg v)) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          (∀ (v : TangentSpace GromovCompactness.I_CP1 z),
              Eq
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z)
                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe GromovCompactness.J_CP1 v))
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J (u z))
                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) v))) →
            Eq (GromovCompactness.Extensions.riemannianEnergyDensityWithJ I ω J u z)
              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ω (u z))
                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) GromovCompactness.e1))
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) GromovCompactness.e2))

type:

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `gromov_compactness_varying_J` from any `StableSphereTreeLimit`
with total energy `≤ B` when `uth.h` is bounded above by the sphere energy gap `ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_le_gap
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J) (B : Real)
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I),
  Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B →
    ∀ {ε_sph : Real},
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
              Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)) →
        Real.instLE.le uth.h ε_sph →
          Exists fun u_lim' =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim'.tree.V),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim'.map v) Set.univ)
              (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim'.map v)) B)
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim' v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim' v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

is globally continuous on `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.local_smooth_compactness_of_continuous_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [DiscreteTopology M] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_6 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M]
  [inst_7 : CompactSpace M] [inst_8 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  IsOpen Ω →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Ω) →
      (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Set.instLE.le K Ω →
            IsCompact K →
              Exists fun C =>
                And (GT.gt C 0)
                  (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), Continuous (u_seq n)) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω)
                (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_lim Ω)

doc:
Marked Gromov compactness when `3 ≤ k`, every `J`-holomorphic sphere in `(M, J)` is constant,
and a subsequence has fixed `north_pole` value and converging distinct marked points (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.marked_gromov_compactness_of_all_jhol_const_of_marks_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat},
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    instLENat.le 3 k →
      ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),
        (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ) →
          (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map) B) →
            ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (c₀ : M),
              (∀ (n : Nat), Eq ((u_seq (σ.val n)).map GromovCompactness.north_pole) c₀) →
                ∀ (pts : Fin k → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  (∀ (i j : Fin k), Ne i j → Ne (pts i) (pts j)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (u_seq (σ.val n)).points i) Filter.atTop (nhds (pts i))) →
                      Exists fun u_lim =>
                        Exists fun _wit => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim) B

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.AlmostComplexStructure.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  (J : (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x))
  (J_sq :
    ∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
      Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) v))
        (SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass.neg v))
  (J_smooth :
    ∀ (x : M), ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) (GromovCompactness.J_chart I J x) (extChartAt I x).target)
  (J_1 : (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x))
  (J_sq_1 :
    ∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
      Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J_1 x) (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J_1 x) v))
        (SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass.neg v))
  (J_smooth_1 :
    ∀ (x : M),
      ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) (GromovCompactness.J_chart I J_1 x) (extChartAt I x).target),
  Eq (Eq { J := J, J_sq := J_sq, J_smooth := J_smooth } { J := J_1, J_sq := J_sq_1, J_smooth := J_smooth_1 }) (Eq J J_1)

doc:
Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when `u_seq` is eventually `J`-holomorphic and
non-constant and every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_eventually_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn_ball_mono_of_continuousOn
type:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {r R : Real},
  Real.instLE.le r R →
    ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →

        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` when `thresh.h / 2 < m_defect` and some `J`-holomorphic
term `u_seq n₀` has non-positive total energy (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_gt_half_h_of_exists_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) 0 →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (And
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                          η)
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (Metric.diam
                                            (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                          η))))

doc: Pointwise $\alpha$-Hölder difference bound on `ball 0 R` for $C^1$ maps on `closedBall 0 R` (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.norm_sub_le_holder_of_contDiffOn_closedBall
type:
∀ {g : Complex → Complex} {R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 R →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
      Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
        ContDiffOn Real 1 g (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
          ∀ {z w : Complex},
            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) z →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) w →
                Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (g z) (g w)))
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (instHMul.hMul
                      (Real.instSupSet.sSup
                        (Set.image (fun ζ => ContinuousLinearMap.hasOpNorm.norm (fderiv Real g ζ)) (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                      (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 R) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                    (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))

doc:
Full 2D affine scaling cancellation theorem:
The quadratic gradient scaling factor λ² cancels identically with the 2D Lebesgue volume scaling factor λ⁻²
under affine change of variables w ↦ a + λ • w on ℂ.
name: GromovCompactness.lintegral_affine_scaling_cancellation
type:

  Real.instLT.lt 0 l →
    ∀ (f : Complex → ENNReal),

            instHMul.hMul (ENNReal.ofReal (instHPow.hPow l 2)) (f (instHAdd.hAdd a (instHSMul.hSMul l w))))
          (MeasureTheory.lintegral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun z => f z)

doc:

doc: Vanishing of outer annulus energy with finite extended measure implies vanishing of inner sub-annulus energy (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.energyMeasure_annulus_at_eq_zero_of_outer_eq_zero
type:

doc:

doc:
Global Weitzenböck curvature bound when the stereographic chart energy density of every
`J`-holomorphic sphere is subharmonic (`0 ≤ laplacian2D`) (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_term_bound_of_global_laplacian_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        ∀ (w : Complex),
          Real.instLE.le 0
            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
              (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
              w)) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Exists fun hessNorm =>
                    Exists fun curvTerm =>
                      And
                        (Eq
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                            (fun z =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                            w)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                        (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul b
                              (instHPow.hPow
                                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                2))
                            (instHMul.hMul c
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))

doc:

Any Möbius matrix `M_mat` whose evaluation `M_mat.eval` fixes three distinct points

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.moebius_three_point_rigidity_eval_eq_id

  Ne p₁ p₂ →
    Ne p₁ p₃ →

        Eq (M_mat.eval p₁) p₁ →
          Eq (M_mat.eval p₂) p₂ → Eq (M_mat.eval p₃) p₃ → ∀ (p : OnePoint Complex), Eq (M_mat.eval p) p

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `marked_gromov_compactness` for `k ≥ 3` marked spheres
admitting a non-bubbling smooth local and marked-point convergent subsequence (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.marked_gromov_compactness_of_no_bubble_three_le_k
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map) B) →
          ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (u₀ : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k),
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) u₀.map Set.univ →
              (∀ (i : Fin k), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (u_seq (σ.val n)).points i) Filter.atTop (nhds (u₀.points i))) →
                Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) Filter.atTop
                    (nhds (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u₀.map)) →

doc:
Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence when every term `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` is a
constant map (`0 sorryAx`, since `cdata.S = ∅`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_const_subseq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Exists fun c => Eq (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) fun x => c) →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                        Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

name: GromovCompactness.walkOfInr.eq_1

doc:
Local $C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}$ convergence upgrade across an isolated point `p ∈ Ω` on
subsingleton targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.smooth_local_upgrade_at_zero_defect_point_of_subsingleton
type:

doc:
Any smooth `J`-holomorphic map on the compact Riemann sphere `CP1` with bounded or continuous
energy density and diameter `> 2 * r₀`, pair distance `≥ 2 * r₀`, or a point at distance `≥ r₀` from `x`
exits `Metric.ball x r₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.jholomorphic_sphere_exits_darboux_ball
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (r₀ : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M),
      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
        GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
          Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
            And
                (Or
                  (BddAbove
                    (Set.range fun w =>
                      GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))
                  (Or (BddAbove (Set.range (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u)))
                    (Continuous (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u))))
                (Or (Exists fun z => Real.instLE.le r₀ (inst_3.dist (u z) x))
                  (Or
                    (Exists fun z₁ => Exists fun z₂ => Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (inst_3.dist (u z₁) (u z₂)))
                    (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (Metric.diam (Set.range u))))) →
              And (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r₀) (u z)))
                (BddAbove
                  (Set.range fun w =>
                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem on subsingleton targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    Exists fun u_lim =>
      And
        (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
        (Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun frames =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                  (u_lim.map v)
                  (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                    (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
              (And
                (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  Set.instLE.le K
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                    IsCompact K →
                      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                        (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:
Three-point uniqueness theorem in PGL(2, ℂ): any two Möbius matrices mapping
the same three distinct projective points (v₁, v₂, v₃) to (w₁, w₂, w₃) are
projectively equivalent on all points in CP¹.
name: GromovCompactness.moebius_three_points_unique
type:
∀ (M₁ M₂ : GromovCompactness.MoebiusMatrix) (v₁ v₂ v₃ w₁ w₂ w₃ : Prod Complex Complex),
  Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₁ v₂) →
    Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₂ v₃) →
      Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₁ v₃) →
        Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv w₁ w₂) →
          Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv w₂ w₃) →
            Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv w₁ w₃) →
              GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₁.act v₁) w₁ →
                GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₁.act v₂) w₂ →
                  GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₁.act v₃) w₃ →
                    GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₂.act v₁) w₁ →
                      GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₂.act v₂) w₂ →
                        GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M₂.act v₃) w₃ → GromovCompactness.PglEquiv M₁ M₂

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `exists_concentration_data` from weak energy measure compactness (`h_weak_comp`),
extended energy finiteness (`h_fin`), and smooth limit extraction (`h_extract`) (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.exists_concentration_data_of_smooth_limit
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      Real.instLE.le 0 B →
        (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
          ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M),
            (∀ (B' : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 B' →
                  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B') →
                    Exists fun σ =>
                      Exists fun μ =>
                        And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ)
                          (GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
                            (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ)) →
              (∀ (n : Nat),
                  ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq n))
                      Set.univ)
                    ENNReal.instTop.top) →
                (∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
                    (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ →
                      GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
                          (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ →
                        (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                            Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p)
                              (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)
                                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))) →
                          Exists fun τ =>
                            Exists fun u₀ =>
                              And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀ Set.univ)
                                (And
                                  (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq ((σ.comp τ).val n)) u₀
                                    (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Set.univ (Finset.instSetLike.coe S)))
                                  (Eq μ
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u₀)
                                      (S.sum fun p =>
                                        instHSMul.hSMul
                                          (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                                          (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))) →
                  Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh)

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_from_translated_density
type:
∀ {η C r E_disk : Real} {a w₀ : Complex} {g : Complex → Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 C →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) w₀ →
        Real.instLE.le
            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
              g (instHAdd.hAdd a w))
            E_disk →
          Real.instLT.lt E_disk η →
            (Real.instLT.lt
                  (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
                    g (instHAdd.hAdd a w))
                  η →
                ∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                    Real.instLE.le (g (instHAdd.hAdd a z))
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                        (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                          fun w => g (instHAdd.hAdd a w)))) →
              Real.instLE.le (g w₀) (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2))) E_disk)

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `gromov_compactness_varying_J` when a subsequence `σ` satisfies
`varying_J.J_seq (σ.1 n) = tgt.J` and admits an unmarked `CompactnessWitness` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_eq_target_J
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) B) →
      ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (varying_J.J_seq (σ.val n)) tgt.J) →
          ∀ (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I)
            (wit : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim),
            Exists fun u_lim' =>
              And
                (∀ (v : u_lim'.tree.V),
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim'.map v) Set.univ)
                (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim'.map v)) B)
                  (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim' v);
                  have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim' v);
                  And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                    (And
                      (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) →
                        And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                          (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                      (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V).cast
                        (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc: For `k < 3` on a subsingleton target `M`, `MarkedStableMap I k` is empty (`0 sorryAx`).

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_solid_ball_mean_value_of_circle_average
type:
∀ (g : Complex → Real) (z₀ : Complex) {r t : Real},
  ContDiffOn Real 2 g (Metric.ball 0 r) →
    Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
      Real.instLE.le 0 t →
        (∀ (ρ : Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc 0 t) ρ →
              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) (g z₀))
                (intervalIntegral
                  (fun θ =>
                    g
                      (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                        (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                  (Real.instNeg.neg Real.pi) Real.pi Real.measureSpace.volume)) →
          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (g z₀))
            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => g w)

doc: Unconditional defect measure decomposition when `B < thresh.h` on any target manifold `M` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_decomposition_of_B_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
          Real.instLT.lt B thresh.h →
            Exists fun m =>
              And
                (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
                (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
                  (Eq cdata.μ
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                      (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

doc:
Global Bochner differential inequality when the 6-branch hypothesis of
`bochner_differential_inequality_of_cases` holds for all `J`-holomorphic spheres (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_global_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            ∀ (w : Complex),
              Or (Exists fun x₀ => Eq u fun x => x₀)
                (Or (∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) 0)
                  (Or
                    (Exists fun c₀ =>
                      Eq
                        (fun z =>
                          GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                        fun x => c₀)
                    (Or
                      (And
                        (Real.instLE.le 0
                          (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                            (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                              (fun ζ =>
                                GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                              w)
                            (Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 1 Matrix.vecEmpty))))
                        (Real.instLE.le 0
                          (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                            (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                              (fun ζ =>
                                GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                              w)
                            (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I Matrix.vecEmpty)))))
                      (Or
                        (Real.instLE.le 0
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                            (fun z =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                            w))
                        (Exists fun hessNorm =>
                          Exists fun curvTerm =>
                            And
                              (Eq
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                                  (fun z =>
                                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                      (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                                  w)
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                              (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                  (instHMul.hMul b
                                    (instHPow.hPow
                                      (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                        (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                      2))
                                  (instHMul.hMul c
                                    (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                      (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))))))))) →
        Exists fun b' =>
          Exists fun c' =>
            And (Real.instLE.le 0 b')
              (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c')
                (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    ∀ (w : Complex),
                      Real.instLE.le
                        (instHSub.hSub
                          (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b')
                            (instHPow.hPow
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                              2))
                          (instHMul.hMul c'
                            (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                          (fun z =>
                            GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                          w)))

doc:
Unconditional Weitzenböck curvature bound on subsingleton targets (`0 sorryAx`):
when `[Subsingleton M]` holds, every map `u : CP1 → M` equals `fun _ => u north_pole`, so its
energy density and 2D Laplacian vanish identically.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_term_bound_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M],
  Exists fun b =>
    Exists fun c =>
      And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
        (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              ∀ (w : Complex),
                Exists fun hessNorm =>
                  Exists fun curvTerm =>
                    And
                      (Eq
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                          (fun z =>
                            GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                          w)
                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                      (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (instHMul.hMul b
                            (instHPow.hPow
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                              2))
                          (instHMul.hMul c
                            (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))

doc:
For `k = 3`, whenever every `J`-holomorphic sphere in `(M, J)` is constant, if all components
of every `u : BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 B` evaluate to the same point `c : M` at `north_pole` and
`MoebiusFrame` acts transitively on the marked point triples of `MarkedStableMap I 3`, then
`ModuliSpace I 3 B` is sequentially compact (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.moduli_space_seq_compact_three_of_all_jhol_const_of_eq_val_of_trans
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (c : M),
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 B) (v : u.val.tree.V),
          Eq (u.val.map v GromovCompactness.north_pole) c) →
        (∀ (u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I 3),
            Exists fun φ =>
              ∀ (i : Fin 3), Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe φ.toHomeo (u₁.tree.mark_point i)) (u₂.tree.mark_point i)) →
          SeqCompactSpace (GromovCompactness.Extensions.ModuliSpace I 3 B)

doc: Unconditional extraction of a varying-`J` stable limit on `[DiscreteTopology M]` targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_varying_J_stable_limit_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Exists fun u_lim =>
        And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
          (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),

doc: For `k < 3` and `B < th.ε_sph`, `ModuliSpace I k B` is empty (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.isEmpty_moduliSpace_of_lt_three_of_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat} {B : Real},

doc:
Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` when `thresh.h / 2 < m_defect` and some term `u_seq n₀`
is a constant map (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_gt_half_h_of_exists_const_term
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) m_defect →
    (Exists fun n₀ => Exists fun c => Eq (u_seq n₀) fun x => c) →
      ∀ (η : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
          Exists fun R₀ =>
            And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
              (∀ (R : Real),
                GE.ge R R₀ →
                  Exists fun δ₀ =>
                    And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                      (∀ (δ : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                          Exists fun N =>
                            ∀ (n : Nat),
                              GE.ge n N →
                                And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                  (And
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                      η)
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (Metric.diam
                                        (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                      η))))

has annular energy and neck diameter bounded by `< η` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (Exists fun N₀ =>
        ∀ (n : Nat),
          GE.ge n N₀ →
            ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
              And
                (Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) η)

      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                              (And
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))

doc:
Frame and convergence transfer onto the pruned sphere tree when a degree-1
constant root is contracted, given smooth convergence across the deleted node (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.pruned_tree_frames_and_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (root' : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root),
  pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root root'.val →
    (∀ (y : pdata.tree.V), pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root y → Eq y root'.val) →
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
          (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames root'.val n).toHomeo))
          (pdata.map root'.val)
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
            (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (pdata.tree.node_point root'.val w.val h))) →
        Exists fun frames' =>
          And (Exists fun ϕ_root => ∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames' root' n) (ϕ_root n))
            (And
              (∀ (v w : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root)
                (h : (GromovCompactness.Assembly.prunedSimpleGraph pdata.tree pdata.root).Adj v w)
                (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                Set.instLE.le K
                    (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                      (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w.val v.val ⋯))) →
                  IsCompact K →
                    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames' v n).inv.comp (frames' w n)).toHomeo)
                      (fun x => pdata.tree.node_point v.val w.val h) Filter.atTop K)

type:

  [inst_9 : SizeOf H] [inst_10 : SizeOf M] (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root : tree.V)
  (map : tree.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol : ∀ (v : tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj v w), Eq (map v (tree.node_point v w h)) (map w (tree.node_point w v ⋯)))

      Ne v root →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map v z) c) → instLENat.le 3 (tree.adj.degree v))
  (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (frames : tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (root_frame_id : Exists fun ϕ_root => ∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames root n) (ϕ_root n))

      Set.instLE.le K (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo)) (map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (tree.node_point v w h))))
  (ghost_root_deg_one_conv :
    Eq (tree.adj.degree root) 1 →
      (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map root z) c) →
        ∀ (w₀ : tree.V) (hw₀_adj : tree.adj.Adj root w₀),
          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
            (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames w₀ n).toHomeo)) (map w₀)

    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop

        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (GromovCompactness.SphereTree._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf tree))
