doc:
Diagonal subsequence and tree rescaling extraction for the grafted prestable sphere tree from
calibrated rescaling data along `globalFrameAt` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_globalFrameAt
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S)
  (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (res : GromovCompactness.Assembly.TreeRescalingData P.tree P.root),
  (∀ (v : P.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n =>
          Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n))
            (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.Assembly.globalFrameAt P.tree P.root res v n).toHomeo))
        (P.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h)))) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))) →
      Exists fun σ =>
        Exists fun res =>
          And
            (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
              (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                    Eq (frames w n)
                      ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                        (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                  ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (P.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

doc:
If the stereographic chart energy density vanishes identically on `ℂ`, then it is `C^∞` and its
translated ball integral is bounded by `energyMeasure I u (disk_at a r)` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.integral_translated_density_le_energyMeasure_of_const_chart
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
  (Eq (fun w => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) fun x =>
      0) →
    And
      (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun w =>
        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
      (Real.instLE.le
        (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
          GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
            (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (instHAdd.hAdd a w)))
        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))

doc:
Inductive Sobolev Bootstrap Reduction (Contract A05 from Contract A04).
Proves the inductive step $W^{k, p} \to W^{k+1, p}$ under interior Cauchy-Riemann estimates
via Sobolev order monotonicity with zero `sorry`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.elliptic_bootstrap_wkp_of_cauchy_riemann
type:
(∀ (p : Real),
    Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
      ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →
          Exists fun C =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
                    (instHMul.hMul C
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)
                          (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 0 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R)))))) →
  ∀ (p : Real),
    Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
      ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →
          Exists fun C =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
                    (instHMul.hMul C
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)
                          (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k f (Metric.closedBall 0 R)))))

doc:
If the sub-annulus energy `energyMeasure I u (annulus_at center r₁ r₂)` is bounded by the
collar sum `((r / r₁)^1 + (r₂ / R)^1) * energyMeasure I u (annulus_at center r R)` for all
`r < r₁ < r₂ < R`, then `SatisfiesCylinderEnergyDecay I u center r R` holds (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.satisfiesCylinderEnergyDecay_of_le_collar_sum
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex)
  (r R : Real),
  (∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
        Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
          Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
            Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
              (instHMul.hMul
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) 1) (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) 1))
                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)))) →
    GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCylinderEnergyDecay I u center r R

doc:
Single-component reduction for `extract_varying_J_stable_limit` when a subsequence `u_seq ∘ σ.1`
converges in $C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{CP}^1)$ to a non-constant limit map `u₀`:
$J_\infty$-holomorphicity of `u₀` follows automatically from `jholomorphic_limit_of_varying_J_subseq` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_varying_J_stable_limit_of_subseq_smooth_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (u₀ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀ Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u₀ z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u₀) B →
            Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u₀) →
              Exists fun u_lim =>
                And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v →
                      Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))

doc:
Conditional Reduction theorem: Epsilon-regularity / diameter bound and Stokes exactness together
imply the minimal energy gap.
Note (Conditional Reduction per COMPLETION_PLAN.md §0 & §2 P0-9):
Takes open analytical contract hypotheses (`h_diam`, `h_stokes`) and does not count as closing
Contract A07 unconditionally.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_stokes_and_diameter
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (ε_diam : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_diam →
    ∀ (r_inj : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r_inj →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) ε_diam →
                Real.instLT.lt (Metric.diam (Set.range u)) r_inj) →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Real.instLT.lt (Metric.diam (Set.range u)) r_inj → Eq (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) 0) →
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Eq (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) 0 →
                    Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
              Exists fun ε_sph =>
                And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
                  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                        Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `scalar_mean_value_inequality` given the local quadratic
subharmonic mean-value bound (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_subharmonic_mv
type:
∀ (b : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (c : optParam Real 0),
      autoParam (Real.instLE.le 0 c) GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_subharmonic_mv._auto_1 →
        ∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
              (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                  ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                    (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                              (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                      (∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                          Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                            ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                                Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                                  (∀ (w : Complex),
                                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) w →
                                        Real.instLE.le (e w) (instHMul.hMul 4 (e z₀))) →
                                    Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                                        (MeasureTheory.integral
                                          (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w =>
                                          e w)
                                        (instHDiv.hDiv
                                          (instHMul.hMul
                                            (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                                (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                            (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                          8))) →
                        Real.instLT.lt
                            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                              fun w => e w)
                            (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 2))) →
                          ∀ (z : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                              Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi) (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w))

    ∀ (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.boundary_circleIntegral_holderSeminorm_le
type:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {r R M α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          Real.instLE.le 0 M →
            ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R) →

                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) R)
                        (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))

                    M)

doc:
Global Bochner differential inequality when every `J`-holomorphic sphere has vanishing
differential everywhere on `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_global_mfderiv_eq_zero
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) 0) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)))

doc:
Subharmonic mean-value inequality on concentric interior disks `ball z₀ t` around a Heinz maximum `z₀`:
for a $C^2$ function `e` satisfying `Δe ≥ -b e² - c e` on `ball 0 r` and `e(w) ≤ 4 e(z₀)` on `closedBall z₀ ρ`,
modifying `e` by the quadratic gauge `K |w - z₀|² / 4` with `K = 16(b+c+1)e(z₀)²` yields the 2D solid-ball
mean-value bound `π t² e(z₀) ≤ ∫_{B(z₀,t)} e + π K t⁴ / 8`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound
type:
∀ (r b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
              (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    Real.instLE.le
                      (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                        (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                    ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                        Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                          (∀ (w : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) w →
                                Real.instLE.le (e w) (instHMul.hMul 4 (e z₀))) →
                            Or (Eq c 0)
                                (Or (Real.instLE.le (1 / 4) (e z₀))
                                  (Or (Real.instLE.le c (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 (instHAdd.hAdd c 1)) (e z₀)))
                                    (Or
                                      (Real.instLE.le 1
                                        (instHMul.hMul
                                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1)) (e z₀))
                                          (instHPow.hPow t 2)))
                                      (Or
                                        (Real.instLE.le
                                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                                          (MeasureTheory.integral
                                            (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t))
                                            fun w => e w))
                                        (Or
                                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                              Real.instLE.le
                                                (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z))
                                          (Or
                                            (∀ (w : Complex),
                                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                                                Real.instLE.le 0 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w))
                                            (Or
                                              (∀ (w : Complex),
                                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                                                  Real.instLE.le
                                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                                      (instHMul.hMul (-4) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                                      (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w))
                                              (∀ (w : Complex),
                                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                                                  Real.instLE.le
                                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                                      (instHMul.hMul (-16) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                                      (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w))))))))) →
                              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                          (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                      (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                    8))

doc: Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `gromov_compactness_varying_J` from a stable sphere tree limit
satisfying the principal-component energy lower bound (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_limit
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J) (B : Real)
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I),
  Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B →
    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
        GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v →
          Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))) →
      Exists fun u_lim' =>
        And (∀ (v : u_lim'.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim'.map v) Set.univ)
          (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim'.map v)) B)
            (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim' v);
            have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim' v);
            And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
              (And
                (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) →
                  And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                    (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V).cast
                  (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc:
One-sided punctured-disk power-law energy decay derived from two-sided cylinder energy decay (`0 sorryAx`):
If `u` satisfies two-sided cylinder decay on sub-annuli of `annulus_at center 0 R` with constants
`(C₀, a_decay)` (`0 ≤ C₀`, `0 ≤ a_decay`) and `energyMeasureExtended I u (annulus_at center 0 R) ≠ ⊤`,
then for all `0 < r₁ < r₂ < R`, choosing the inner radius `r = min (r₁ / 2) (r₁ * (r₂ / R))`
absorbs the inner collar ratio `(r / r₁)^a_decay ≤ (r₂ / R)^a_decay` and yields
`E(u; A(r₁, r₂)) ≤ 2 * C₀ * (r₂ / R)^a_decay * E(u; A(0, R))`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.energyMeasure_annulus_le_punctured_disk_power_of_cylinder_decay
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex)
  {r₁ r₂ R C₀ a_decay : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r₁ →
    Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
      Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
        Real.instLE.le 0 C₀ →
          Real.instLE.le 0 a_decay →
            Ne
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
                  (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center 0 R))
                ENNReal.instTop.top →
              (∀ (r : Real),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                    Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (instHMul.hMul C₀
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                              (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)))) →
                Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 C₀) (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay))
                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center 0 R)))

type:

  (w₀ : pdata.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        IsOpen Ω →
          Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                (pdata.map w₀)
                (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
              Real.instLT.lt (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)) th.h →
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                  (pdata.map w₀) Ω

type:

  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)

      GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) Set.univ) →

  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
          Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
      ∀ (η : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
          Exists fun R₀ =>
            And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
              (∀ (R : Real),
                GE.ge R R₀ →
                  Exists fun δ₀ =>
                    And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                      (∀ (δ : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                          Exists fun N =>
                            ∀ (n : Nat),
                              GE.ge n N →
                                And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                  (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                    Set.instMembership.mem
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                      Set.instMembership.mem
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) w →
                                        Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `bochner_differential_inequality` from the Weitzenböck
curvature decomposition bound (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_curvature_bound
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Exists fun hessNorm =>
                    Exists fun curvTerm =>
                      And
                        (Eq
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                            (fun z =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                            w)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                        (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul b
                              (instHPow.hPow
                                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                2))
                            (instHMul.hMul c
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)))

doc:
Suppressed sphere tree structure and convergence transfer on `{v : pdata.tree.V // v ≠ pdata.root}`
when a degree-2 constant root is suppressed and its two neighbors are joined by a bridge edge
(Proved with zero sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.suppressed_tree_and_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 2 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      ∀ (w₁ w₂ : pdata.tree.V),
        Ne w₁ w₂ →
          pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₁ →
            pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₂ →
              (∀ (y : pdata.tree.V), pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root y → Or (Eq y w₁) (Eq y w₂)) →
                ∀ (root' : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root),
                  let adj' := GromovCompactness.Assembly.suppressedSimpleGraph pdata.tree pdata.root w₁ w₂;
                  Exists fun _is_tree' =>
                    Exists fun node_point' =>
                      Exists fun _node_distinct' =>
                        Exists fun frames' =>
                          And
                            (∀ (v w : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root) (h : adj'.Adj v w),
                              Eq (pdata.map v.val (node_point' v w h)) (pdata.map w.val (node_point' w v ⋯)))
                            (And
                              (∀ (v : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root),
                                Ne v root' →
                                  (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map v.val z) c) →
                                    instLENat.le 3 (adj'.degree v))
                              (And (Exists fun ϕ_root => ∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames' root' n) (ϕ_root n))
                                (And
                                  (∀ (v w : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root) (h : adj'.Adj v w)
                                    (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                    Set.instLE.le K
                                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                                          (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (node_point' w v ⋯))) →
                                      IsCompact K →
                                        TendstoUniformlyOn
                                          (fun n =>
                                            EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames' v n).inv.comp (frames' w n)).toHomeo)
                                          (fun x => node_point' v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                                  (∀ (v : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root),
                                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                                      (fun n =>
                                        Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n))
                                          (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames' v n).toHomeo))
                                      (pdata.map v.val)
                                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                                        (Set.ofPred fun z =>
                                          Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (node_point' v w h)))))))

name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.assemble_prestable_limit_of_all_jhol_eq_north_pole_of_eventually_const_north_pole
type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →

type:

doc:
Subharmonic quadratic mean-value bound when `laplacian2D e` is bounded below by `-M` on
`Metric.closedBall z₀ t` with `M ≤ 16 * (b + c + 1) * (e z₀)^2` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_laplacian_ge_neg_const
type:
∀ (r b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
              ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                  ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                      Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                        ∀ (M : Real),
                          Real.instLE.le M
                              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)) →
                            (∀ (w : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                                  Real.instLE.le (Real.instNeg.neg M) (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w)) →
                              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                          (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                      (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                    8))

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (J_seq : Nat → (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x))
  (J_seq_sq :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
      Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J_seq n x) (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J_seq n x) v))
        (SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass.neg v))
  (J_seq_smooth :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (x : M),
      ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) (GromovCompactness.J_chart I (J_seq n) x) (extChartAt I x).target)
  (J_seq_tame :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
      Ne v 0 →
        Real.instLT.lt 0
          (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (tgt.ω x) v)
            (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J_seq n x) v)))
  (c0_conv : ∀ (x : M), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => J_seq n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (tgt.J x)))
  (c_infty_conv :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (x : M) (K : Set E),
      Set.instLE.le K (extChartAt I x).target →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n y => iteratedFDeriv Real k (GromovCompactness.J_chart I (J_seq n) x) y)
            (fun y => iteratedFDeriv Real k (GromovCompactness.J_chart I tgt.J x) y) Filter.atTop K)
  (uth_h : Real) (uth_h_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 uth_h) (uth_ε_reg : Real) (uth_ε_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 uth_ε_reg)
  (uth_C_reg : Real) (uth_C_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 uth_C_reg)
  (uth_reg :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (J_seq n) u Set.univ →
          Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) uth_ε_reg →
            ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Extensions.riemannianEnergyDensityWithJ I tgt.ω (J_seq n) u z)
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul uth_C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                    (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))))
  (uth_hbar : Real) (uth_hbar_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 uth_hbar)
  (uth_sph :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (J_seq n) u Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le uth_hbar (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u Set.univ))
  (uth_le_reg : Real.instLE.le uth_h (instHDiv.hDiv uth_ε_reg 2)) (uth_le_sph : Real.instLE.le uth_h uth_hbar)
  (J_seq_1 : Nat → (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x))
  (J_seq_sq_1 :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
      Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J_seq_1 n x) (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J_seq_1 n x) v))
        (SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass.neg v))
  (J_seq_smooth_1 :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (x : M),
      ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) (GromovCompactness.J_chart I (J_seq_1 n) x)

  (J_seq_tame_1 :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
      Ne v 0 →
        Real.instLT.lt 0
          (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (tgt.ω x) v)
            (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J_seq_1 n x) v)))
  (c0_conv_1 : ∀ (x : M), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => J_seq_1 n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (tgt.J x)))
  (c_infty_conv_1 :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (x : M) (K : Set E),
      Set.instLE.le K (extChartAt I x).target →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n y => iteratedFDeriv Real k (GromovCompactness.J_chart I (J_seq_1 n) x) y)
            (fun y => iteratedFDeriv Real k (GromovCompactness.J_chart I tgt.J x) y) Filter.atTop K)
  (uth_h_1 : Real) (uth_h_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 uth_h_1) (uth_ε_reg_1 : Real)
  (uth_ε_reg_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 uth_ε_reg_1) (uth_C_reg_1 : Real) (uth_C_reg_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 uth_C_reg_1)
  (uth_reg_1 :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (J_seq_1 n) u Set.univ →
          Real.instLT.lt ⋯ uth_ε_reg_1 → ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), ⋯)
  (uth_hbar_1 : Real) (uth_hbar_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 uth_hbar_1)
  (uth_sph_1 :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (J_seq_1 n) u Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) → Real.instLE.le uth_hbar_1 ⋯)
  (uth_le_reg_1 : Real.instLE.le uth_h_1 (instHDiv.hDiv uth_ε_reg_1 2))
  (uth_le_sph_1 : Real.instLE.le uth_h_1 uth_hbar_1),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { J_seq := J_seq, J_seq_sq := J_seq_sq, J_seq_smooth := J_seq_smooth, J_seq_tame := J_seq_tame,
        c0_conv := c0_conv, c_infty_conv := c_infty_conv, uth_h := uth_h, uth_h_pos := uth_h_pos,
        uth_ε_reg := uth_ε_reg, uth_ε_reg_pos := uth_ε_reg_pos, uth_C_reg := uth_C_reg, uth_C_reg_pos := uth_C_reg_pos,
        uth_reg := uth_reg, uth_hbar := uth_hbar, uth_hbar_pos := uth_hbar_pos, uth_sph := uth_sph,
        uth_le_reg := uth_le_reg, uth_le_sph := uth_le_sph }
      { J_seq := J_seq_1, J_seq_sq := J_seq_sq_1, J_seq_smooth := J_seq_smooth_1, J_seq_tame := J_seq_tame_1,
        c0_conv := c0_conv_1, c_infty_conv := c_infty_conv_1, uth_h := uth_h_1, uth_h_pos := uth_h_pos_1,
        uth_ε_reg := uth_ε_reg_1, uth_ε_reg_pos := uth_ε_reg_pos_1, uth_C_reg := uth_C_reg_1,
        uth_C_reg_pos := uth_C_reg_pos_1, uth_reg := uth_reg_1, uth_hbar := uth_hbar_1, uth_hbar_pos := uth_hbar_pos_1,
        uth_sph := uth_sph_1, uth_le_reg := uth_le_reg_1, uth_le_sph := uth_le_sph_1 })
    (And (Eq J_seq J_seq_1)

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M]
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →

        And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
          (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
          have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
          And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
            (And
              (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                  (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
              (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
Unconditional `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` when `B < th.ε_sph` and `u_seq` consists of
`J`-holomorphic spheres with `totalEnergy ≤ B` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_B_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
          (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
          (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
          Real.instLT.lt B th.ε_sph →
            Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun res =>
                And
                  (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                    (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                      (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                          Eq (frames w n)
                            ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                              (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                        ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                            (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                            (P.map v)
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                    (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` when the sequence is eventually `J`-holomorphic with
`totalEnergy I (u_seq n) < thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) thresh.h) →
      ∀ (η : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
          Exists fun R₀ =>
            And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
              (∀ (R : Real),
                GE.ge R R₀ →
                  Exists fun δ₀ =>
                    And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                      (∀ (δ : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                          Exists fun N =>
                            ∀ (n : Nat),
                              GE.ge n N →
                                And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                  (And
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                      η)
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (Metric.diam
                                        (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                      η))))

type:

  {inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M} {inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M} {inst_6 : CompactSpace M}
  {inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M} {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M}
  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I} {σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap}
  {frames : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame}
  {smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h)))}
  {frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K}
  {energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))}
  {σ_1 : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap} {frames_1 : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame}
  {smooth_conv_1 :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ_1.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h)))}
  {frame_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames_1 v n).inv.comp (frames_1 w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K}
  {energy_conv_1 :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ_1.val n))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))},
  Eq
      { σ := σ, frames := frames, smooth_conv := smooth_conv, frame_collapse := frame_collapse,
        energy_conv := energy_conv }
      { σ := σ_1, frames := frames_1, smooth_conv := smooth_conv_1, frame_collapse := frame_collapse_1,
        energy_conv := energy_conv_1 } →
    And (Eq σ σ_1) (Eq frames frames_1)

doc: Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `defect_measure_identity` from `defect_measure_decomposition_exists` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_identity_of_decomp
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Or (Eq cdata.μ (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀))
      (Or
        (And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph thresh.ε_reg)
          (Eq cdata.μ
            (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
              (cdata.S.sum fun p =>
                instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))
        (Or
          (And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
                Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)).toReal)
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p =>
                  instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))
          (Exists fun m =>
            And
              (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
              (Eq cdata.μ
                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                  (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))))) →
    Exists fun m =>
      And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
        (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
          (And
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);

doc:
Any finite-energy `J`-holomorphic curve on the punctured sphere `CP1 \ {p}` satisfies
`SatisfiesPunctureSobolevExtension` when it is constant on `CP1 \ {p}`, globally `J`-holomorphic
or `WeakJHolomorphicOn`, admits a $C^1$ extension with vanishing differential at `p`, or agrees on
`CP1 \ {p}` with a globally `J`-holomorphic or `WeakJHolomorphicOn` extension (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.satisfiesPunctureSobolevExtension_of_finite_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u
      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
    Ne
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
        ENNReal.instTop.top →
      Or
          (Exists fun c =>
            Set.EqOn (fun x => c) u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
          (Or (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ)
            (Or (GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u Set.univ)
              (Or
                (Exists fun u_ext =>
                  And (ContMDiffOn GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I 1 u_ext Set.univ)
                    (And (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
                      (Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u_ext p) 0)))
                (Or
                  (Exists fun u_ext =>
                    And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_ext Set.univ)
                      (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))))
                  (Exists fun u_ext =>
                    And (GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u_ext Set.univ)
                      (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))))))) →
        GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesPunctureSobolevExtension I u p

doc: Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `isolating_disk_defect_limit` from `defect_measure_decomposition_exists` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Or (Eq cdata.μ (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀))
      (Or
        (And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph thresh.ε_reg)
          (Eq cdata.μ
            (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
              (cdata.S.sum fun p =>
                instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))
        (Or
          (And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
                Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)).toReal)
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p =>
                  instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))
          (Exists fun m =>
            And
              (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
              (Eq cdata.μ
                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                  (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))))) →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                        Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc: Asymptotic neck energy and diameter decay when the sequence is eventually constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_annular_energy_and_diam_of_eventually_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (Exists fun N₀ => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Exists fun c => Eq (u_seq n) fun x => c) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)

                                  (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                η)))

doc: Unconditional defect measure identity when `B ≤ 0` on any target manifold `M` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_identity_of_nonpos_B_jhol
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),

              And
                (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
                (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
                  (And
                    (Eq cdata.μ
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                        (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `sphere_energy_gap` when `riemannianEnergyDensity I u` is
continuous and there is a pair of points at distance `≥ 2 * r₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_continuous_density_and_pair_dist_ge
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              Continuous (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u) →
                (Exists fun z₁ => Exists fun z₂ => Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (inst_3.dist (u z₁) (u z₂))) →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r₀ 2)) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

doc:
Equivalence between the pointwise Bochner inequality `-b e_w² - c e_w ≤ lap_w` and the
existence of a Weitzenböck decomposition `lap_w = hessNorm² + curvTerm` with
`|curvTerm| ≤ b e_w² + c e_w` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_decomposition_of_inequality
type:
∀ {e_w lap_w b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      Real.instLE.le 0 e_w →
        Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow e_w 2)) (instHMul.hMul c e_w))
            lap_w →
          Exists fun hessNorm =>
            Exists fun curvTerm =>
              And (Eq lap_w (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul b (instHPow.hPow e_w 2)) (instHMul.hMul c e_w)))

doc:
Master Stabilization Theorem when `u_seq` is non-constant along a subsequence `τ` and some
term `u_seq (τ.1 n)` has non-positive energy (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_subseq_nonconst_of_exists_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq)
  (τ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (τ.val n) z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (τ.val n)) Set.univ) →
      (Exists fun n => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (τ.val n))) 0) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:

doc:
Zero-defect singleton convergence at the attachment point of a degree-1 constant root:
when `root` has degree 1 and `map root` is constant, the exterior of the unique child bubble `w₀`
carries zero limiting energy, so the rescaled sequence on `w₀` also converges smoothly at the attachment node.
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData.ghost_root_deg_one_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

      ∀ (w₀ : self.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : self.tree.adj.Adj self.root w₀),
        GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
          (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (self.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (self.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
          (self.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (self.tree.node_point w₀ self.root ⋯))

Smooth convergence upgrade across a deleted node when the sum of component energies is strictly
below `th.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.upgrade_convergence_across_deleted_node_of_sum_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq)
  (w₀ : pdata.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        IsOpen Ω →
          Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                (pdata.map w₀)
                (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
              Real.instLT.lt (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)) th.ε_sph →
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                  (pdata.map w₀) Ω

doc:
Reduction of `extract_varying_J_stable_limit` to any `StableSphereTreeLimit` with total energy `≤ B`
when `uth.h` is bounded above by the sphere energy gap `ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_varying_J_stable_limit_of_le_gap
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J) (B : Real)
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I),
  Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B →
    ∀ {ε_sph : Real},
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
              Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)) →
        Real.instLE.le uth.h ε_sph →
          Exists fun u_lim' =>
            And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim'.map v)) B)
              (∀ (v : u_lim'.tree.V),
                GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim' v →
                  Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim'.map v)))

doc: Unconditional core compactness on `[DiscreteTopology M]` targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_core_of_discrete
type:

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M]
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Exists fun u_lim => Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim)

doc:
Weak compactness of a sequence of uniformly bounded finite Borel measures on `CP1` that admits
a weakly convergent subsequence (`0 sorryAx`, deducing `IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim` from `h_bdd`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.prokhorov_weak_compactness_of_subseq_conv_bdd
type:
∀ (μ_seq : Nat → MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  [∀ (n : Nat), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ_seq n)],
  (Exists fun B =>
      And (GT.gt B 0)
        (∀ (n : Nat),
          ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (μ_seq n) Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B))) →
    ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (μ_lim : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence (fun n => μ_seq (σ.val n)) μ_lim →
        Exists fun σ' =>
          Exists fun μ_lim' =>
            And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim')
              (GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence (fun n => μ_seq (σ'.val n)) μ_lim')

doc:
Unconditional core compactness when a subsequence `σ` consists of non-constant maps and some
term on `σ` has `totalEnergy < th.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_core_of_subseq_nonconst_of_exists_lt_eps_sph
type:

  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),

        (Exists fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) th.ε_sph) →
