doc:
For `k = 3`, whenever every `J`-holomorphic sphere in `(M, J)` is constant, if all components
of every `u : BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 B` evaluate to the same point `c : M` at `north_pole` and
`MoebiusFrame` acts transitively on the marked point triples of `MarkedStableMap I 3`, then
`ModuliSpace I 3 B` is compact (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.moduli_space_compact_three_of_all_jhol_const_of_eq_val_of_trans
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (c : M),
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 B) (v : u.val.tree.V),
          Eq (u.val.map v GromovCompactness.north_pole) c) →
        (∀ (u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I 3),
            Exists fun φ =>
              ∀ (i : Fin 3), Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe φ.toHomeo (u₁.tree.mark_point i)) (u₂.tree.mark_point i)) →
          CompactSpace (GromovCompactness.Extensions.ModuliSpace I 3 B)

doc:
The Bochner differential inequality holds unconditionally whenever the stereographic chart energy
density is constant on `ℂ` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_const_chart
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (c₀ : Real),
        (Eq (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
            fun x => c₀) →
          ∀ (w : Complex),
            Real.instLE.le
              (instHSub.hSub
                (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                  (instHPow.hPow
                    (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) 2))
                (instHMul.hMul c
                  (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                w)

doc: On a `[DiscreteTopology M]` target, `graft_defect_trees_to_root` holds unconditionally (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.graft_defect_trees_to_root_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))) →
            Exists fun pdata =>
              Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)) B

doc: Inductive Schauder Bootstrap Step from `SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder` (Zero-sorry reduction).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.elliptic_bootstrap_holder_of_schauder
type:
∀ (k : Nat) (α r R : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          Exists fun C =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder k α r R f →
                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                      (instHMul.hMul C
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm k α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                            (Metric.ball 0 R))
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm k α f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.polar_far_zone_angular_slice_bound
type:
∀ {g : Complex → Complex} {z w : Complex} {M δ ρ α : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 M →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 δ →
      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 δ) ρ →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
          Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
            Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) δ →
              (∀ (θ : Real),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.uIcc 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)) θ →
                    Real.instLE.le
                      (Complex.instNorm.norm
                        (g
                          (instHAdd.hAdd z
                            (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                              (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))))
                      M) →
                Real.instLE.le
                  (Complex.instNorm.norm
                    (intervalIntegral
                      (fun θ =>
                        instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                          (instHSub.hSub
                            (instHDiv.hDiv
                              (g
                                (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                    (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                              (instHSub.hSub
                                (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                    (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
                                z))
                            (instHDiv.hDiv
                              (g
                                (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                    (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                              (instHSub.hSub
                                (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                    (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
                                w))))
                      0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) Real.measureSpace.volume))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi) M) (instHPow.hPow δ α))
                    (instHPow.hPow ρ (Real.instNeg.neg α)))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.fderiv_comp_add_const
type:
∀ (g : Complex → Real) (a z : Complex),
  Eq (fderiv Real (fun w => g (instHAdd.hAdd a w)) z) (fderiv Real g (instHAdd.hAdd a z))

doc:
By definition, `laplacian2D` is the sum of the two diagonal entries of the second
iterated Fréchet derivative on `ℂ`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D_eq_trace_iteratedFDeriv
type:
∀ (e : Complex → Real) (z : Complex),
  Eq (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe (iteratedFDeriv Real 2 e z)
        (Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 1 Matrix.vecEmpty)))
      (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe (iteratedFDeriv Real 2 e z)
        (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I Matrix.vecEmpty))))

doc: Zero-sorry interior Cauchy–Riemann Schauder estimate when `f = fun _ => 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.interior_cauchy_riemann_estimate_of_eq_zero
type:
∀ (k : Nat) (α r R : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          Exists fun C =>
            And (GT.gt C 0)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                (Eq f fun x => 0) →
                  Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                    (instHMul.hMul C
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm k α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                          (Metric.ball 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm_sub_le_of_bounds
type:
∀ {α K₁ K₂ : Real} {f₁ f₂ : Complex → Complex} {s : Set Complex},
  Real.instLE.le 0 K₁ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 K₂ →
      (∀ (z : Complex),
          Set.instMembership.mem s z →
            ∀ (w : Complex),
              Set.instMembership.mem s w →
                Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f₁ z) (f₁ w)))
                  (instHMul.hMul K₁ (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
        (∀ (z : Complex),
            Set.instMembership.mem s z →
              ∀ (w : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem s w →
                  Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f₂ z) (f₂ w)))
                    (instHMul.hMul K₂ (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm α (fun z => instHSub.hSub (f₁ z) (f₂ z)) s)
            (instHAdd.hAdd K₁ K₂)

name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.suppressedSimpleGraph_isTree
type:
∀ (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root w₁ w₂ : tree.V),
  Ne w₁ w₂ →
    tree.adj.Adj root w₁ →
      tree.adj.Adj root w₂ →
        (∀ (y : tree.V), tree.adj.Adj root y → Or (Eq y w₁) (Eq y w₂)) →
          (GromovCompactness.Assembly.suppressedSimpleGraph tree root w₁ w₂).IsTree

doc: Zero-sorry prestable limit assembly from any `PrestableLimitData` on a subsequence `u_seq ∘ σ.1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.assemble_prestable_limit_of_subseq_pdata
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
    ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
      (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)),
      Exists fun pdata' => Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v)) B

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.interior_cauchy_riemann_estimate_zero_of_first_deriv
type:
∀ {α r R C₀ C₁ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 C₀ →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 C₁ →
      ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
        Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 r))
            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)) →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
              (instHMul.hMul C₀
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                    (Metric.ball 0 R))
                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))) →
            (∀ (z : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                  Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1))
                    (instHMul.hMul C₁
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                          (Metric.ball 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))) →
              (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f z))
                      (instHMul.hMul 2
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                          (Metric.ball 0 R)))) →
                (∀ (z : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                      ∀ (w : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (Complex.instNorm.norm
                              (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1)
                                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f w) 1)))
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHMul.hMul C₁
                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                              (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                  (∀ (z : Complex),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                        ∀ (w : Complex),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                            Real.instLE.le
                              (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f z)
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f w)))
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (instHMul.hMul 2
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                                (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 1 α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd 1 C₀) (instHMul.hMul 4 C₁)) 8)
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                            (Metric.ball 0 R))
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))

doc: $J$-invariance of the symmetrized metric: $g(Jv, Jw) = g(v, w)$.
name: GromovCompactness.metric_J_invariant
type:

doc:
Subharmonic quadratic mean-value bound in the large-radius / large-center regime
`1 ≤ 2 * (b + c + 1) * e z₀ * t^2` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_large_radius
type:
∀ (b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
              ∀ (t : Real),
                Real.instLE.le 1
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1)) (e z₀))
                      (instHPow.hPow t 2)) →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t))
                        fun w => e w)
                      (instHDiv.hDiv
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                              (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                          (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                        8))

doc:
For `A.omega_eval < th.h`, if all components of every `u : BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 A.omega_eval`
evaluate to the same point `c : M` at `north_pole` and `MoebiusFrame` acts transitively on the marked point
triples of `MarkedStableMap I 3`, then `ModuliSpaceInClass I 3 A` is Hausdorff (`T2Space`) (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.moduli_space_in_class_t2_three_of_lt_threshold_of_eq_val_of_trans
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]

  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M),

    ∀ (c : M),
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 A.omega_eval) (v : u.val.tree.V),
          Eq (u.val.map v GromovCompactness.north_pole) c) →
        (∀ (u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I 3),
            Exists fun φ =>
              ∀ (i : Fin 3), Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe φ.toHomeo (u₁.tree.mark_point i)) (u₂.tree.mark_point i)) →
          T2Space (GromovCompactness.Extensions.ModuliSpaceInClass I 3 A)

doc:
Any two `3`-marked stable maps whose components are all constant with the same value `c : M`
and whose marked points are intertwined by a `MoebiusFrame` `φ` are isomorphic (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.stableMapEquiv_of_all_const_three
type:

doc: Morrey-Sobolev difference quotient bound for constant maps or maps with unit-constant Hölder-Sobolev bound (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.satisfiesMorreySobolev_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 2 p →
    ∀ (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        ∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
          ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            Or (Exists fun c => Eq f fun x => c)
                (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
                    ∀ (w : Complex),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                        Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHPow.hPow (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z w)
                              (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p)))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r)))) →
              GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesMorreySobolev p r f

doc:
Existence of calibrated moving centers and radii for smooth `J`-holomorphic spheres
without requiring an external `RadialEnergyIVT` hypothesis (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.exists_calibrated_rescaling_of_jhol
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat),
          Exists fun a_n =>
            Exists fun R_n =>
              And
                (Real.instLE.le (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist a_n 0)
                  (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHAdd.hAdd n.cast 1)))
                (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 R_n)
                  (And (Real.instLE.le R_n (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHAdd.hAdd n.cast 1)))
                    (Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))
                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a_n R_n)))))) →
        Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Analysis.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect)

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `epsilon_regularity` when the translated chart energy
density vanishes on `Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_eq_zero_on_ball
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c η C : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 C →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (z : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun w =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                      z)) →
            (∀ (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
                    (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                      ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                        ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                    (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                            Real.instLT.lt
                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w)
                                η →
                              ∀ (z : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                  Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                      (MeasureTheory.integral
                                        (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
                                        e w))) →
              ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun w =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) →
                      (∀ (w : Complex),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                            Eq
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (instHAdd.hAdd a w)))
                              0) →
                        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) η →
                          ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                              Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))

doc:
Two-sided neck factor bound: $(r / r_1)^\alpha + (r_2 / R)^\alpha$ is bounded above by 2
when $0 < r \le r_1$ and $0 \le r_2 \le R$ and $\alpha \ge 0$.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.neck_factor_le_two
type:
∀ {r r₁ r₂ R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLE.le r r₁ →
      Real.instLE.le 0 r₂ →
        Real.instLE.le r₂ R →
          Real.instLT.lt 0 R →
            Real.instLE.le 0 α →
              Real.instLE.le
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) α) (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) α)) 2

doc:
Unconditional `neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound` when `thresh.h ≤ m_defect` and some `J`-holomorphic
term `u_seq n₀` has total energy `< thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_ge_h_of_exists_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) thresh.h →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                        Set.instMembership.mem
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                          Set.instMembership.mem
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                              w →
                                            Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

  {thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M} (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) [μ_fin : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ]
  (μ_total_le : ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B))
  (weak_lim :
    GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence

  (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  (S_def :
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p)
        (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)

  (card_S_mul_le : Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul S.card.cast thresh.ε_reg) B)

  (u₀_jhol : GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀ Set.univ)

    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀

  (measure_decomp :
    Eq μ
      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u₀)
        (S.sum fun p =>
          instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
  (σ_1 : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (μ_1 : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  (μ_fin_1 : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_1)
  (μ_total_le_1 : ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ_1 Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B))
  (weak_lim_1 :
    GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
      (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ_1.val n))) μ_1)
  (S_1 : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  (S_def_1 :
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S_1 p)
        (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ_1 (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))))
  (card_S_mul_le_1 : Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul S_1.card.cast thresh.ε_reg) B)
  (card_S_le_1 : Real.instLE.le S_1.card.cast (instHDiv.hDiv B thresh.ε_reg)) (u₀_1 : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (u₀_jhol_1 : GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀_1 Set.univ)
  (smooth_conv_1 :
    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ_1.val n)) u₀_1
      (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Set.univ (Finset.instSetLike.coe S_1)))
  (measure_decomp_1 :
    Eq μ_1
      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u₀_1)
        (S_1.sum fun p =>
          instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ_1 (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { σ := σ, μ := μ, μ_fin := μ_fin, μ_total_le := μ_total_le, weak_lim := weak_lim, S := S, S_def := S_def,
        card_S_mul_le := card_S_mul_le, card_S_le := card_S_le, u₀ := u₀, u₀_jhol := u₀_jhol,
        smooth_conv := smooth_conv, measure_decomp := measure_decomp }

        S_def := S_def_1, card_S_mul_le := card_S_mul_le_1, card_S_le := card_S_le_1, u₀ := u₀_1, u₀_jhol := u₀_jhol_1,
        smooth_conv := smooth_conv_1, measure_decomp := measure_decomp_1 })
    (And (Eq σ σ_1) (And (Eq μ μ_1) (And (Eq S S_1) (Eq u₀ u₀_1))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.boundary_circleIntegral_deriv_holder_est
type:
∀ {r R α M : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          Real.instLE.le 0 M →
            ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
              ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R) →
                (∀ (ζ : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.sphere 0 R) ζ → Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (f ζ)) M) →
                  ∀ {z w : Complex},
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                        Real.instLE.le
                          (Complex.instNorm.norm
                            (instHSub.hSub
                              (circleIntegral
                                (fun ζ =>
                                  instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub ζ z) 2)) (f ζ))
                                0 R)
                              (circleIntegral
                                (fun ζ =>
                                  instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub ζ w) 2)) (f ζ))
                                0 R)))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHDiv.hDiv
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi) R) (instHAdd.hAdd R r))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                                (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 4))
                              M)
                            (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))

doc: Morrey-Sobolev Embedding in 2D from `SatisfiesMorreySobolev` (Zero-sorry reduction).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.morrey_sobolev_embedding_of_certificate
type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 2 p →
    ∀ (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Exists fun C =>
          Exists fun α =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
              (And (Eq α (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p)))
                (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 α)
                  (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                    ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                      GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesMorreySobolev p r f →
                        ∀ (z : Complex),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
                            ∀ (w : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                                Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z w) α))
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))))))

doc:
First-order directional derivative and `dbarComplex` Schauder bounds when `dbarComplex f` is $C^1$
on `closedBall 0 R` and `f` satisfies the first-order directional derivative estimates on `ball 0 r` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.schauder_zero_deriv_bounds_of_contDiffOn_dbar
type:
∀ {α r R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
            ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
              ContDiffOn Real 1 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                (∀ (z : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                      Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1))
                        (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                              (Metric.ball 0 R))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))) →
                  (∀ (z : Complex),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                        ∀ (w : Complex),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                            Real.instLE.le
                              (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1)
                                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f w) 1)))
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                                (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                    And
                      (BddAbove
                        (Set.image (fun z => Complex.instNorm.norm (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f z))
                          (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                      (And
                        (BddAbove
                          (Set.ofPred fun q =>
                            Exists fun z =>
                              And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) z)
                                (Exists fun w =>
                                  And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) w)
                                    (And (Ne z w)
                                      (Eq q
                                        (instHDiv.hDiv
                                          (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                            (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f z)
                                              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f w)))
                                          (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α)))))))
                        (And
                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                              Real.instLE.le
                                (Complex.instNorm.norm (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1))
                                (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))
                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                              ∀ (w : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                                  Real.instLE.le
                                    (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                      (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1)
                                        (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f w) 1)))
                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                                      (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α)))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `sphere_energy_gap` when `riemannianEnergyDensity I u` is
continuous and for every `x ∈ Set.range u` there is `z : CP1` with `r₀ ≤ dist (u z) x` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_continuous_density_and_exists_dist_ge
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              Continuous (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u) →
                (∀ (x : M),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x → Exists fun z => Real.instLE.le r₀ (inst_3.dist (u z) x)) →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r₀ 2)) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

doc: When `S = ∅` and `μ = energyMeasureExtended I u₀`, the defect measure decomposition holds with zero sorry.
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_decomposition_of_empty_S
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Eq cdata.S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection →
    Eq cdata.μ (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀) →
      Exists fun m =>
        And
          (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
          (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem under a positive energy lower bound and singleton convergence upgrade (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_energy_lb_and_upgrade
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) {ε : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le ε (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n))) →
      (∀ (pdata' : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata'.tree.V)
          (hw₀_adj : pdata'.tree.adj.Adj pdata'.root w₀),
          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
            (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata'.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata'.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
            (pdata'.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata'.tree.node_point w₀ pdata'.root ⋯))) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:
Smooth convergence upgrade across a deleted node (`0 sorryAx` conditional reduction):
At an interior smooth point attached to a degree-1 constant root with zero limiting energy atom,
convergence upgrades smoothly across the point.
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.upgrade_convergence_across_deleted_node_of_upgrade
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata.tree.V)
  (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        IsOpen Ω →
          Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                (pdata.map w₀)
                (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
              Or (Eq Ω Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
                  (Or
                    (Exists fun c =>
                      And
                        (Eq
                          (fun n =>
                            Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                          fun x x_1 => c)
                        (Eq (pdata.map w₀) fun x => c))
                    (Or
                      (Exists fun N₀ =>
                        Exists fun c =>
                          And
                            (∀ (n : Nat),
                              GE.ge n N₀ →
                                ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                  Eq
                                    (Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n))
                                      (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo) z)
                                    c)
                            (Eq (pdata.map w₀) fun x => c))
                      (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n =>
                          Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                        (pdata.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))))) →
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                  (pdata.map w₀) Ω

doc: Transfers a bound on the Heinz maximum `(r - ‖z₀‖)² e(z₀)` to a uniform bound on `closedBall 0 (r/2)`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.heinz_transfer_to_half_ball
type:
∀ (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
      (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
        ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z₀ →
            (∀ (w : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm w)) 2) (e w))
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm z₀)) 2) (e z₀))) →
              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm z₀)) 2) (e z₀))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 8 Real.pi)
                    (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
                      e w)) →
                ∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                    Real.instLE.le (e z)
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi) (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                        (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                          fun w => e w))

doc:
Iterated Widman hole-filling geometric contraction (`0 sorryAx`):
If `e : ℕ → ℝ` satisfies `e (j + 1) ≤ K * (e j - e (j + 1))` for all `j < k` with `0 ≤ K`,
then `e k ≤ (K / (1 + K)) ^ k * e 0`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.le_pow_hole_filling_of_step
type:
∀ {e : Nat → Real} {K : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 K →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      (∀ (j : Nat),
          instLTNat.lt j k →
            Real.instLE.le (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1)) (instHMul.hMul K (instHSub.hSub (e j) (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1))))) →
        Real.instLE.le (e k) (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv K (instHAdd.hAdd 1 K)) k) (e 0))

doc: Unconditional Weitzenböck curvature bound on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_term_bound_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [DiscreteTopology M] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_6 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M]
  [inst_7 : CompactSpace M] [inst_8 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  Exists fun b =>
    Exists fun c =>
      And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
        (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              ∀ (w : Complex),
                Exists fun hessNorm =>
                  Exists fun curvTerm =>
                    And
                      (Eq
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                          (fun z =>
                            GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                          w)
                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                      (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (instHMul.hMul b
                            (instHPow.hPow
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                              2))
                          (instHMul.hMul c
                            (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))

on `pdata.σ` has degree at least 1 given a positive sphere energy gap (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  (Exists fun ε_sph =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
              Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))) →
    ∀ (N₀ : Nat),
      (∀ (n : Nat),
          GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) Set.univ) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `gromov_compactness_varying_J` from a single non-constant
`J`-holomorphic sphere `u₀` with `uth.h ≤ totalEnergy I u₀ ≤ B` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_single_nonconst
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J) (B : Real)
  (u₀ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀ Set.univ →
    Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u₀ z) c) →
      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u₀) B →
        Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u₀) →
          Exists fun u_lim' =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim'.tree.V),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim'.map v) Set.univ)
              (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim'.map v)) B)
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim' v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim' v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

type:
∀ (b : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (c : optParam Real 0),

          GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_laplacian_nonneg._auto_1 →
        ∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            ∀ (e : Complex → Real),

                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →

                            fun w => e w)

                        ∀ (z : Complex),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                            Real.instLE.le (e z)

doc:
Master Stabilization Theorem whenever every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere equals its
`north_pole` value (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_all_jhol_eq_north_pole
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [h_sub : Subsingleton M]
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
      Exists fun th =>
        Exists fun u_stable =>
          And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
            (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
            have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
            And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
              (And
                (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                  And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                    (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                  (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
Conditional Reduction of Contract B02 to Radial Energy IVT:
Under RadialEnergyIVT, exists_calibrated_rescaling holds constructively.
Note (Conditional Reduction per COMPLETION_PLAN.md §0 & §2 P0-9):
Requires the unproved `RadialEnergyIVT` hypothesis.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.exists_calibrated_rescaling_of_ivt
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat),
          Exists fun a_n =>
            Exists fun R_n =>
              And
                (Real.instLE.le (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist a_n 0)
                  (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHAdd.hAdd n.cast 1)))
                (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 R_n)
                  (And (Real.instLE.le R_n (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHAdd.hAdd n.cast 1)))
                    (Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))
                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a_n R_n)))))) →
        GromovCompactness.Analysis.RadialEnergyIVT I →
          Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Analysis.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect)

`J_n`-holomorphic and every `J_{N₀}`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat),
        GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq N₀) u Set.univ →
            Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
            (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc:
Weak Compactness of Energy Measures for sequences of J-holomorphic curves (Contract C01).
Proved with zero direct sorry. The finiteness hypothesis `h_fin` is explicit because `totalEnergy` is
defined via `ENNReal.toReal` and so reads infinite energy as `0`; finiteness of the energy measure is
not derivable from `totalEnergy ≤ B` alone.
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.weak_energy_measure_compactness
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 B →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
      (∀ (n : Nat),
          ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq n)) Set.univ)
            ENNReal.instTop.top) →
        Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun μ_lim =>
            And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim)
              (GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
                (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ_lim)

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds.mk.sizeOf_spec
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_4} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [inst_8 : SizeOf E] [inst_9 : SizeOf H] [inst_10 : SizeOf M]
  (ε_reg : Real) (ε_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg) (C_reg : Real) (C_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
  (h_reg :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) →
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
              ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                  Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))))
  (ε_sph : Real) (ε_sph_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph) (h_sph_le_reg : Real.instLE.le ε_sph ε_reg)
  (h_sph :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))
  (ε_neck : Real) (ε_neck_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck) (C_neck : Real) (C_neck_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 C_neck)
  (a_decay : Real) (a_decay_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay)
  (h_neck :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)) ε_neck →
              ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                  Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                    Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (instHMul.hMul C_neck
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                              (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))
  (h : Real) (h_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 h) (h_le_reg : Real.instLE.le h (instHDiv.hDiv ε_reg 2))
  (h_le_sph : Real.instLE.le h ε_sph) (h_le_neck : Real.instLE.le h (instHDiv.hDiv ε_neck 2)),
  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds._sizeOf_inst I M).sizeOf
      { ε_reg := ε_reg, ε_reg_pos := ε_reg_pos, C_reg := C_reg, C_reg_pos := C_reg_pos, h_reg := h_reg, ε_sph := ε_sph,
        ε_sph_pos := ε_sph_pos, h_sph_le_reg := h_sph_le_reg, h_sph := h_sph, ε_neck := ε_neck,
        ε_neck_pos := ε_neck_pos, C_neck := C_neck, C_neck_pos := C_neck_pos, a_decay := a_decay,
        a_decay_pos := a_decay_pos, h_neck := h_neck, h := h, h_pos := h_pos, h_le_reg := h_le_reg,
        h_le_sph := h_le_sph, h_le_neck := h_le_neck })
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd ⋯ (Real._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf ε_sph))
                              ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)).sizeOf ε_sph_pos))
                            ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLE.le ε_sph ε_reg)).sizeOf h_sph_le_reg))
                          (Real._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf ε_neck))
                        ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck)).sizeOf ε_neck_pos))
                      (Real._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf C_neck))
                    ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_neck)).sizeOf C_neck_pos))
                  (Real._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf a_decay))
                ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay)).sizeOf a_decay_pos))
              (Real._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf h))
            ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLT.lt 0 h)).sizeOf h_pos))
          ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLE.le h (instHDiv.hDiv ε_reg 2))).sizeOf h_le_reg))
        ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLE.le h ε_sph)).sizeOf h_le_sph))
      ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLE.le h (instHDiv.hDiv ε_neck 2))).sizeOf h_le_neck))

type:

    ∀ {w₀ : Complex},
      Set.instMembership.mem
          (Set.ofPred fun z =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z a))
              (Real.instLT.lt (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z a) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2)))

              (GromovCompactness.disk_at w₀ (instHDiv.hDiv (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist w₀ a) 2)))

doc:
Master Stabilization Theorem for non-constant `J`-holomorphic spheres given `th : Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M`
and singleton convergence upgrade (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_thresholds_and_upgrade
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
      (∀ (pdata' : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata'.tree.V)
          (hw₀_adj : pdata'.tree.adj.Adj pdata'.root w₀),
          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
            (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata'.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata'.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
            (pdata'.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata'.tree.node_point w₀ pdata'.root ⋯))) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc: Global Epsilon-Regularity when every `J`-holomorphic sphere equals its `north_pole` value (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    Exists fun ε_reg =>
      Exists fun C_reg =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
                    ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                        Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc:
Zero-sorry Morrey-Sobolev embedding under `SatisfiesMorreySobolev` or the two-branch hypothesis
of `satisfiesMorreySobolev_of_contDiffOn` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.morrey_sobolev_embedding_of_cases
type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 2 p →
    ∀ (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        ∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
          ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            Or (Exists fun c => Eq f fun x => c)
                (Or
                  (∀ (z : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
                      ∀ (w : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                          Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHPow.hPow (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z w)
                                (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p)))
                              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))))
                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesMorreySobolev p r f)) →
              ∀ (z : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
                  ∀ (w : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                      Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.morreyGeometricConstant p))
                              (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv p (instHSub.hSub p 2))
                                (instHPow.hPow r (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p))))
                            (instHPow.hPow (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z w)
                              (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p))))
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r)))

eventually (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) 0)
          Filter.atTop →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
            (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))
