doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `epsilon_regularity` under the full 4-branch hypothesis
of `integral_translated_density_le_energyMeasure` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c η C : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 C →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (z : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun w =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                      z)) →
            (∀ (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
                    (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                      ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                        ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                    (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                            Real.instLT.lt
                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w)
                                η →
                              ∀ (z : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                  Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                      (MeasureTheory.integral
                                        (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
                                        e w))) →
              ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    Or (Exists fun c₀ => Eq u fun x => c₀)
                        (Or
                          (Eq
                            (fun w =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                            fun x => 0)
                          (And
                            (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun w =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                            (Or (Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1))
                              (∀ (w : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                                  Eq
                                    (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                      (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (instHAdd.hAdd a w)))
                                    0)))) →
                      Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) η →
                        ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                            Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))

      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →

            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);

                (And

                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast

When `cdata.S = ∅` and total energy converges along `cdata.σ` (or a sub-subsequence `cdata.σ.comp τ`),
every vertex of `P.tree` automatically equals `P.root` (`PartialRootGraftedTree.eq_root_of_empty`),
giving `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` with `0 sorryAx`.
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_empty_S
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  Eq cdata.S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection →
    Or
        (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))
        (Exists fun τ =>
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p)))) →
      Exists fun σ =>
        Exists fun res =>
          And
            (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
              (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                    Eq (frames w n)
                      ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                        (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                  ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (P.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.TreeRescalingData.mk.sizeOf_spec
type:
∀ {tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree} {root : tree.V} (parent : (w : tree.V) → Ne w root → tree.V)
  (parent_adj : ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root), tree.adj.Adj (parent w hw) w) (depth : tree.V → Nat)
  (depth_parent : ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root), instLTNat.lt (depth (parent w hw)) (depth w))
  (adj_parent_or_child :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V), tree.adj.Adj v w → Or (Exists fun hw => Eq (parent w hw) v) (Exists fun hv => Eq (parent v hv) w))
  (center : tree.V → Nat → Complex) (scale : tree.V → Nat → Real)
  (scale_pos : ∀ (w : tree.V) (n : Nat), Real.instLT.lt 0 (scale w n))
  (scale_tendsto : ∀ (w : tree.V), Ne w root → Filter.Tendsto (scale w) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (center_tendsto :
    ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (center w n)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (tree.node_point (parent w hw) w ⋯)))
  (parent_collapse :
    ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root) (h : tree.adj.Adj (parent w hw) w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree.node_point w (parent w hw) ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn
            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (center w n) (scale w n) ⋯).toHomeo)
            (fun x => tree.node_point (parent w hw) w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (child_collapse :
    ∀ (v : tree.V) (hv : Ne v root) (h : tree.adj.Adj v (parent v hv)) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree.node_point (parent v hv) v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn
            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (center v n) (scale v n) ⋯).inv.toHomeo)
            (fun x => tree.node_point v (parent v hv) h) Filter.atTop K),
  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.Assembly.TreeRescalingData._sizeOf_inst tree root).sizeOf
      { parent := parent, parent_adj := parent_adj, depth := depth, depth_parent := depth_parent,
        adj_parent_or_child := adj_parent_or_child, center := center, scale := scale, scale_pos := scale_pos,
        scale_tendsto := scale_tendsto, center_tendsto := center_tendsto, parent_collapse := parent_collapse,
        child_collapse := child_collapse })
    1

doc:
Target Monotonicity Formula when `r^2 ≤ energyMeasure I u (u ⁻¹' (Metric.ball x r))` holds
globally for non-constant `J`-holomorphic spheres exiting `Metric.ball x r` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_global_r_sq_le_energy
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Real.instLE.le r 1 →
          Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow r 2)
                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
    Exists fun c =>
      Exists fun r₀ =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 c)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                        (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))))

doc:
Target Monotonicity Formula on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` (`0 sorryAx`):
since `CP1` is connected, every `J`-holomorphic sphere `u : CP1 → M` into a discrete target is
constant, so the non-constancy hypothesis is vacuously false.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_discrete
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M],
  Exists fun c =>
    Exists fun r₀ =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 c)
        (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀)
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
              Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
                Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                      (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                        Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))))

type:

                (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
              GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I

doc:
Elliptic Bootstrap Step for Cauchy-Riemann Kernel (Holomorphic Curves).
When $\bar\partial f = 0$ on the larger disk $D_R$, the $(k+1)$-th Sobolev norm on the smaller disk
$D_r$ is bounded directly by a constant multiple of the $W^{k, p}$ norm.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.elliptic_bootstrap_wkp_of_dbar_zero
type:
(∀ (p : Real),
    Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
      ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →
          Exists fun C =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
                    (instHMul.hMul C
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)
                          (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 0 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R)))))) →
  ∀ (p : Real),
    Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
      ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →
          Exists fun C =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  Eq
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)
                        (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                      0 →
                    Real.instLE.le
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
                      (instHMul.hMul C (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k f (Metric.closedBall 0 R))))

doc:
On any disk `ball a r ⊂ ℂ` with `0 < r`, the unweighted chart energy integral weighted by the
minimum spherical Jacobian `(2 / (1 + (‖a‖ + r)^2))^2` is bounded above by `energyMeasure I u (disk_at a r)` (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.mul_integral_translated_density_le_energyMeasure
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
  (Continuous fun w => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) →
    Real.instLE.le
      (instHMul.hMul
        (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv 2 (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd (Complex.instNorm.norm a) r) 2)))
          2)
        (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
          GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
            (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (instHAdd.hAdd a w))))
      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm_le_of_bound
type:
∀ {α K : Real} {f : Complex → Complex} {s : Set Complex},
  Real.instLE.le 0 K →
    (∀ (z : Complex),
        Set.instMembership.mem s z →
          ∀ (w : Complex),
            Set.instMembership.mem s w →
              Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                (instHMul.hMul K (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm α f s) K

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.fderiv_norm_sq_sub
type:
∀ (z₀ z : Complex),
  Eq (fderiv Real (fun w => instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub w z₀)) 2) z)
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHSMul.hSMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe Complex.reCLM (instHSub.hSub z z₀)))
        Complex.reCLM)

doc: Zero-sorry Morrey-Sobolev embedding for constant maps `fun _ => c` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.morrey_sobolev_embedding_const
type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 2 p →
    ∀ (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        ∀ (c z : Complex),
          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
            ∀ (w : Complex),
              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub ((fun x => c) z) ((fun x => c) w)))
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (instHMul.hMul
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.morreyGeometricConstant p))
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv p (instHSub.hSub p 2)) (instHPow.hPow r (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p))))
                      (instHPow.hPow (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z w)
                        (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 1 (fun x => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 r)))

doc: Zero-sorry Genus 0 Gromov Compactness from a `CompactnessWitness` along a subsequence `σ` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_subseq_witness
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
    ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I)
      (wit : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim),
      Exists fun u_stable =>
        And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
          (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
          have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
          And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
            (And
              (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                  (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
              (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchy_pompeiu_holder_gain_of_pointwise
type:
∀ (r R α : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
              ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                ∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    ∀ (w : Complex),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                        Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul R (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 2))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (instHMul.hMul 4
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                    (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                      (instHSub.hSub 1 α))))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                  (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                            (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
            Exists fun C =>
              And (GT.gt C 0)
                (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                  ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                      (instHMul.hMul C
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                            (Metric.ball 0 R))
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))

Compatibility of $C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}$ convergence with composition by Möbius frames:
If $u_n \to u$ locally smoothly and $\phi_n \to \phi$ in $\operatorname{MoebiusFrame}$,
then $u_n \circ \phi_n \to u \circ \phi$ locally smoothly.

type:

          GE.ge n N₀ →

                        (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal p.snd))))))

its total mass on CP1 equals totalEnergy u₀ + ∑ m_p (Zero-sorry).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (m : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real),

    Eq cdata.μ
        (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
          (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))) →

        (instHAdd.hAdd

doc:
Zero-sorry local smooth compactness on `Set.univ` when every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere
is constant and `u_seq n north_pole` is eventually constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.local_smooth_compactness_univ_of_all_jhol_const_of_eventually_eq_north_pole
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        Set.instLE.le K Set.univ →
          IsCompact K →
            Exists fun C =>
              And (GT.gt C 0)
                (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
        (Exists fun N₀ => Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Eq (u_seq n GromovCompactness.north_pole) c₀) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Set.univ)
                (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_lim Set.univ)

doc:
Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` when
`thresh.h ≤ m_defect` and at least one term `u_seq n₀` is `J`-holomorphic (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_ge_h_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        ∀ (η : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
            Exists fun R₀ =>
              And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                (∀ (R : Real),
                  GE.ge R R₀ →
                    Exists fun δ₀ =>
                      And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                        (∀ (δ : Real),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                            Exists fun N =>
                              ∀ (n : Nat),
                                GE.ge n N →
                                  And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                    (And
                                      (Real.instLT.lt
                                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                        η)
                                      (Real.instLT.lt
                                        (Metric.diam
                                          (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                        η))))

doc:
Inductive Schauder Bootstrap Step (Contract A05).
Boosts regularity from $C^{k,\alpha}$ to $C^{k+1,\alpha}$ on concentric disks under the Cauchy-Riemann operator.
Proved with ZERO `sorry` (`0 sorryAx`) via reduction to Contract A04.

                ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder k α r R f →
                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                      (instHMul.hMul C
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm k α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                            (Metric.ball 0 R))
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm k α f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (Exists fun N₀ =>
        ∀ (n : Nat),
          GE.ge n N₀ →
            ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
              And (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) 0)
                (Eq (Metric.diam (Set.image (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂))) 0)) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                  (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                η)
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (Metric.diam
                                  (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                η)))

  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)

              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →

                (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))) →

doc:
The Bochner differential inequality holds unconditionally at any point `w` where the 2D Laplacian
of the chart energy density is non-negative (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_laplacian_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (w : Complex),
        Real.instLE.le 0
            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
              (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
              w) →
          Real.instLE.le
            (instHSub.hSub
              (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                (instHPow.hPow
                  (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) 2))
              (instHMul.hMul c
                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
              (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z)) w)

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq)
  (w₀ : pdata.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        IsOpen Ω →
          Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))

                  Filter.atTop →

                    Filter.atTop →
                  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I

                      Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))

doc:
If a local chart representation `v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → E` is $C^{k+1}$ on an open set
`U ⊆ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)` and maps `U` into `(extChartAt I x₀).target`, then the nonlinear
Cauchy–Riemann operator `x ↦ fderiv ℝ v x (J_CP1 w) - J_chart I ClosedTameTarget.J x₀ (v x) (fderiv ℝ v x w)`
is $C^k$ on `U` for every direction `w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)`, and all its iterated derivatives
of order `r ≤ k` are bounded on every compact `K ⊆ U` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.contDiffOn_chart_cauchyRiemann_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (x₀ : M) {k : Nat} {U : Set (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2))},
  IsOpen U →
    ∀ {v : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2) → E},
      ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k 1).cast v U →
        Set.MapsTo v U (extChartAt I x₀).target →
          ∀ (w : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)),
            And
              (ContDiffOn Real k.cast
                (fun x =>
                  instHSub.hSub
                    (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real v x)
                      (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe GromovCompactness.J_CP1 w))
                    (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (GromovCompactness.J_chart I inst_7.J x₀ (v x))
                      (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real v x) w)))
                U)
              (∀ (r : Nat),
                instLENat.le r k →
                  ∀ (K : Set (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2))),
                    IsCompact K →
                      Set.instLE.le K U →
                        Exists fun C =>
                          ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)),
                            Set.instMembership.mem K x →
                              Real.instLE.le
                                (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                                  (iteratedFDeriv Real r
                                    (fun y =>
                                      instHSub.hSub
                                        (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real v y)
                                          (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe GromovCompactness.J_CP1 w))
                                        (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (GromovCompactness.J_chart I inst_7.J x₀ (v y))
                                          (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real v y) w)))
                                    x))
                                C)

doc:
Subharmonic quadratic mean-value bound when the sharp Laplacian lower bound
`-16 * (b + c + 1) * (e z₀)^2 ≤ laplacian2D e w` holds on `closedBall z₀ t` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_laplacian_lb_sixteen
type:
∀ (r b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
              ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                  ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                      Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                        (∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                              Real.instLE.le
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (-16) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w)) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                              (MeasureTheory.integral
                                (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                              (instHDiv.hDiv
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                      (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                  (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                8))

doc:
Smooth ($C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}(U)$) Arzelà–Ascoli subsequence extraction on an open set `U ⊆ E`
from `qinz1yang/differential-geometry` (`SmoothMap.lean`), proved with `0 sorryAx`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.exists_cInf_subseq_on
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] [FiniteDimensional Real E]
  [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace Real F] [FiniteDimensional Real F] {U : Set E},
  IsOpen U →
    ∀ (Φ : Nat → E → F),
      (∀ (k : Nat), ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) (Φ k) U) →
        (∀ (r : Nat) (K : Set E),
            IsCompact K →
              Set.instLE.le K U →
                Exists fun M =>
                  ∀ (k : Nat) (x : E),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K x →
                      Real.instLE.le (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm (iteratedFDeriv Real r (Φ k) x)) M) →
          Exists fun φ =>
            Exists fun Φinf =>
              And (StrictMono φ)
                (And (ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) Φinf U)
                  (∀ (r : Nat) (K : Set E),
                    IsCompact K →
                      Set.instLE.le K U →
                        TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k => iteratedFDeriv Real r (Φ (φ k))) (iteratedFDeriv Real r Φinf)
                          Filter.atTop K))

doc:
Global Bochner differential inequality when every `J`-holomorphic sphere has non-negative
directional second derivatives of its stereographic chart energy density along `1` and `I` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_global_directional_second_deriv_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        ∀ (w : Complex),
          And
            (Real.instLE.le 0
              (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                  (fun ζ =>
                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                  w)
                (Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 1 Matrix.vecEmpty))))
            (Real.instLE.le 0
              (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                  (fun ζ =>
                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                  w)
                (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I Matrix.vecEmpty))))) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)))

name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.LocalDefectTree.mk.injEq
type:

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M}
  {m_defect : Real} {base_val : M} (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root : tree.V)
  (map : tree.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol : ∀ (v : tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj v w), Eq (map v (tree.node_point v w h)) (map w (tree.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (root_attach : Eq (map root GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
  (root_north_pole_free :
    ∀ (w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj root w), Ne (tree.node_point root w h) GromovCompactness.north_pole)
  (energy_sum :
    Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect → Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (map v)) m_defect)
  (stable :
    Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
      ∀ (v : tree.V),
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map v z) c) →
          ite (Eq v root) (instLENat.le 2 (tree.adj.degree v)) (instLENat.le 3 (tree.adj.degree v)))
  (tree_1 : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root_1 : tree_1.V) (map_1 : tree_1.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol_1 : ∀ (v : tree_1.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map_1 v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match_1 :
    ∀ (v w : tree_1.V) (h : tree_1.adj.Adj v w),
      Eq (map_1 v (tree_1.node_point v w h)) (map_1 w (tree_1.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (root_attach_1 : Eq (map_1 root_1 GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
  (root_north_pole_free_1 :
    ∀ (w : tree_1.V) (h : tree_1.adj.Adj root_1 w), Ne (tree_1.node_point root_1 w h) GromovCompactness.north_pole)
  (energy_sum_1 :
    Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect → Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (map_1 v)) m_defect)
  (stable_1 :
    Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
      ∀ (v : tree_1.V),
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map_1 v z) c) →
          ite (Eq v root_1) (instLENat.le 2 (tree_1.adj.degree v)) (instLENat.le 3 (tree_1.adj.degree v))),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { tree := tree, root := root, map := map, is_jhol := is_jhol, nodal_match := nodal_match,
        root_attach := root_attach, root_north_pole_free := root_north_pole_free, energy_sum := energy_sum,
        stable := stable }
      { tree := tree_1, root := root_1, map := map_1, is_jhol := is_jhol_1, nodal_match := nodal_match_1,
        root_attach := root_attach_1, root_north_pole_free := root_north_pole_free_1, energy_sum := energy_sum_1,

doc: Morrey-Sobolev Embedding in 2D (Contract A04, auxiliary Sobolev formulation).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.morrey_sobolev_embedding
type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 2 p →
    ∀ (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Exists fun C =>
          Exists fun α =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
              (And (Eq α (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p)))
                (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 α)
                  (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                    ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                      ∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
                          ∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                              Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z w) α))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))))))

doc:
Auxiliary induction lemma on tree vertex cardinality given degree-1 root pruning and non-vanishing
subsequence energy (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_aux
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
      Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
          Exists fun pdata' =>
            And (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V) 1) (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V))
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))) →
    (∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        Not (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))) →
      ∀ (k : Nat) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
        instLENat.le (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V) k →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
              (Exists fun σ =>
                Exists fun frames =>
                  And
                    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (u_lim.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instLE.le K
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                          IsCompact K →
                            TendstoUniformlyOn
                              (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                              (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:
Existence of calibrated moving centers and radii (Contract B02).
Under energy concentration at `0` with defect mass `m_defect`, the Intermediate Value
Theorem (`RadialEnergyIVT`) yields calibrated moving centers and scaling radii.
Note (Conditional Reduction per COMPLETION_PLAN.md §0 & §2 P0-9):
Formulated as a conditional reduction theorem requiring the radial IVT hypothesis; does not count
as closing Contract B02 unconditionally until the radial IVT is proved.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.exists_calibrated_rescaling
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat),
          Exists fun a_n =>
            Exists fun R_n =>
              And
                (Real.instLE.le (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist a_n 0)
                  (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHAdd.hAdd n.cast 1)))
                (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 R_n)
                  (And (Real.instLE.le R_n (instHDiv.hDiv 1 (instHAdd.hAdd n.cast 1)))
                    (Real.instLE.le (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))
                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a_n R_n)))))) →
        GromovCompactness.Analysis.RadialEnergyIVT I →
          Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Analysis.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect)

doc:
For any holomorphic map on `ball 0 R` continuous on `closure (ball 0 R)` (`DiffContOnCl ℂ f (ball 0 R)`),
Mathlib's Cauchy integral formula (`DiffContOnCl.two_pi_i_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul`)
yields the exact Cauchy–Pompeiu near/far decomposition with `I_near = 0` and `I_far = 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchy_pompeiu_near_far_decomp_of_diffContOnCl
type:
∀ {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
            DiffContOnCl Complex f (Metric.ball 0 R) →
              ∀ {z w : Complex},
                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                    Exists fun I_near =>
                      Exists fun I_far =>
                        And
                          (Eq (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w))
                            (instHSub.hSub
                              (instHSub.hSub
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (Complex.instInv.inv
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                                  (circleIntegral
                                    (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) (f ζ)) 0 R))
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (Complex.instInv.inv
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                                  (circleIntegral
                                    (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ w)) (f ζ)) 0 R)))
                              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (Complex.ofReal Real.pi))
                                (instHAdd.hAdd I_near I_far))))
                          (And
                            (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_near)
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                    (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                                (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w))))
                            (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_far)
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (instHDiv.hDiv
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                        (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                                    (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                                  (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))

doc:
**Universal Component Count Bounds (Contract G04 & Theorem 1)**.
For any stable sphere tree limit of total energy $\le B$:
1. $P \cdot h \le B$, so $P \le \lfloor B / h \rfloor$.
2. If $|V| > 1$, then $G \le P - 2$ and $|V| \le 2P - 2$.
3. Universally across all configurations (including single curves $|V| = 1$), the safe integer bound
   $$(|V| : \mathbb{Z}) \le \max(1, 2\lfloor B / h \rfloor - 2)$$
   holds without natural subtraction truncation artifacts.
name: GromovCompactness.Topology.component_count_bounds
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (B : Real),
  Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B →
    have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
    have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
    And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
      (And
        (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
          And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
            (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
        (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
          (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2))))

Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `neck_vanishing_quantified` under the 4-branch hypothesis of
`neck_annular_energy_and_diam_eventually_small` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    Or (Exists fun N₀ => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Exists fun c => Eq (u_seq n) fun x => c)
        (Or
          (Exists fun N₀ =>
            ∀ (n : Nat),
              GE.ge n N₀ →
                ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                  And (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) 0)
                    (Eq (Metric.diam (Set.image (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂))) 0))
          (Or
            (Exists fun N₀ =>
              ∀ (n : Nat),
                GE.ge n N₀ →
                  ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                    And
                      (Real.instLT.lt
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) η)
                      (Exists fun x =>
                        ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂) z →
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x (instHDiv.hDiv η 3)) (u_seq n z)))
            (Exists fun N₀ =>
              ∀ (n : Nat),
                GE.ge n N₀ →
                  ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                    And
                      (Real.instLT.lt
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) η)
                      (Real.instLT.lt (Metric.diam (Set.image (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂))) η)))) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                              (And
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                  η)
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (Metric.diam
                                    (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                  η))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.local_smooth_compactness_of_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  IsOpen Ω →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Ω) →
      (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),

            IsCompact K →
              Exists fun C =>
                And (GT.gt C 0)

continuous at `x₀`, then `HasFDerivAt g (g' x₀) x₀` (`0 sorryAx`).

              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f
                (instHAdd.hAdd z
                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
              (instHSub.hSub
                (instHAdd.hAdd z
                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
                z))))
        (Complex.instNorm.norm
          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f
            (instHAdd.hAdd z
              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))))

doc:
By continuity on `closedBall 0 R` and density of `ball 0 R` in `closedBall 0 R`,
`‖f ζ‖ ≤ supNormOn f (ball 0 R)` holds on the entire closed ball `closedBall 0 R` (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.norm_le_supNormOn_closedBall_of_continuousOn
type:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 R →
    ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
      ∀ {ζ : Complex},
        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 R) ζ →
          Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (f ζ)) (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))

doc:
If `riemannianEnergyDensity I u` is continuous on `CP1`, then its pullback along `stereo_chart.symm`
is bounded above on `ℂ` by compactness of `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bddAbove_chart_density_of_continuous
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  Continuous (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u) →

name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.prunedSimpleGraph_connected

doc:
Pruning operation: removing a degree-1 constant root vertex and promoting its child to root
when the rescaled sequence at the child is eventually constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.prune_degree_one_root_of_eventually_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      (∀ (w₀ : pdata.tree.V),
          pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀ →
            Exists fun N₀ =>
              Exists fun c =>
                And
                  (∀ (n : Nat),
                    GE.ge n N₀ →
                      ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Eq
                          (Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo)
                            z)
                          c)
                  (Eq (pdata.map w₀) fun x => c)) →
        Exists fun pdata' =>
          And (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V) 1) (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V))
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))

doc:
Dyadic decay from Widman hole-filling (`0 sorryAx`, ported from `qinz1yang/differential-geometry`):
For any antitone sequence `e : ℕ → ℝ` with `e 0 ≤ Λ` satisfying `e (j + 1) ≤ K * (e j - e (j + 1))`
whenever `e j - e (j + 1) < ε₀`, there exists `N` depending only on `(ε₀, K, Λ)` such that
`e (N + k) ≤ (K / (1 + K)) ^ k * ε₀`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.dyadic_decay_of_hole_filling
type:
∀ {ε₀ K Λ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε₀ →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 K →
      Real.instLE.le 0 Λ →
        Exists fun N =>
          ∀ (e : Nat → Real),
            Antitone e →
              (∀ (k : Nat), Real.instLE.le 0 (e k)) →
                Real.instLE.le (e 0) Λ →
                  (∀ (j : Nat),
                      Real.instLT.lt (instHSub.hSub (e j) (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1))) ε₀ →
                        Real.instLE.le (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1))
                          (instHMul.hMul K (instHSub.hSub (e j) (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1))))) →
                    ∀ (k : Nat),
                      Real.instLE.le (e (instHAdd.hAdd N k))
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv K (instHAdd.hAdd 1 K)) k) ε₀)

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_4} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (ε_reg : Real) (ε_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg) (C_reg : Real)
  (C_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
  (h_reg :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) →
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
              ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                  Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))))
  (ε_sph : Real) (ε_sph_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph) (h_sph_le_reg : Real.instLE.le ε_sph ε_reg)
  (h_sph :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))
  (ε_neck : Real) (ε_neck_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck) (C_neck : Real) (C_neck_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 C_neck)
  (a_decay : Real) (a_decay_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay)
  (h_neck :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)) ε_neck →
              ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                  Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                    Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (instHMul.hMul C_neck
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                              (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))
  (h : Real) (h_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 h) (h_le_reg : Real.instLE.le h (instHDiv.hDiv ε_reg 2))
  (h_le_sph : Real.instLE.le h ε_sph) (h_le_neck : Real.instLE.le h (instHDiv.hDiv ε_neck 2)) (ε_reg_1 : Real)
  (ε_reg_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg_1) (C_reg_1 : Real) (C_reg_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg_1)
  (h_reg_1 :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) →
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg_1 →
              ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                  Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg_1 (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))))
  (ε_sph_1 : Real) (ε_sph_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph_1) (h_sph_le_reg_1 : Real.instLE.le ε_sph_1 ε_reg_1)
  (h_sph_1 :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le ε_sph_1 (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))
  (ε_neck_1 : Real) (ε_neck_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck_1) (C_neck_1 : Real)
  (C_neck_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 C_neck_1) (a_decay_1 : Real) (a_decay_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay_1)
  (h_neck_1 : ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex), ⋯) (h_1 : Real)
  (h_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 h_1), ⋯

doc: Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence on `[DiscreteTopology M]` targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                        Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

  (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) {φ : Nat → Nat},
  StrictMono φ →

doc: Subsequences converging smoothly on `Set.univ` satisfy `extract_smooth_limit_off_singular_set` with zero sorry.
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.extract_smooth_limit_off_singular_set_of_global_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  (Exists fun u₀ =>
      And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀ Set.univ)
        (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀ Set.univ)) →

        (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀
          (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Set.univ (Finset.instSetLike.coe S)))

name: GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended_comp
type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
  Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (Function.comp u (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ₁.toHomeo)))
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ₁.toHomeo.symm)
        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)) →
    Eq
        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I
          (Function.comp (Function.comp u (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ₁.toHomeo)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ₂.toHomeo)))
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ₂.toHomeo.symm)

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
          Real.instLT.lt B thresh.ε_sph →
            Exists fun m =>
              And
                (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
                (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
                  (And
                    (Eq cdata.μ
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                        (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem when some input map `u_seq n` has energy `< th.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_exists_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (Exists fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) th.ε_sph) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),

    (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        Set.instLE.le K Set.univ →
          IsCompact K →
            Exists fun C =>
              And (GT.gt C 0)
                (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
      ∀ (N₁ : Nat),
        (∀ (n : Nat),
            GE.ge n N₁ →
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ →
                Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c) →
          (Exists fun N₀ => Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Eq (u_seq n GromovCompactness.north_pole) c₀) →
            Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun u_lim =>
