doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `sphere_energy_gap` when `riemannianEnergyDensity I u` is
bounded above and there is a pair of points at distance `≥ 2 * r₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_bddAbove_density_and_pair_dist_ge
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              BddAbove (Set.range (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u)) →
                (Exists fun z₁ => Exists fun z₂ => Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (inst_3.dist (u z₁) (u z₂))) →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r₀ 2)) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

doc:
Global `sphere_energy_gap` given target monotonicity `h_mono` and the 6-branch Darboux-ball exit
hypothesis for all non-constant `J`-holomorphic spheres (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_global_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                ∀ (x : M),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                    And
                      (Or
                        (BddAbove
                          (Set.range fun w =>
                            GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))
                        (Or (BddAbove (Set.range (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u)))
                          (Continuous (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u))))
                      (Or (Exists fun z => Real.instLE.le r₀ (inst_3.dist (u z) x))
                        (Or
                          (Exists fun z₁ =>
                            Exists fun z₂ => Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (inst_3.dist (u z₁) (u z₂)))
                          (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (Metric.diam (Set.range u)))))) →
          Exists fun ε_sph =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm_one_le_of_fderiv_one_and_cauchyRiemann
type:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {s : Set Complex} {α M₀ H₀ M₁ M₂ K₁ K₂ : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 M₁ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 M₂ →
      Real.instLE.le 0 K₁ →
        Real.instLE.le 0 K₂ →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f s) M₀ →
            Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm α f s) H₀ →
              (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem s z →
                    Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1)) M₁) →
                (∀ (z : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem s z →
                      Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f z)) M₂) →
                  (∀ (z : Complex),
                      Set.instMembership.mem s z →
                        ∀ (w : Complex),
                          Set.instMembership.mem s w →
                            Real.instLE.le
                              (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1)
                                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f w) 1)))
                              (instHMul.hMul K₁ (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                    (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem s z →
                          ∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem s w →
                              Real.instLE.le
                                (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                  (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f z)
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f w)))
                                (instHMul.hMul K₂ (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 1 α f s)
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd M₀ H₀) (instHMul.hMul 2 M₁))
                              (instHMul.hMul 2 M₂))
                            (instHMul.hMul 2 K₁))
                          (instHMul.hMul 2 K₂))

doc:
Smooth removal of singularities under any of the 6 verified extension cases whenever every
globally weak `J`-holomorphic sphere on `CP1` is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.removal_of_singularities_of_all_weak_const_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [T2Space M],
  (∀ (v : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I v Set.univ → Exists fun c => Eq v fun x => c) →
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
        Ne
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
              (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
            ENNReal.instTop.top →
          Or
              (Exists fun c =>
                Set.EqOn (fun x => c) u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
              (Or (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ)
                (Or (GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u Set.univ)
                  (Or
                    (Exists fun u_ext =>
                      And (ContMDiffOn GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I 1 u_ext Set.univ)
                        (And (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
                          (Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u_ext p) 0)))
                    (Or
                      (Exists fun u_ext =>
                        And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_ext Set.univ)
                          (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))))
                      (Exists fun u_ext =>
                        And (GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u_ext Set.univ)
                          (Set.EqOn u_ext u
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))))))) →
            ExistsUnique fun u_smooth =>
              And (Set.EqOn u_smooth u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
                (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_smooth Set.univ)

doc:
Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence whenever every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere
is constant and `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` is eventually `J`-holomorphic (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_eventually_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat),
      GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
          Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
      ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
          ∀ (a : Complex),
            Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
              ∀ (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                      (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                    Exists fun m_p =>
                      And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                        (Filter.Tendsto
                          (fun n =>
                            GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                          Filter.atTop
                          (nhds
                            (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                              (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc:
Pruning operation: removing a degree-1 constant root vertex and promoting its child to root
(`0 sorryAx` conditional reduction from `prunedSimpleGraph_isTree`, `prunedSimpleGraph_degree_eq_of_ne`,
`card_subtype_ne_root_add_one`, and `sum_subtype_ne_root_eq_sum_univ_of_zero`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.prune_degree_one_root_of_upgrade
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      (∀ (w₀ : pdata.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
          Or
            (Exists fun c =>
              And
                (Eq
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                  fun x x_1 => c)
                (Eq (pdata.map w₀) fun x => c))
            (Or
              (Exists fun N₀ =>
                Exists fun c =>
                  And
                    (∀ (n : Nat),
                      GE.ge n N₀ →
                        ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                          Eq
                            (Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo)
                              z)
                            c)
                    (Eq (pdata.map w₀) fun x => c))
              (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                (pdata.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))))) →
        Exists fun pdata' =>
          And (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V) 1) (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V))
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `assemble_prestable_limit` from concentration data (`cdata`),
defect measure decomposition (`m_defect`), local defect trees (`defect_trees`), and grafted tree rescaling (`h_extract`) (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.assemble_prestable_limit_of_components
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
    ∀ (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
      (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real),
      (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le th.ε_sph (m_defect p)) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))) →
          ∀
            (defect_trees :
              (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) →
                SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
                  GromovCompactness.Bubbling.LocalDefectTree I th (m_defect p) (cdata.u₀ p)),
            (∀ (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
                Exists fun σ =>
                  Exists fun res =>
                    And
                      (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                        (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                          (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                              Eq (frames w n)
                                ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                                  (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                            And
                              (∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                                  (fun n =>
                                    Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                                  (P.map v)
                                  (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                                    (Set.ofPred fun z =>
                                      Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
                              (Eq (P.tree.adj.degree P.root) 1 →
                                (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (P.map P.root z) c) →
                                  ∀ (w₀ : P.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : P.tree.adj.Adj P.root w₀),
                                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                                      (fun n =>
                                        Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                                      (P.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (P.tree.node_point w₀ P.root ⋯))))
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀)
                            (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))) →
              Exists fun pdata =>
                Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)) B

doc:
Inductive Sobolev Bootstrap Step (Contract A05, `0 sorryAx` conditional reduction).
Boosts regularity from $W^{k, p}$ to $W^{k+1, p}$ on concentric disks under the Cauchy-Riemann operator.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.elliptic_bootstrap_wkp
type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
    ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →
        (∀ (p : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
              ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
                And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →
                  Exists fun C =>
                    And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
                      (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                        ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
                            (instHMul.hMul C
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)
                                  (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 0 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R)))))) →
          Exists fun C =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
                    (instHMul.hMul C
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)
                          (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k f (Metric.closedBall 0 R)))))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound` when `thresh.h / 2 < m_defect` and some `J`-holomorphic
term `u_seq n₀` has total energy `< thresh.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_gt_half_h_of_exists_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) thresh.ε_sph →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                        Set.instMembership.mem
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                          Set.instMembership.mem
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                              w →
                                            Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc: Local Smooth Compactness Under Gradient Bounds from Arzelà-Ascoli extraction (Zero-sorry reduction).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.local_smooth_compactness_of_arzela_ascoli
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  IsOpen Ω →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Ω) →
      (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Set.instLE.le K Ω →
            IsCompact K →
              Exists fun C =>
                And (GT.gt C 0)
                  (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
        ((∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Set.instLE.le K Ω →
                IsCompact K →
                  Exists fun C =>
                    And (GT.gt C 0)
                      (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
            Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun u_lim => GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω)
                (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_lim Ω)

doc:
Unconditional extraction of a varying-`J` stable limit when `pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ < uth.h`
eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_varying_J_stable_limit_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) uth.h)
          Filter.atTop →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
            (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
              GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v →
                Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `cylinder_localization` under any of the 5 collar
oscillation cases (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cylinder_localization_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (d₀ : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 d₀ →
    Exists fun η =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 η)
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r R : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLT.lt r R →
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Or (Real.instLE.le (instHDiv.hDiv R 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 r))
                    (Or
                      (Eq (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2))
                        Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
                      (Or
                        (Exists fun c =>
                          ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                            Set.instMembership.mem
                                (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2)) z →
                              Eq (u z) c)
                        (Or
                          (Exists fun x₀ =>
                            ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                              Set.instMembership.mem
                                  (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2)) z →
                                Real.instLE.le (inst_3.dist (u z) x₀)
                                  (instHMul.hMul 2
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R)).sqrt))
                          (Real.instLE.le
                            (Metric.diam
                              (Set.image u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2))))
                            (instHMul.hMul 4
                              (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R)).sqrt))))) →
                  Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R)) η →
                    Exists fun x₀ =>
                      ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2))
                            z →
                          Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u z) x₀) d₀)

doc:
For any map complex-differentiable on `ball 0 R`, `dbarComplex f` vanishes on `ball 0 R`, so its
$\alpha$-Hölder difference quotients on `ball 0 R` are bounded above by `0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bddAbove_holder_quotient_dbarComplex_ball_of_differentiableOn
type:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {R α : Real},
  DifferentiableOn Complex f (Metric.ball 0 R) →
    BddAbove
      (Set.ofPred fun q =>
        Exists fun z =>
          And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) z)
            (Exists fun w =>
              And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) w)
                (And (Ne z w)
                  (Eq q
                    (instHDiv.hDiv
                      (Complex.instNorm.norm
                        (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f z)
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f w)))
                      (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))))

doc: Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence when `B ≤ thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_le_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Real.instLE.le B thresh.h →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                        Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc: Cylinder Energy and Diameter Exponential Decay from decay certificate (Zero-sorry reduction).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cylinder_exponential_decay_of_certificate
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  Exists fun C₀ =>
    Exists fun a_decay =>
      Exists fun ε_neck =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C₀)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay)
            (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck)
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCylinderEnergyDecay I u center r R →
                        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))
                            ε_neck →
                          ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                            Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                              Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                                Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                                  Real.instLE.le
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHMul.hMul C₀
                                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                                          (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))))

doc: Boundedness of the $m$-th derivative $\alpha$-Hölder difference quotients on `ball 0 R` for $C^{m+1}$ maps (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bddAbove_derivHolder_quotient_ball_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ (m : Nat) {g : Complex → Complex} {R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 R →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
      Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
        ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd m.cast 1) g (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
          BddAbove
            (Set.ofPred fun q =>
              Exists fun z =>
                And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) z)
                  (Exists fun w =>
                    And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) w)
                      (And (Ne z w)
                        (Eq q
                          (instHDiv.hDiv
                            (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                              (instHSub.hSub (iteratedFDeriv Real m g z) (iteratedFDeriv Real m g w)))
                            (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))))

doc:
Whenever `m_defect < 3 * thresh.h / 2` and `energyMeasure I decomp.v (disk_at 0 1) ≤ totalEnergy I decomp.v`,
`energyMeasure I decomp.v (disk_at 0 1) = m_defect - thresh.h / 2` (`0 sorryAx`).

`totalEnergy < thresh.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
      (Exists fun N₀ =>
          ∀ (n : Nat),
            GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) thresh.ε_sph) →
        Exists fun m =>
          And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
            (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
              (Eq cdata.μ
                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                  (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) fun x => u_seq (cdata.σ.val n) GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `weak_energy_measure_compactness` given extended energy finiteness
and Prokhorov weak measure compactness (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.weak_energy_measure_compactness_of_fin_and_compactness
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 B →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
      (∀ (n : Nat),
          ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq n)) Set.univ)
            ENNReal.instTop.top) →
        (∀ (μ_seq : Nat → MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
            [∀ (n : Nat), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ_seq n)],
            (Exists fun B =>
                And (GT.gt B 0)
                  (∀ (n : Nat),
                    ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (μ_seq n) Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B))) →
              Exists fun σ =>
                Exists fun μ_lim =>
                  And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim)
                    (GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence (fun n => μ_seq (σ.val n)) μ_lim)) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun μ_lim =>
              And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim)
                (GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
                  (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ_lim)

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),

    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →

doc: Smooth convergence upgrade across a deleted node when singleton convergence holds at the node (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.upgrade_convergence_across_deleted_node_of_singleton_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata.tree.V)
  (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        IsOpen Ω →
          Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                (pdata.map w₀)
                (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
              GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                  (pdata.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯)) →
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                  (pdata.map w₀) Ω

doc:
If an equicontinuous sequence `f : ℕ → X → V` converges along a dense sequence `d : ℕ → X`,
then it converges pointwise on `X` to a continuous limit `g : X → V` and converges uniformly on
every compact subset `K : Set X` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.tendstoUniformlyOn_of_equicontinuous_of_dense
type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : PseudoMetricSpace X] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : PseudoMetricSpace V] [CompleteSpace V]
  (f : Nat → X → V),
  Equicontinuous f →
    ∀ (d : Nat → X),
      DenseRange d →
        (∀ (m : Nat), Exists fun l => Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f k (d m)) Filter.atTop (nhds l)) →
          Exists fun g => And (Continuous g) (∀ (K : Set X), IsCompact K → TendstoUniformlyOn f g Filter.atTop K)

doc:
Zero-sorry reduction of `marked_gromov_compactness` for `0`-marked curves when a subsequence `σ`
consists of non-constant maps and `totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map ≤ 0` eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.marked_gromov_compactness_zero_marks_of_subseq_nonconst_of_eventually_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M 0) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map) B) →
      ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq ((u_seq (σ.val n)).map z) c)) →
          Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) 0)
              Filter.atTop →
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              Exists fun _wit => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim) B

type:

                ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal ε₀)

doc: Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `exists_one_level_decomposition` from exterior unit-disk mass (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.exists_one_level_decomposition_of_exterior_unit_disk_mass
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (_res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (base_val : M),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => u_seq n (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (_res.a n))) Filter.atTop
          (nhds base_val) →
        ∀ (v : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ →
            ∀ (q : Finset Complex) (m_child : Complex → Real),
              (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLE.le thresh.h (m_child z)) →
                (∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q z) → Eq (m_child z) 0) →
                  Eq m_defect (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (q.sum fun z => m_child z)) →
                    Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val →
                      Eq
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v)
                              (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)))
                            ((Finset.filter (fun w => Not (Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm w) 1)) q).sum fun z =>
                              m_child z))
                          (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) →
                        Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)

type:

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),

    ∀ (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th),

    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I v_seq v_lim (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.circle_average_ge_center_of_subharmonic
type:
∀ (g : Complex → Real) {z₀ : Complex} {r t ρ : Real},
  ContDiffOn Real 2 g (Metric.ball 0 r) →
    Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
      (∀ (w : Complex),
          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
            Real.instLE.le 0 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D g w)) →
        Real.instLE.le 0 ρ →
          Real.instLE.le ρ t →
            Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) (g z₀))
              (intervalIntegral
                (fun θ =>
                  g
                    (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                (Real.instNeg.neg Real.pi) Real.pi Real.measureSpace.volume)

doc:
Exponential decay from differential inequality $F(t) \le c \cdot F'(t)$:
If $F : ℝ → ℝ$ is differentiable, $c > 0$, and $F(t) \le c \cdot F'(t)$ for all $t$,
then for any $T \le L$, $F(T) \cdot e^{-T/c} \le F(L) \cdot e^{-L/c}$.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.exp_decay_of_diff_ineq
type:
∀ {F : Real → Real},
  Differentiable Real F →
    ∀ {c : Real},
      Real.instLT.lt 0 c →

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `sphere_energy_gap`: given target monotonicity (`h_mono`)
and the Darboux-ball exit + chart energy density boundedness hypothesis (`h_cases`), every
non-constant `J`-holomorphic sphere has total energy at least `c * r₀ ^ 2` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_exit_and_bddAbove_chart_density
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              (∀ (x : M),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                    And
                      (BddAbove
                        (Set.range fun w =>
                          GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))
                      (Or (Exists fun z => Real.instLE.le r₀ (inst_3.dist (u z) x))
                        (Or
                          (Exists fun z₁ =>
                            Exists fun z₂ => Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (inst_3.dist (u z₁) (u z₂)))
                          (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (Metric.diam (Set.range u)))))) →
                Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r₀ 2)) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

doc:
The Ghost Component Bound Theorem (`gromov_compactness.pdf` Theorem 1 & Task `F06`):
In any stable sphere tree with $|V| > 1$, let $P$ be the number of non-constant components
and $G$ be the number of ghost components ($|V| = P + G$).
For unmarked curves ($k = 0$):
1. $G \le P - 2$
2. $|V| = P + G \le 2P - 2$.
In particular, the total number of components is linearly bounded by the number of non-constant components.
(For general $k$-marked curves, $G \le P + k - 2$ and $|V| \le \max(1, 2P + k - 2) \le \max(1, 2\lfloor B/h \rfloor + k - 2)$).
name: GromovCompactness.ghost_components_bound
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (P G : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card lim.tree.V) →
    Eq P (Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I lim v)) →
      Eq G (Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I lim v)) →
        And (instLENat.le G (instHSub.hSub P 2))
          (instLENat.le (Fintype.card lim.tree.V) (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 P) 2))

type:

type:

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
      ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_lim z) c) →
          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Set.univ →
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop

              Exists fun u_stable =>
                And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
                  (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
                  have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);

                        And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                          (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                      (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast

  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →

subsequences, global smooth convergence, empty singular sets, and punctured `J`-holomorphic limits (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Or (Exists fun c => ∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)
          (Or
            (Exists fun N₀ =>
              Exists fun c => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)
            (Or (Exists fun u₀ => GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀ Set.univ)
              (Or
                (And (Eq S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
                  (Exists fun u₀ =>
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀
                      (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Set.univ (Finset.instSetLike.coe S))))
                (Exists fun u₀ =>
                  And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀ Set.univ)
                    (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀
                      (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Set.univ (Finset.instSetLike.coe S))))))) →
        Exists fun u₀ =>
          And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀ Set.univ)
            (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀
              (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Set.univ (Finset.instSetLike.coe S)))

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →

          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast

Master Stabilization Theorem when `u_seq` is non-constant along a subsequence `τ` and some
term `u_seq (τ.1 n)` has energy `< th.h` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq)
  (τ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (τ.val n) z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (τ.val n)) Set.univ) →
      (Exists fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (τ.val n))) th.h) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchy_pompeiu_ckHolderNorm_zero_le
type:
∀ {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
            ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
              (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    ∀ (w : Complex),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                        Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul R (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 2))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (instHMul.hMul 4
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                    (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                      (instHSub.hSub 1 α))))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                  (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                            (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (instHAdd.hAdd 1
                        (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul R (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                          (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 2)))
                      (instHMul.hMul 4
                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                          (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))))
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                        (Metric.ball 0 R))
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) 0) →
          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And

                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

  (stable_off_root :

      Ne v root →

  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.Bubbling.PartialGraftedTree._sizeOf_inst I thresh m_defect base_val decomp s).sizeOf
      { tree := tree, root := root, map := map, is_jhol := is_jhol, nodal_match := nodal_match, root_map := root_map,
        root_nodal_points := root_nodal_points, root_degree_ge := root_degree_ge, energy_sum := energy_sum,

doc:
**Master Stabilization Theorem (Contract G02)**.
Contracting unstable ghost roots yields a fully stable sphere tree limit preserving all nodal matching,
energy conservation, and convergence conditions. Proved with zero sorry (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Exists fun u_lim =>
        And
          (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
            (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
          (Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun frames =>
              And
                (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                    (u_lim.map v)
                    (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                      (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                (And
                  (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instLE.le K
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                      IsCompact K →
                        TendstoUniformlyOn
                          (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                          (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                  (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                    (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) th.h) →

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c η C : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 C →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (z : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun w =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                      z)) →
            (∀ (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
                    (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                      ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                        ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                    (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                            Real.instLT.lt
                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w)
                                η →
                              ∀ (z : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                  Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                      (MeasureTheory.integral
                                        (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
                                        e w))) →
              ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun w =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Complex.instNorm.norm a) r) 1 →
                        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) η →
                          ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                              Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))

doc:
Whenever `0 < m_defect` and `m_defect < thresh.h`, every `LocalDefectTree` has total energy `0`
when every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.LocalDefectTree.energy_sum_eq_zero_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (m_defect : Real) (base_val : M) (T : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.LocalDefectTree I thresh m_defect base_val),
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
    Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (T.map v)) 0

doc:
Global Epsilon-Regularity when every `J`-holomorphic sphere has vanishing differential everywhere
on `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_global_mfderiv_eq_zero
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) 0) →
    Exists fun ε_reg =>
      Exists fun C_reg =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
                    ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                        Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `gromov_compactness_core` from `assemble_prestable_limit`
and `stabilize_prestable_tree` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_core_of_assemble_and_stabilize
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (Exists fun u_lim =>
      And
        (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
        (Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun frames =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                  (u_lim.map v)
                  (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                    (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
              (And
                (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  Set.instLE.le K
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                    IsCompact K →
                      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                        (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))) →
    Exists fun u_lim => Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim)

doc:
On a compact manifold `M`, any sequence of `J`-holomorphic spheres with `totalEnergy < thresh.ε_sph`
admits a constant subsequence (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.exists_const_map_subseq_of_jhol_of_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) thresh.ε_sph) →
      Exists fun σ =>
        Exists fun c₀ =>
          And (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n) GromovCompactness.north_pole) Filter.atTop (nhds c₀))
            (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) (u_seq (σ.val n) GromovCompactness.north_pole))

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.StableMapAutomorphism.mk.sizeOf_spec
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I}
  [inst_8 : SizeOf E] [inst_9 : SizeOf H] [inst_10 : SizeOf M]
  (tree_iso : GromovCompactness.Extensions.TreeAutomorphism lim.tree)
  (frame : lim.tree.V → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (curve_equiv :
    ∀ (v : lim.tree.V) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Eq (lim.map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe tree_iso.toEquiv v) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frame v).toHomeo z))
        (lim.map v z))
  (node_compat :
    ∀ (v w : lim.tree.V) (h : lim.tree.adj.Adj v w),
      Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frame v).toHomeo (lim.tree.node_point v w h))
        (lim.tree.node_point (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe tree_iso.toEquiv v) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe tree_iso.toEquiv w)
          ⋯)),
  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.Extensions.StableMapAutomorphism._sizeOf_inst I lim).sizeOf
      { tree_iso := tree_iso, frame := frame, curve_equiv := curve_equiv, node_compat := node_compat })
    (instHAdd.hAdd 1 ((GromovCompactness.Extensions.TreeAutomorphism._sizeOf_inst lim.tree).sizeOf tree_iso))
