doc:
Any `J`-holomorphic curve on `CP1` with sub-threshold annular energy satisfies the cylindrical
Grönwall energy decay estimate `SatisfiesCylinderEnergyDecay` under any of the verified decay
regimes (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.satisfiesCylinderEnergyDecay_of_jhol
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex)
  (r R : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)) 1 →
          Or (Exists fun c => Eq u fun x => c)
              (∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                  Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                    Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                      Or (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂)) 0)
                        (Or
                          (Real.instLE.le
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHMul.hMul 1
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) 1)
                                  (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) 1)))
                              (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))
                          (Or
                            (And
                              (Real.instLT.lt 0
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)))
                              (Real.instLE.le 1
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) 1)
                                  (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) 1))))
                            (And
                              (Ne (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂)) 0)
                              (And
                                (Not
                                  (Real.instLT.lt 0
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))
                                (Or
                                  (Ne
                                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))
                                    ENNReal.instTop.top)
                                  (Continuous fun w =>
                                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                      (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))) →
            GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCylinderEnergyDecay I u center r R

doc:
Specialization to dilation by factor l > 0:
the Dirichlet energy density scales by exactly l².
name: GromovCompactness.dilation_trace_scaling
type:
∀ {V : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : Module Real V] (B : V → V → Real),
  (∀ (x y z : V), Eq (B (instHAdd.hAdd x y) z) (instHAdd.hAdd (B x z) (B y z))) →
    (∀ (x y z : V), Eq (B x (instHAdd.hAdd y z)) (instHAdd.hAdd (B x y) (B x z))) →
      (∀ (c : Real) (x y : V), Eq (B (instHSMul.hSMul c x) y) (instHMul.hMul c (B x y))) →
        (∀ (c : Real) (x y : V), Eq (B x (instHSMul.hSMul c y)) (instHMul.hMul c (B x y))) →
          ∀ (T : LinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) V) (l : Real)
            (K : LinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2))),
            Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e1) (instHSMul.hSMul l GromovCompactness.e1) →
              Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e2) (instHSMul.hSMul l GromovCompactness.e2) →
                Eq
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e1))
                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e1)))
                    (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e2))
                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e2))))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow l 2)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e1)
                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e1))
                      (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e2)
                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e2))))

doc: Pruning operation when the sum of component energies is nonpositive (`0 sorryAx`).

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

        Exists fun pdata' =>

              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))

doc:
First-jet composition regularity: if `u : E → F` is $C^{k+1}$ on an open set `U ⊆ E` and
`Φ : (F × (E →L[ℝ] F)) → G` is $C^k$ on an open set `V` containing `(u, fderiv ℝ u) '' U`,
then the first-jet composition `x ↦ Φ (u x, fderiv ℝ u x)` is $C^k$ on `U`, and all its
iterated derivatives of order `r ≤ k` are bounded on every compact `K ⊆ U` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.contDiffOn_comp_firstJet_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} {G : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E]
  [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_3 : NormedSpace Real F] [inst_4 : NormedAddCommGroup G]
  [inst_5 : NormedSpace Real G] {k : Nat} {U : Set E},
  IsOpen U →
    ∀ {V : Set (Prod F (ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) E F))} {u : E → F}
      {Φ : Prod F (ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) E F) → G},
      ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k 1).cast u U →
        ContDiffOn Real k.cast Φ V →
          Set.MapsTo (fun x => { fst := u x, snd := fderiv Real u x }) U V →
            And (ContDiffOn Real k.cast (fun x => Φ { fst := u x, snd := fderiv Real u x }) U)
              (∀ (r : Nat),
                instLENat.le r k →
                  ∀ (K : Set E),
                    IsCompact K →
                      Set.instLE.le K U →
                        Exists fun C =>
                          ∀ (x : E),
                            Set.instMembership.mem K x →
                              Real.instLE.le
                                (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                                  (iteratedFDeriv Real r (fun y => Φ { fst := u y, snd := fderiv Real u y }) x))
                                C)

doc:
Unconditional weak energy measure compactness when `u_seq` admits a subsequence of constant maps

name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.weak_energy_measure_compactness_of_const_subseq_varying
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  (Exists fun σ => ∀ (n : Nat), Exists fun c => Eq (u_seq (σ.val n)) fun x => c) →
    Exists fun σ =>
      Exists fun μ_lim =>
        And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim)
          (GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
            (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ_lim)

doc:
For `k = 3`, on subsingleton targets `[Subsingleton M]`, if `MoebiusFrame` acts transitively on
the marked point triples of `MarkedStableMap I 3`, then `ModuliSpaceInClass I 3 A` is compact (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.moduli_space_in_class_compact_three_of_subsingleton_of_trans
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M]
  (A : GromovCompactness.Extensions.HomologyClass2 M),
  (∀ (u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I 3),
      Exists fun φ =>

doc: Target Monotonicity Formula when the boundary-hit energy lower bound holds globally (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_global_boundary_hit_energy
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Real.instLE.le r 1 →
          Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                ∀ (z_hit : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (frontier (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r))) z_hit →
                    Eq (inst.dist (u z_hit) x) r →
                      Or
                        (Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow r 2)
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r))))
                        (Exists fun s =>
                          And (Set.instLE.le s (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))
                            (And
                              (Ne
                                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
                                  (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))
                                ENNReal.instTop.top)
                              (Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow r 2) (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u s))))) →
    Exists fun c =>
      Exists fun r₀ =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 c)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                        (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))))

doc: Auxiliary Sobolev Cauchy-Riemann estimate from `SatisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann` (Zero-sorry reduction).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.interior_cauchy_riemann_estimate_sobolev_of_certificate
type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
    ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →
        Exists fun C =>
          And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
            (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
              ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann p k r R f →
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
                    (instHMul.hMul C
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)
                          (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 0 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.polar_radial_intervalIntegral_eq_sub
type:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {z : Complex} {ε R θ : Real},
  (∀ (r : Real),
      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.uIcc ε R) r →
        DifferentiableAt Real f
          (instHAdd.hAdd z
            (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal r) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))) →
    IntervalIntegrable
        (fun r =>
          ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
            (fderiv Real f
              (instHAdd.hAdd z
                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal r) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
            (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
        Real.measureSpace.volume ε R →
      Eq
        (intervalIntegral
          (fun r =>
            ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
              (fderiv Real f
                (instHAdd.hAdd z
                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal r) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
              (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
          ε R Real.measureSpace.volume)
        (instHSub.hSub
          (f
            (instHAdd.hAdd z
              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal R) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
          (f
            (instHAdd.hAdd z
              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ε) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `gromov_compactness_varying_J` from a `CompactnessWitness`
for `u_seq` when `uth.h` is bounded above by the sphere energy gap `ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_compactnessWitness
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
    ∀ (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (wit : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim)
      {ε_sph : Real},
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
              Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)) →
        Real.instLE.le uth.h ε_sph →
          Exists fun u_lim' =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim'.tree.V),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim'.map v) Set.univ)
              (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim'.map v)) B)
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim' v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim' v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc: Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when `totalEnergy I (u_seq n) ≤ 0` eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_eventually_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) 0) Filter.atTop →
          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →

                    Exists fun x₀ =>
                      ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2))

doc:
Subharmonic quadratic mean-value bound when `e` is superharmonic or harmonic up to `-b e(w)²`
(i.e. `∀ w ∈ closedBall z₀ t, -b * (e w)^2 ≤ laplacian2D e w`, which holds whenever `c = 0` or `e = 0`) (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_quad_subharm
type:
∀ (r b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
              ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                  ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                      Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                        (∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) w →
                              Real.instLE.le (e w) (instHMul.hMul 4 (e z₀))) →
                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                            Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                                (instHDiv.hDiv
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                        (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                    (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                  8))

doc: Unconditional `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` on `[Subsingleton M]` targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  Exists fun σ =>
    Exists fun res =>
      And
        (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),

                    (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))

doc:
From `SmoothLimits.lean`: if a sequence of smooth maps `f : ℕ → E → F` on an open set `U`
has uniform local jet bounds on compact subsets of `U` and converges pointwise on `U` to `f₀`,
then `f₀` is $C^\infty$ on `U` and for every `r : ℕ` and compact `K ⊆ U`, `iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (f k)`
converges uniformly on `K` to `iteratedFDeriv ℝ r f₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.tendstoUniformlyOn_iteratedFDeriv_of_pointwise_of_local_jet_bounds
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] [FiniteDimensional Real E]
  [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace Real F] [FiniteDimensional Real F] {U : Set E},
  IsOpen U →
    ∀ (f : Nat → E → F) (f₀ : E → F),
      (∀ (k : Nat), ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) (f k) U) →
        (∀ (r : Nat) (K : Set E),
            IsCompact K →
              Set.instLE.le K U →
                Exists fun C =>
                  ∀ (k : Nat) (x : E),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K x →
                      Real.instLE.le (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm (iteratedFDeriv Real r (f k) x)) C) →
          (∀ (x : E), Set.instMembership.mem U x → Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f k x) Filter.atTop (nhds (f₀ x))) →
            And (ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) f₀ U)
              (∀ (r : Nat) (K : Set E),
                IsCompact K →
                  Set.instLE.le K U →
                    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k => iteratedFDeriv Real r (f k)) (iteratedFDeriv Real r f₀) Filter.atTop K)

  (m_child : Complex → Real)
  (m_child_pos : ∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLE.le thresh.h (m_child z))
  (m_child_zero : ∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q z) → Eq (m_child z) 0)

  (node_match : Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
  (calibrated_unit_mass :

        ((Finset.filter (fun w => Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm w) 1) q).sum fun z => m_child z))

  (v_jhol_1 : GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v_1 Set.univ) (q_1 : Finset Complex)

  (m_child_zero_1 : ∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q_1 z) → Eq (m_child_1 z) 0)

  (node_match_1 : Eq (v_1 GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
  (calibrated_unit_mass_1 :

      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v_1 (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1))
        ((Finset.filter (fun w => Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm w) 1) q_1).sum fun z => m_child_1 z))
      (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))),
  Eq

      { v := v, v_jhol := v_jhol, q := q, m_child := m_child, m_child_pos := m_child_pos, m_child_zero := m_child_zero,
        mass_sum := mass_sum, node_match := node_match, calibrated_unit_mass := calibrated_unit_mass }
      { v := v_1, v_jhol := v_jhol_1, q := q_1, m_child := m_child_1, m_child_pos := m_child_pos_1,

      ∀ (x w₁ w₂ : Sum T₁.V T₂.V) (h₁ : (GromovCompactness.graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).Adj x w₁)
        (h₂ : (GromovCompactness.graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).Adj x w₂),
        Ne w₁ w₂ →
          Ne (GromovCompactness.graftNodePoint T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂ p₁ p₂ x w₁ h₁)
            (GromovCompactness.graftNodePoint T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂ p₁ p₂ x w₂ h₂)

doc:
Unconditional defect measure identity when `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` eventually has
`totalEnergy < thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_identity_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
      (Exists fun N₀ =>
          ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) thresh.h) →
        Exists fun m =>
          And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
            (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
              (And
                (Eq cdata.μ
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                    (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

doc:
Target Monotonicity Formula when a subset `s ⊆ u ⁻¹' (Metric.ball x r)` carries energy `≥ r^2`
globally for non-constant `J`-holomorphic spheres exiting `Metric.ball x r` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_global_subset_energy_ge
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        Real.instLE.le r 1 →
          Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                ∀ (z_hit : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (frontier (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r))) z_hit →
                    Eq (inst.dist (u z_hit) x) r →
                      Exists fun s =>
                        And (Set.instLE.le s (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))
                          (And
                            (Ne
                              (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
                                (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))
                              ENNReal.instTop.top)
                            (Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow r 2) (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u s)))) →
    Exists fun c =>
      Exists fun r₀ =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 c)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                        (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))))

doc:
Global `sphere_energy_gap` when every non-constant `J`-holomorphic sphere has continuous
energy density and diameter `> 2 * r₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_global_continuous_density_and_diam_gt
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                And (Continuous (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u))
                  (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (Metric.diam (Set.range u)))) →
          Exists fun ε_sph =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))

doc:
Local uniform gradient bound from `thresh.h_reg` and `exists_closedBall_eventually_energy_lt_eps_reg_of_notMem_S`:
on any stereographic disk `disk_at a r ⊆ closedBall p ρ` in the southern hemisphere (`Metric.ball a r ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 1`)
around `p ∉ S`, `riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq (σ.1 n))` is eventually bounded by
`thresh.C_reg * r ^ (-2 : ℝ) * thresh.ε_reg` on `disk_at a (r / 2)` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.eventually_gradient_bound_on_disk_of_notMem_S
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M) (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
      (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ]
      (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
          (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ →
        (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
            Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p)
              (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))) →
          ∀ {p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem},
            Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p) →
              ∀ {a : Complex} {r ρ : Real},
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) →
                    Set.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r) (Metric.closedBall p ρ) →
                      ∀ {ε₁ : Real},
                        Real.instLT.lt ε₁ thresh.ε_reg →
                          Real.instLT.lt 0 ε₁ →
                            Filter.Eventually
                                (fun n =>
                                  ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
                                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n)))
                                      (Metric.closedBall p ρ))
                                    (ENNReal.ofReal ε₁))
                                Filter.atTop →
                              Filter.Eventually
                                (fun n =>
                                  ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                    Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq (σ.val n)) z)
                                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul thresh.C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                          thresh.ε_reg))
                                Filter.atTop

name: GromovCompactness.lintegral_scaled_density_eq

          (MeasureTheory.lintegral measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume fun w =>

doc:
2D Solid-Ball Subharmonic Mean-Value Inequality:
If `g : ℂ → ℝ` is $C^2$ on `ball 0 r` with `closedBall z₀ t ⊆ ball 0 r`, `t ≥ 0`,
and `0 ≤ laplacian2D g` on `closedBall z₀ t`, then `π t² g(z₀) ≤ ∫_{B(z₀,t)} g`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_solid_ball_mean_value_inequality
type:
∀ (g : Complex → Real) (z₀ : Complex) {r t : Real},
  ContDiffOn Real 2 g (Metric.ball 0 r) →
    Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
      Real.instLE.le 0 t →
        (∀ (w : Complex),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
              Real.instLE.le 0 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D g w)) →
          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (g z₀))
            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => g w)

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `resolve_single_defect_tree` across sub-threshold masses
(`m_defect < thresh.h`), leaf bubbles, and one-level decompositions (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.resolve_single_defect_tree_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 m_defect →
    ∀ (base_val : M),
      Or (Real.instLT.lt m_defect thresh.h)
          (Or
            (And (Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect)
              (Exists fun v =>
                And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                  (And (Eq m_defect (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v))
                    (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                      (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1))
                        (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)))))))
            (And (Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect)
              (Exists fun decomp =>
                Or (Eq decomp.q Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
                  (∀ (z : Complex),
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem decomp.q z →
                      Nonempty
                        (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.LocalDefectTree I thresh (decomp.m_child z)
                          (decomp.v (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))))))) →
        Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.LocalDefectTree I thresh m_defect base_val)

doc:

doc:
Smoothness of the stereographic chart energy density and comparison between the Euclidean ball
integral of the chart energy density and `energyMeasure I u (disk_at a r)` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.integral_translated_density_le_energyMeasure
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
      Or (Exists fun c => Eq u fun x => c)
          (Or
            (Eq (fun w => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
              fun x => 0)
            (And
              (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun w =>
                GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
              (Or (Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1))
                (∀ (w : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                    Eq
                      (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                        (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (instHAdd.hAdd a w)))
                      0)))) →
        And
          (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun w =>
            GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
          (Real.instLE.le
            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (instHAdd.hAdd a w)))
            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))

name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.suppressed_frame_collapse
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₁ w₂ : pdata.tree.V)
  (hadj₁ : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₁) (hadj₂ : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₂)
  (v w : Subtype fun v => Ne v pdata.root)
  (h : (GromovCompactness.Assembly.suppressedSimpleGraph pdata.tree pdata.root w₁ w₂).Adj v w)
  (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  Set.instLE.le K
      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
        (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton
          (GromovCompactness.Assembly.suppressedNodePoint pdata.tree pdata.root w₁ w₂ hadj₁ hadj₂ w v ⋯))) →
    IsCompact K →
      TendstoUniformlyOn
        (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((pdata.frames v.val n).inv.comp (pdata.frames w.val n)).toHomeo)
        (fun x => GromovCompactness.Assembly.suppressedNodePoint pdata.tree pdata.root w₁ w₂ hadj₁ hadj₂ v w h)
        Filter.atTop K

doc:
Unconditional target monotonicity bound when `Metric.diam (Set.range u) < r` (`0 sorryAx`):
since `x ∈ Set.range u`, `u` cannot exit `Metric.ball x r`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_diam_range_lt
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (c r : Real),
  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
      Real.instLT.lt (Metric.diam (Set.range u)) r →
        Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))

doc:
Continuous radius power-law decay from discrete geometric scale decay (`0 sorryAx`,
ported from `qinz1yang/differential-geometry`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.radius_power_bound_of_geometric_decay
type:
∀ {E : Real → Real} {θ R q M : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 θ →
    Real.instLT.lt θ 1 →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 R →
        Real.instLE.le 0 q →
          Real.instLE.le 0 M →
            MonotoneOn E (Set.Ioc 0 R) →
              (∀ (n : Nat),
                  Real.instLE.le (E (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow θ n) R))
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHPow.hPow θ q) n) M)) →
                ∀ (r : Real),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 R) r →
                    Real.instLE.le (E r)
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv M (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul θ R) q)) (instHPow.hPow r q))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `gromov_compactness_varying_J` when a subsequence `u_seq ∘ σ.1`
converges smoothly on `CP1` to a non-constant map `u₀` with `uth.h ≤ totalEnergy I u₀ ≤ B` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_subseq_smooth_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (u₀ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀ Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u₀ z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u₀) B →
            Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u₀) →
              Exists fun u_lim' =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim'.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim'.map v) Set.univ)
                  (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim'.map v)) B)
                    (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim' v);
                    have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim' v);
                    And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                      (And
                        (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) →
                          And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                            (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                        (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim'.tree.V).cast
                          (Int.instMax.max 1
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc:
Unconditional defect measure identity when `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` eventually has
`totalEnergy < thresh.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_identity_of_eventually_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
      (Exists fun N₀ =>
          ∀ (n : Nat),
            GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) thresh.ε_sph) →
        Exists fun m =>
          And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
            (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
              (And
                (Eq cdata.μ
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                    (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `epsilon_regularity` on disks `ball a r ⊆ closedBall 0 1`
(or vanishing chart density) given the Bochner differential inequality (`h_boch`) and scalar
mean-value inequality (`h_smv`) (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_subset_closedBall_one
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c η C : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 C →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (z : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun w =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                      z)) →
            (∀ (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
                    (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                      ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                        ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                    (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                            Real.instLT.lt
                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w)
                                η →
                              ∀ (z : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                  Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                      (MeasureTheory.integral
                                        (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
                                        e w))) →
              ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    Or (Exists fun c₀ => Eq u fun x => c₀)
                        (And
                          (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun w =>
                            GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          (Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1))) →
                      Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) η →
                        ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                            Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))

  Eq ((GromovCompactness.MoebiusMatrix.affine_scaling a scale hscale).eval (OnePoint.some z))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.heinz_bound_general
type:
∀ (b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e₀ : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 e₀ →
          ∀ (ρ : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 ρ →
              ∀ (E : Real),
                Real.instLE.le 0 E →
                  (∀ (t : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                        Real.instLE.le e₀
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul (Real.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2))) E)
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                (instHPow.hPow e₀ 2))
                              (instHPow.hPow t 2)))) →
                    Real.instLT.lt E (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 2))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 ρ) 2) e₀)
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 8 Real.pi) E)

doc:
For $C^{m+2}$ maps on `closedBall 0 R` and `0 < r < R`, the $m$-th derivative $\alpha$-Hölder
difference quotients of `dbarComplex f` are bounded above on `ball 0 r` (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bddAbove_derivHolder_quotient_dbarComplex_ball_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ (m : Nat) {f : Complex → Complex} {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd m.cast 1) 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
            BddAbove
              (Set.ofPred fun q =>
                Exists fun z =>
                  And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z)
                    (Exists fun w =>
                      And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w)
                        (And (Ne z w)
                          (Eq q
                            (instHDiv.hDiv
                              (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                                (instHSub.hSub (iteratedFDeriv Real m (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) z)
                                  (iteratedFDeriv Real m (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) w)))
                              (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))))

doc:
Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence when `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` eventually has
`totalEnergy < thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`, since `cdata.S = ∅`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
      (Exists fun N₀ =>
          ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) thresh.h) →
        ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
            ∀ (a : Complex),
              Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
                ∀ (r : Real),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                    Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                        (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                      Exists fun m_p =>
                        And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                          (Filter.Tendsto
                            (fun n =>
                              GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                            Filter.atTop
                            (nhds
                              (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc:
When `reps` is eventually constant at an edgeless constant-component `BoundedMarkedStableMap`,
subsequence extraction holds with `0 sorryAx`.
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_bounded_marked_stable_subseq_of_eventually_const_edgeless
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (k : Nat) (B : Real)
  (reps : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I k B) (N₀ : Nat)
  (lim_rep : GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I k B),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Eq (reps n) lim_rep) →
    (∀ (v : lim_rep.val.tree.V), Exists fun c => Eq (lim_rep.val.map v) fun x => c) →
      (∀ (v w : lim_rep.val.tree.V), Not (lim_rep.val.tree.adj.Adj v w)) →
        Exists fun φ' =>
          And (StrictMono φ')
            (Exists fun lim_rep' =>
              Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedGromovWitness I (fun n => (reps (φ' n)).val) lim_rep'.val))

doc:
One-level decomposition extraction for an isolated defect mass `m ≥ h` across leaf bubbles
(`q = ∅`), single-child bubbles (`q = {0}`), unit-disk child configurations, and general calibrated
child configurations (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.exists_one_level_decomp
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (base_val : M),
      Or
          (Exists fun v =>
            And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
              (And (Eq m_defect (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v))
                (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                  (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1))
                    (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))))))
          (Or
            (Exists fun v =>
              And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                (And (Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (instHSub.hSub m_defect thresh.h))
                  (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                    (Eq
                      (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v)
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)))
                      (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)))))
            (Or
              (Exists fun v =>
                Exists fun q =>
                  Exists fun m_child =>
                    And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                      (And
                        (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm z) 1)
                        (And (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLE.le thresh.h (m_child z))
                          (And (∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q z) → Eq (m_child z) 0)
                            (And
                              (Eq m_defect
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (q.sum fun z => m_child z)))
                              (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                                (Eq
                                  (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v)
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)))
                                  (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))))))))
              (Exists fun v =>
                Exists fun q =>
                  Exists fun m_child =>
                    And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                      (And (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLE.le thresh.h (m_child z))
                        (And (∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q z) → Eq (m_child z) 0)
                          (And
                            (Eq m_defect (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (q.sum fun z => m_child z)))
                            (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                              (Eq
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1))
                                  ((Finset.filter (fun w => Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm w) 1) q).sum fun z =>
                                    m_child z))
                                (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)))))))))) →
        Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)

doc:
Contract B01: Equivalence between defect atom and energy concentration.
When the regular part of the limit measure is atomless (e.g. continuous energy density
of a smooth J-holomorphic curve), the defect measure has an atom of mass ≥ ε₀ at x
if and only if every metric neighborhood of x concentrates energy ≥ ε₀.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.has_energy_defect_iff_concentration
type:
∀ {X : Type u_4} [inst : MetricSpace X] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
  (μ_reg ν_defect : MeasureTheory.Measure X) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_reg]
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν_defect],
  (∀ (x : X), Eq (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ_reg (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton x)) 0) →
    ∀ (x : X) (ε₀ : Real),
      Iff
        (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal ε₀)
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe ν_defect (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton x)))
        (∀ (r : Real),
          GT.gt r 0 →
            ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal ε₀)
              (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (instHAdd.hAdd μ_reg ν_defect) (Metric.closedBall x r)))

doc:
Frame transition collapse (PDF §2.3 condition 2): for adjacent components $v \sim w$,
$$\phi_{v, n}^{-1} \circ \phi_{w, n} \longrightarrow z_{vw} \quad \text{locally uniformly on } \mathbb{CP}^1 \setminus \{z_{wv}\}.$$
name: GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness.frame_collapse
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M}
  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I} (self : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim)
  (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  Set.instLE.le K (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
    IsCompact K →
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((self.frames v n).inv.comp (self.frames w n)).toHomeo)
        (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K

doc:
Unconditional threshold-free Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when every globally `J`-holomorphic
sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_univ_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Exists fun th =>
            Exists fun u_stable =>
              And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
Extraction of the rescaled bubble curve `v : CP1 → M` and child concentration points `q ⊂ ℂ`
across leaf bubbles (`q = ∅`), single-child bubbles (`q = {0}`), unit-disk child configurations,
and general calibrated child configurations (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.extract_rescaled_bubble_and_children
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (base_val : M),
      Or
          (Exists fun v =>
            And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
              (And (Eq m_defect (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v))
                (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                  (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1))
                    (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))))))
          (Or
            (Exists fun v =>
              And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                (And (Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (instHSub.hSub m_defect thresh.h))
                  (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                    (Eq
                      (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v)
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)))
                      (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)))))
            (Or
              (Exists fun v =>
                Exists fun q =>
                  Exists fun m_child =>
                    And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                      (And
                        (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm z) 1)
                        (And (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLE.le thresh.h (m_child z))
                          (And (∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q z) → Eq (m_child z) 0)
                            (And
                              (Eq m_defect
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (q.sum fun z => m_child z)))
                              (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                                (Eq
                                  (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v)
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)))
                                  (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))))))))
              (Exists fun v =>
                Exists fun q =>
                  Exists fun m_child =>
                    And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                      (And (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLE.le thresh.h (m_child z))
                        (And (∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q z) → Eq (m_child z) 0)
                          (And
                            (Eq m_defect (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (q.sum fun z => m_child z)))
                            (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                              (Eq
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1))
                                  ((Finset.filter (fun w => Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm w) 1) q).sum fun z =>
                                    m_child z))
                                (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)))))))))) →
        Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)

doc:
Unconditional `neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound` when `thresh.h / 2 < m_defect` and some `J`-holomorphic
term `u_seq n₀` has total energy `< thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_gt_half_h_of_exists_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) thresh.h →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                        Set.instMembership.mem
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                          Set.instMembership.mem
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                              w →
                                            Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc: Smooth convergence upgrade across a deleted node when the rescaled sequence is eventually constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.upgrade_convergence_across_deleted_node_of_eventually_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata.tree.V)
  (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        IsOpen Ω →
          Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                (pdata.map w₀)
                (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
              ∀ (N₀ : Nat) (c : M),
                (∀ (n : Nat),
                    GE.ge n N₀ →
                      ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Eq
                          (Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo)
                            z)
                          c) →
                  (Eq (pdata.map w₀) fun x => c) →
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n =>
                        Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                      (pdata.map w₀) Ω

doc:
Any sequence of non-constant J-holomorphic spheres cannot have total energy tending to zero
given a positive sphere energy gap (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.not_tendsto_zero_totalEnergy_of_jhol_nonconst
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
  (Exists fun ε_sph =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
              Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
        Not (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

type:

doc: Zero-sorry interior Cauchy–Riemann Schauder estimate for constant maps `fun _ => c` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:

                        (Metric.ball 0 R))
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (fun x => c) (Metric.ball 0 R)))))

doc: Zero-sorry defect measure identity when `B ≤ 0` and `cdata.u₀` is a constant map (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_identity_of_nonpos_B_and_const_u0
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Real.instLE.le B 0 →
    (Exists fun c => Eq cdata.u₀ fun x => c) →
      Exists fun m =>
        And
          (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
          (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
            (And
              (Eq cdata.μ
                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                  (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
              (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `sphere_energy_gap` when the stereographic chart energy
density is bounded above and for every `x ∈ Set.range u` there is `z : CP1` with
`r₀ ≤ dist (u z) x` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_bddAbove_chart_density_and_exists_dist_ge
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              BddAbove
                  (Set.range fun w =>

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]

  (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) fun x => u_seq (cdata.σ.val n) GromovCompactness.north_pole) →

          (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
          (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
