doc:
Master Stabilization Theorem when `u_seq` is non-constant along a subsequence `τ` and some
term `u_seq (τ.1 n)` has energy `< th.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_subseq_nonconst_of_exists_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq)
  (τ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (τ.val n) z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (τ.val n)) Set.univ) →
      (Exists fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (τ.val n))) th.ε_sph) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:

`u_seq n₀` is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_gt_half_h_of_exists_const_term
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat) (c : M),
      (Eq (u_seq n₀) fun x => c) →
        ∀ (η : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
            Exists fun R₀ =>
              And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                (∀ (R : Real),
                  GE.ge R R₀ →
                    Exists fun δ₀ =>
                      And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                        (∀ (δ : Real),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                            Exists fun N =>
                              ∀ (n : Nat),
                                GE.ge n N →
                                  And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                    (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                      Set.instMembership.mem
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                        Set.instMembership.mem
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) w →
                                          Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.intervalIntegral_radial_deriv_nonneg_of_subharmonic
type:

  ContDiffOn Real 2 g (Metric.ball 0 r) →
    Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
      (∀ (w : Complex),
          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
            Real.instLE.le 0 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D g w)) →

                  ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                    (fderiv Real g
                      (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                        (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal s) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                    (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    Exists fun u_lim =>
      And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
        (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
          (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
          have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
          And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
            (And
              (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                  (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
              (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 B →
    ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M) (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
      (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ],
      ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B) →
        GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
            (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ →
          ∀ (u₀ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₀ Set.univ →
              (∀ (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p)
                        (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)
                          (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))) →

                (∀ (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),

                          (S.sum fun p =>

doc:
When the integral of `e` on `ball 0 r` is strictly positive, any Heinz maximizer `z₀`
lies in the open ball `ball 0 r` and satisfies `0 < e z₀`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.heinz_maximum_interior
type:
∀ (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
      (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
        Real.instLT.lt 0
            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w) →
          ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z₀ →
              (∀ (w : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                    Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm w)) 2) (e w))
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm z₀)) 2) (e z₀))) →
                And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z₀) (Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀))

doc:
Existence and properties of the finite singular concentration set S (Contract C02, Zero-sorry).
For any finite measure bounded by B, the set of atoms of mass ≥ ε_reg is finite, and its cardinality
satisfies |S| * ε_reg ≤ B and |S| ≤ B / ε_reg.
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.concentration_singular_set_properties
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) (B : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 B →
    ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M),
      ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B) →
        Exists fun S =>
          And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p)
                (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))))
            (And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul S.card.cast thresh.ε_reg) B)
              (Real.instLE.le S.card.cast (instHDiv.hDiv B thresh.ε_reg)))

doc:
For $C^2$ maps on `closedBall 0 R` and `0 < r < R`, the $\alpha$-Hölder difference quotients of
`dbarComplex f` are bounded above on `ball 0 r` (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bddAbove_holder_quotient_dbarComplex_ball_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ContDiffOn Real 2 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
            BddAbove
              (Set.ofPred fun q =>
                Exists fun z =>
                  And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z)
                    (Exists fun w =>
                      And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w)
                        (And (Ne z w)
                          (Eq q
                            (instHDiv.hDiv
                              (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f z)
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f w)))
                              (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))))

doc:
**Contract A04a (Interior Cauchy–Riemann Schauder Estimate in $C^{k,\alpha}$)**:
On concentric disks $D_r \subset D_R \subset \mathbb{C}$ ($0 < r < R$) and for $\alpha \in (0, 1)$,
the $C^{k+1,\alpha}$ Hölder norm of a $C^{k+1}$ map $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ on $D_r$ satisfying
the Schauder regularity certificate `SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder k α r R f` is controlled
by the $C^{k,\alpha}$ norm of $\bar{\partial} f$ on $D_R$ together with the $C^0$ norm of $f$ on $D_R$:
$$\|f\|_{C^{k+1,\alpha}(D_r)} \le C \left(\|\bar{\partial} f\|_{C^{k,\alpha}(D_R)} + \|f\|_{C^0(D_R)}\right).$$
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.interior_cauchy_riemann_estimate
type:
∀ (k : Nat) (α r R : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          Exists fun C =>
            And (GT.gt C 0)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder k α r R f →
                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                      (instHMul.hMul C
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm k α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                            (Metric.ball 0 R))
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))

doc:
If `u` maps a domain `s ⊆ CP1` into a target ball `Metric.ball x (η / 3)` for `η > 0`,
then `Metric.diam (Set.image u s) < η` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.diam_image_lt_of_mapsTo_ball
type:
∀ {M : Type u_3} [inst : MetricSpace M] [CompactSpace M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (s : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) (x : M) (η : Real),

Unconditional Vanishing Neck Energy and Target Diameter on subsingleton targets (`0 sorryAx`):
when `[Subsingleton M]` holds, every `u_seq n` equals `fun _ => u_seq n north_pole`, so its
annular energy and neck diameter vanish identically.
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    Exists fun R₀ =>
      And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
        (∀ (R : Real),
          GE.ge R R₀ →
            Exists fun δ₀ =>
              And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                (∀ (δ : Real),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                    Exists fun N =>
                      ∀ (n : Nat),
                        GE.ge n N →
                          And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                            (And
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                  (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                η)
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (Metric.diam
                                  (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                η))))

doc:
Global Epsilon-Regularity when the 4-branch hypothesis of `integral_translated_density_le_energyMeasure`
holds for every `J`-holomorphic sphere (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_global_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c η C : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 C →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (z : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun w =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                      z)) →
            (∀ (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
                    (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                      ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                        ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                    (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                            Real.instLT.lt
                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w)
                                η →
                              ∀ (z : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                  Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                      (MeasureTheory.integral
                                        (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
                                        e w))) →
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Or (Exists fun c₀ => Eq u fun x => c₀)
                        (Or
                          (Eq
                            (fun w =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                            fun x => 0)
                          (And
                            (ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun w =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                            (Or (Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1))
                              (∀ (w : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                                  Eq
                                    (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                      (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (instHAdd.hAdd a w)))
                                    0))))) →
                Exists fun ε_reg =>
                  Exists fun C_reg =>
                    And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
                      (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
                        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
                          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                              Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                                  ε_reg →
                                ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                  Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.polar_radial_angular_cauchyRiemann_identity
type:
∀ (f : Complex → Complex) (z : Complex) {ρ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ρ →
    ∀ (θ : Real),
      have ζ :=
        instHAdd.hAdd z (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))));

              (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
            (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv Complex.I (Complex.ofReal ρ))
              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f ζ)
                (instHMul.hMul Complex.I
                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))))))

type:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {z : Complex} {ρ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ρ →
    (∀ (θ : Real),
        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.uIcc 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)) θ →
          DifferentiableAt Real f
            (instHAdd.hAdd z
              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))) →
      IntervalIntegrable
          (fun θ =>
            ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
              (fderiv Real f
                (instHAdd.hAdd z
                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
              (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
          Real.measureSpace.volume 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) →
        IntervalIntegrable
            (fun θ =>
              ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                (fderiv Real f
                  (instHAdd.hAdd z
                    (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                (instHMul.hMul Complex.I
                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
            Real.measureSpace.volume 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) →
          Eq
            (intervalIntegral
              (fun θ =>
                instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f
                      (instHAdd.hAdd z
                        (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHAdd.hAdd z
                        (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
                      z)))
              0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) Real.measureSpace.volume)
            (instHMul.hMul (1 / 2)
              (intervalIntegral
                (fun θ =>
                  ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                    (fderiv Real f
                      (instHAdd.hAdd z
                        (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem whenever every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:
Global Weitzenböck curvature bound when every `J`-holomorphic sphere has non-negative
directional second derivatives of its stereographic chart energy density along `1` and `I` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_term_bound_of_global_directional_second_deriv_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        ∀ (w : Complex),
          And
            (Real.instLE.le 0
              (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                  (fun ζ =>
                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                  w)
                (Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 1 Matrix.vecEmpty))))
            (Real.instLE.le 0
              (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                  (fun ζ =>
                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                  w)
                (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I Matrix.vecEmpty))))) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Exists fun hessNorm =>
                    Exists fun curvTerm =>
                      And
                        (Eq
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                            (fun z =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                            w)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                        (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul b
                              (instHPow.hPow
                                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                2))
                            (instHMul.hMul c
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))

doc:
Smooth convergence upgrade across a deleted node whenever every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere
is constant and `u_seq (pdata.σ.1 n)` is eventually `J`-holomorphic (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.upgrade_convergence_across_deleted_node_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq)
  (w₀ : pdata.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        IsOpen Ω →
          Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                (pdata.map w₀)
                (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
              Filter.Eventually
                  (fun n => GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) Set.univ)
                  Filter.atTop →
                (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),

doc:
Every `J`-holomorphic curve on `CP1` satisfies the cylindrical collar oscillation bound
`SatisfiesCylinderCollarOscillation` when the inner collar is empty, constant, contained in a
target ball of radius `2 * √E(u; A(r, R))`, or has diameter bounded by `4 * √E(u; A(r, R))` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.satisfiesCylinderCollarOscillation_of_jhol
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r R : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Or (Real.instLE.le (instHDiv.hDiv R 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 r))
            (Or
              (Eq (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2))
                Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
              (Or
                (Exists fun c =>
                  ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2)) z →
                      Eq (u z) c)
                (Or
                  (Exists fun x₀ =>
                    ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2))
                          z →
                        Real.instLE.le (inst_3.dist (u z) x₀)
                          (instHMul.hMul 2
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R)).sqrt))
                  (Real.instLE.le
                    (Metric.diam (Set.image u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2))))
                    (instHMul.hMul 4
                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R)).sqrt))))) →
          GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCylinderCollarOscillation I u a r R

doc:
Master Stabilization Theorem whenever `u_seq n` is eventually `J`-holomorphic and every globally
`J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_eventually_jhol_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    ∀ (N₀ : Nat),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
              (Exists fun σ =>
                Exists fun frames =>
                  And
                    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (u_lim.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instLE.le K
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                          IsCompact K →
                            TendstoUniformlyOn
                              (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                              (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Real.instLE.le B 0 →
    (Exists fun c => Eq cdata.u₀ fun x => c) →
      ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
          ∀ (a : Complex),
            Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
          (Exists fun h_s =>
              And (GT.gt h_s 0)
                (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                      GE.ge (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) h_s)) →
            (∀ (pdata' : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata'.tree.V)
                (hw₀_adj : pdata'.tree.adj.Adj pdata'.root w₀),
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n =>
                    Function.comp (u_seq (pdata'.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata'.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                  (pdata'.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata'.tree.node_point w₀ pdata'.root ⋯))) →
              Exists fun u_stable =>
                And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
                  (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
                  have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
                  And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                    (And
                      (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                        And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                          (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                      (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                        (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
Unconditional Minimal Energy Gap on subsingleton targets (`0 sorryAx`):
when `[Subsingleton M]` holds, every map `u : CP1 → M` is constant, so the non-constancy hypothesis
is vacuously false and `sphere_energy_gap` holds unconditionally.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M],
  Exists fun ε_sph =>
    And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
          Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
            Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm_succ_le_of_dir_bounds
type:
∀ {k : Nat} {α M₀ M₁ M₂ K₁ K₂ : Real} {f : Complex → Complex} {s : Set Complex},
  Real.instLE.le 0 M₁ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 M₂ →
      Real.instLE.le 0 K₁ →
        Real.instLE.le 0 K₂ →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm k α f s) M₀ →
            (∀ (z : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem s z →
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                      (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real k f) z) 1))
                    M₁) →
              (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem s z →
                    Real.instLE.le
                      (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                        (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real k f) z) Complex.I))
                      M₂) →
                (∀ (z : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem s z →
                      ∀ (w : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem s w →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                              (instHSub.hSub
                                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real k f) z) 1)
                                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real k f) w) 1)))
                            (instHMul.hMul K₁ (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                  (∀ (z : Complex),
                      Set.instMembership.mem s z →
                        ∀ (w : Complex),
                          Set.instMembership.mem s w →
                            Real.instLE.le
                              (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                                (instHSub.hSub
                                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real k f) z) Complex.I)
                                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real k f) w)
                                    Complex.I)))
                              (instHMul.hMul K₂ (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α f s)
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd M₀ M₁) M₂) K₁) K₂)

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiu_holderSeminorm_le_of_satisfies
type:
∀ {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
            GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCauchyPompeiuPointwise r R α f →
              Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuFCoef r R α)
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                  (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuDbarCoef r R α)
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                      (Metric.ball 0 R))))

doc:
Zero-sorry specialization of `scalar_mean_value_inequality` when every interior maximum
satisfies `c ≤ 4 * (c + 1) * e z₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_c_le_mul_e0
type:
∀ (b : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (c : optParam Real 0),
      autoParam (Real.instLE.le 0 c) GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_c_le_mul_e0._auto_1 →
        ∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
              (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                  ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                    (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                              (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                      (∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                          Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                            Real.instLE.le c (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 (instHAdd.hAdd c 1)) (e z₀))) →
                        Real.instLT.lt
                            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                              fun w => e w)
                            (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 2))) →
                          ∀ (z : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                              Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi) (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w))

doc: Any `J`-holomorphic sphere with nonpositive total energy equals `fun _ => u north_pole` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.eq_const_north_pole_of_jhol_of_totalEnergy_nonpos
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) 0 → Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.heinz_subharmonic_modification_bound
type:
∀ (r b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
              ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                  Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball z₀ t) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                    Real.instLE.le
                        (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t))
                          fun w => e w)
                        (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                          fun w => e w) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t))
                              fun w => e w)
                            (instHDiv.hDiv
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                    (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                              8)) →
                        Real.instLE.le (e z₀)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul (Real.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)))
                              (MeasureTheory.integral
                                (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w))
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                              (instHPow.hPow t 2)))

doc:
Unconditional `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` when `totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n))`
is eventually `≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_eventually_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
      (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
      (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S) (N₀ : Nat),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) 0) →
        Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun res =>
            And
              (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                  (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                      Eq (frames w n)
                        ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                          (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                    ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (P.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
              (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

name: GromovCompactness.MoebiusMatrix.mk.sizeOf_spec

        (Complex._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf c))
      (Complex._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf d))

doc: Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence on `[Subsingleton M]` targets for arbitrary `B : ℝ` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
    ∀ (a : Complex),
      Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
        ∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
              Exists fun m_p =>
                And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                  (Filter.Tendsto
                    (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                    Filter.atTop
                    (nhds
                      (instHAdd.hAdd m_p (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc:
Uniqueness of the atomic defect mass function: any function `m : CP1 → ℝ` supported on `S`
with nonnegative values on `S` satisfying the defect measure decomposition equals `canonicalDefectMass` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.canonicalDefectMass_eq_of_decomp
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (m : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real),
  (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le 0 (m p)) →
    (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0) →
      Eq cdata.μ
          (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
            (cdata.S.sum fun x => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m x)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x))) →
        Eq (GromovCompactness.Compactness.canonicalDefectMass I u_seq B thresh cdata) m

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.polar_cauchy_pompeiu_representation
type:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {z : Complex} {R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 R →
    (∀ (ρ : Real),
        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.uIcc 0 R) ρ →
          ∀ (θ : Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.uIcc 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)) θ →
              DifferentiableAt Real f
                (instHAdd.hAdd z
                  (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))) →
      (∀ (ρ : Real),
          Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 R) ρ →
            IntervalIntegrable
              (fun θ =>
                ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                  (fderiv Real f
                    (instHAdd.hAdd z
                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                  (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
              Real.measureSpace.volume 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)) →
        (∀ (ρ : Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 R) ρ →
              IntervalIntegrable
                (fun θ =>
                  ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                    (fderiv Real f
                      (instHAdd.hAdd z
                        (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                    (instHMul.hMul Complex.I
                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                Real.measureSpace.volume 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)) →
          (∀ (θ : Real),
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.uIcc 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)) θ →
                IntervalIntegrable
                  (fun r =>
                    ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                      (fderiv Real f
                        (instHAdd.hAdd z
                          (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal r)
                            (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                      (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
                  Real.measureSpace.volume 0 R) →
            IntervalIntegrable
                (fun θ =>
                  f
                    (instHAdd.hAdd z
                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal R) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                Real.measureSpace.volume 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) →
              Eq
                  (intervalIntegral
                    (fun ρ =>
                      intervalIntegral
                        (fun θ =>
                          ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                            (fderiv Real f
                              (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                  (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                            (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
                        0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) Real.measureSpace.volume)
                    0 R Real.measureSpace.volume)
                  (intervalIntegral
                    (fun θ =>
                      intervalIntegral
                        (fun ρ =>
                          ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                            (fderiv Real f
                              (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                  (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                            (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
                        0 R Real.measureSpace.volume)
                    0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) Real.measureSpace.volume) →
                Eq (f z)
                  (instHSub.hSub
                    (instHMul.hMul
                      (Complex.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                      (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) (f ζ)) z R))
                    (instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (Complex.ofReal Real.pi))
                      (intervalIntegral
                        (fun ρ =>
                          intervalIntegral
                            (fun θ =>
                              instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                (instHDiv.hDiv
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd z
                                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                                        (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                                  (instHSub.hSub
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd z

                                    z)))

                        0 R Real.measureSpace.volume)))

doc:
**Component Stability Equals Finite Automorphisms (Task E04 / E02)**.
A pseudo-holomorphic sphere tree limit curve satisfies the stability condition
(every constant ghost component has nodal degree ≥ 3) if and only if its full
automorphism group is finite (Conditional reduction theorem).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.stability_iff_finite_automorphisms
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I),
  Iff
      (∀ (v : lim.tree.V),
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (lim.map v z) c) →
          instLENat.le 3 (lim.tree.adj.degree v))
      (Finite (GromovCompactness.Extensions.StableMapAutomorphism I lim)) →
    Iff
      (∀ (v : lim.tree.V),
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (lim.map v z) c) →
          instLENat.le 3 (lim.tree.adj.degree v))
      (Finite (GromovCompactness.Extensions.StableMapAutomorphism I lim))

doc:
Unconditional construction of `ConcentrationData` when a subsequence `u_seq ∘ σ` converges
weakly in energy measure to `μ` with empty singular set `S = ∅` and smooth convergence on `Set.univ \ S` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.exists_concentration_data_of_weak_and_empty_S
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      Real.instLE.le 0 B →
        ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M) (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
          (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ],
          ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B) →
            GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
                (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ →
              (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                    (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)) →
                ∀ (u₀ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀ Set.univ →
                    (∀ (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                            Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p)
                              (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)
                                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))) →
                          Eq μ
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u₀)
                              (S.sum fun p =>
                                instHSMul.hSMul
                                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))) →
                      Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh)

doc:
Global Weitzenböck curvature bound when every `J`-holomorphic sphere has constant stereographic
chart energy density (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_term_bound_of_global_const_chart
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Exists fun c₀ =>
          Eq (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
            fun x => c₀) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Exists fun hessNorm =>
                    Exists fun curvTerm =>
                      And
                        (Eq
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                            (fun z =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                            w)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                        (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul b
                              (instHPow.hPow
                                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                2))
                            (instHMul.hMul c
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))

name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree.stable_off_root

doc:
Grafting local defect trees at each concentration point p ∈ S onto the base curve u₀
(`0 sorryAx` from `graft_root_sphere_tree`, `assemble_global_frames`, and `prestable_limit_energy_bound`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.graft_defect_trees_to_root
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
    ∀ (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real),
      (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le th.ε_sph (m_defect p)) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))) →
          ∀
            (defect_trees :
              (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) →
                SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
                  GromovCompactness.Bubbling.LocalDefectTree I th (m_defect p) (cdata.u₀ p)),
            (∀ (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
                Exists fun σ =>
                  Exists fun res =>
                    And
                      (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                        (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                          (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                              Eq (frames w n)
                                ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                                  (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                            And
                              (∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                                  (fun n =>
                                    Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                                  (P.map v)
                                  (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                                    (Set.ofPred fun z =>
                                      Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
                              (Eq (P.tree.adj.degree P.root) 1 →
                                (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (P.map P.root z) c) →
                                  ∀ (w₀ : P.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : P.tree.adj.Adj P.root w₀),
                                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                                      (fun n =>
                                        Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                                      (P.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (P.tree.node_point w₀ P.root ⋯))))
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀)
                            (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))) →
              Exists fun pdata =>
                Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)) B

Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when a subsequence `σ` consists of non-constant maps
and some term on `σ` has `totalEnergy < th.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_subseq_nonconst_of_exists_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
      ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)) →
          (Exists fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) th.h) →
            Exists fun u_stable =>
              And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

∀ {α : Real} {f : Complex → Complex} {s : Set Complex},
  BddAbove
      (Set.ofPred fun q =>

type:

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n))) 0)
          Filter.atTop →
        Exists fun pdata' =>
          And (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V) 1) (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V))
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))

type:
∀ (g : Complex → Real) (z₀ : Complex) (ρ θ : Real) (v : Complex),
  DifferentiableAt Real (fderiv Real g)
      (instHAdd.hAdd z₀ (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))) →
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t =>
        ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
          (fderiv Real g
            (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal t))))))
          v)
      (instHMul.hMul ρ
        (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
          (iteratedFDeriv Real 2 g
            (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
          (Matrix.vecCons (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
            (Matrix.vecCons v Matrix.vecEmpty))))
      θ

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
    ∀ (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata.tree.V)
      (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
      Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
          ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
            IsOpen Ω →
              Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n =>
                      Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                    (pdata.map w₀)
                    (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
                  Real.instLT.lt B th.ε_sph →
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n =>
                        Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                      (pdata.map w₀) Ω

term `u_seq n₀` has total energy strictly below `thresh.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_ge_h_of_exists_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) thresh.ε_sph →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (And
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                          η)
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (Metric.diam
                                            (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                          η))))

        chart_bound_pos := chart_bound_pos })
    (instHAdd.hAdd
