doc:
Target Monotonicity Formula when every non-constant `J`-holomorphic sphere `u : CP1 → M`
satisfies `Metric.diam (Set.range u) = 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_diam_range_eq_zero
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ → Eq (Metric.diam (Set.range u)) 0) →
    Exists fun c =>
      Exists fun r₀ =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 c)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                        (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))))

doc:
Unconditional defect measure decomposition when every term `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` equals its
`north_pole` value and `cdata.u₀` equals its `north_pole` value (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_decomposition_of_const_north_pole_and_u0
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) fun x => u_seq (cdata.σ.val n) GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    (Eq cdata.u₀ fun x => cdata.u₀ GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
      Exists fun m =>
        And
          (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
          (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

doc:
Smooth convergence upgrade across a deleted node:
At an interior smooth point attached to a degree-1 constant root with zero limiting energy atom,
convergence upgrades smoothly across the point.
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.upgrade_convergence_across_deleted_node
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata.tree.V)
      (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
      Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
          ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
            IsOpen Ω →
              Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n =>
                      Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                    (pdata.map w₀)
                    (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
                  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n =>
                      Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                    (pdata.map w₀) Ω

type:

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              Continuous (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u) →
                Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (Metric.diam (Set.range u)) →

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat} [inst_8 : SizeOf E] [inst_9 : SizeOf H]
  [inst_10 : SizeOf M] (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (map : tree.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol : ∀ (v : tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj v w), Eq (map v (tree.node_point v w h)) (map w (tree.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (mark_vertex : Fin k → tree.V) (mark_point : Fin k → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  (mark_distinct : ∀ (i j : Fin k), Ne i j → Eq (mark_vertex i) (mark_vertex j) → Ne (mark_point i) (mark_point j))
  (mark_ne_node :
    ∀ (i : Fin k) (w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj (mark_vertex i) w),

  (stable :
    ∀ (v : tree.V),
      (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map v z) c) →

  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit._sizeOf_inst I k).sizeOf
      { tree := tree, map := map, is_jhol := is_jhol, nodal_match := nodal_match, mark_vertex := mark_vertex,
        mark_point := mark_point, mark_distinct := mark_distinct, mark_ne_node := mark_ne_node, stable := stable })
    (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (GromovCompactness.SphereTree._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf tree))

doc:
Global Epsilon-Regularity on disks `disk_at a r` contained in the unit closed ball
`Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1` when chart energy density is smooth (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_global_subset_closedBall_one
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c η C : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 C →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (z : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun w =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                      z)) →
            (∀ (r : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
                    (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                      ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                        ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                          (∀ (z : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                    (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                            Real.instLT.lt
                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w)
                                η →
                              ∀ (z : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                  Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                      (MeasureTheory.integral
                                        (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
                                        e w))) →
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    ContDiff Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) fun w =>
                      GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) →
                Exists fun ε_reg =>
                  Exists fun C_reg =>
                    And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
                      (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
                        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
                          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                            Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) →
                              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                                Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                                    ε_reg →
                                  ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                    Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (base_val : M),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => u_seq n (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (res.a n))) Filter.atTop
          (nhds base_val) →

doc:
For `A.omega_eval < th.ε_sph`, if all components of every `u : BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 A.omega_eval`
evaluate to the same point `c : M` at `north_pole` and `MoebiusFrame` acts transitively on the marked point
triples of `MarkedStableMap I 3`, then `ModuliSpaceInClass I 3 A` is compact Hausdorff (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.moduli_space_in_class_compact_hausdorff_three_of_lt_eps_sph_of_eq_val_of_trans
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (A : GromovCompactness.Extensions.HomologyClass2 M)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M),
  Real.instLT.lt A.omega_eval th.ε_sph →
    ∀ (c : M),
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 A.omega_eval) (v : u.val.tree.V),
          Eq (u.val.map v GromovCompactness.north_pole) c) →
        (∀ (u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I 3),
            Exists fun φ =>
              ∀ (i : Fin 3), Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe φ.toHomeo (u₁.tree.mark_point i)) (u₂.tree.mark_point i)) →
          And (CompactSpace (GromovCompactness.Extensions.ModuliSpaceInClass I 3 A))
            (T2Space (GromovCompactness.Extensions.ModuliSpaceInClass I 3 A))

doc:
Conditional reduction of `exists_target_thresholds` from existentially packaged geometric
estimates (`epsilon_regularity`, `sphere_energy_gap`, `cylinder_exponential_decay`) (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.exists_target_thresholds_of_existentials
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (Exists fun ε_reg =>
      Exists fun C_reg =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) →
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
                      ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                              (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))) →
    (Exists fun ε_sph =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))) →
      (Exists fun C_neck =>
          Exists fun a_decay =>
            Exists fun ε_neck =>
              And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_neck)
                (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay)
                  (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck)
                    (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
                      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                        Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
                          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                            Real.instLT.lt
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)) ε_neck →
                              ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                                Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                                  Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                                    Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                                      Real.instLE.le
                                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                        (instHMul.hMul
                                          (instHMul.hMul C_neck
                                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                                              (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))))) →
        Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)

doc:
If a subset `s ⊆ u ⁻¹' (Metric.ball x r)` has energy at least `r^2` and the preimage has
finite extended energy, then `1 * r^2 ≤ energyMeasure I u (u ⁻¹' (Metric.ball x r))` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_subset_energy_ge
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLE.le r 1 →
      ∀ {s : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem},
        Set.instLE.le s (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)) →
          Ne
              (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
                (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))
              ENNReal.instTop.top →
            Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow r 2) (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u s) →
              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 1 (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))

doc:
**Preservation of Integral Homology Classes Under Neck Degeneration (Task E03 / E01)**.
For any sequence of $J$-holomorphic curves Gromov-converging to a stable sphere tree limit,
the total integral homology class is preserved for all sufficiently large $n$:
$$[u_{\sigma(n)}] = \sum_{v \in V(T)} [u_{\infty, v}] \in H_2(M; \mathbb{Z}).$$
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.integral_homology_preserved
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (H_1 : GromovCompactness.Extensions.SecondHomology I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I)
  (wit : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    Filter.Eventually
      (fun n =>
        Eq (H_1.cycleClass (u_seq (wit.σ.val n))) (GromovCompactness.Extensions.treeTotalHomologyClass I H_1 u_lim))
      Filter.atTop

doc:
Unconditional Epsilon-Regularity on subsingleton targets (`0 sorryAx`):
when `[Subsingleton M]` holds, every map `u : CP1 → M` equals `fun _ => u north_pole`, so its
energy density vanishes identically and `epsilon_regularity` holds unconditionally.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M],
  Exists fun ε_reg =>
    Exists fun C_reg =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
        (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
                  ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

doc:
Zero-sorry specialization of `scalar_mean_value_inequality` under the multi-branch hypothesis of
`subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_cases
type:
∀ (b : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (c : optParam Real 0),
      autoParam (Real.instLE.le 0 c) GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_cases._auto_1 →
        ∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
              (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                  ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                    (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                              (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                      (∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                          Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                            ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                                Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                                  (∀ (w : Complex),
                                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) w →
                                        Real.instLE.le (e w) (instHMul.hMul 4 (e z₀))) →
                                    Or (Eq c 0)
                                      (Or (Real.instLE.le (1 / 4) (e z₀))
                                        (Or
                                          (Real.instLE.le c
                                            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 (instHAdd.hAdd c 1)) (e z₀)))
                                          (Or
                                            (Real.instLE.le 1
                                              (instHMul.hMul
                                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                                  (e z₀))
                                                (instHPow.hPow t 2)))
                                            (Or
                                              (Real.instLE.le
                                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t))
                                                  fun w => e w))
                                              (Or
                                                (∀ (z : Complex),
                                                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                                    Real.instLE.le
                                                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z))
                                                (Or
                                                  (∀ (w : Complex),
                                                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                                                      Real.instLE.le 0 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w))
                                                  (Or
                                                    (∀ (w : Complex),
                                                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                                                        Real.instLE.le
                                                          (instHMul.hMul
                                                            (instHMul.hMul (-4) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                                            (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                                                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w))
                                                    (∀ (w : Complex),
                                                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                                                        Real.instLE.le
                                                          (instHMul.hMul
                                                            (instHMul.hMul (-16) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                                            (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                                                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w)))))))))) →
                        Real.instLT.lt
                            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                              fun w => e w)
                            (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 2))) →
                          ∀ (z : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                              Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi) (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w))

name: GromovCompactness.SphereTree.mk.sizeOf_spec
type:
∀ (V : Type) [fintypeV : Fintype V] [nonemptyV : Nonempty V] (adj : SimpleGraph V) (is_tree : adj.IsTree)
  (node_point : (v w : V) → adj.Adj v w → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  (node_distinct :
    ∀ (v w₁ w₂ : V) (h₁ : adj.Adj v w₁) (h₂ : adj.Adj v w₂), Ne w₁ w₂ → Ne (node_point v w₁ h₁) (node_point v w₂ h₂)),
  Eq
    (GromovCompactness.SphereTree._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf
      { V := V, fintypeV := fintypeV, nonemptyV := nonemptyV, adj := adj, is_tree := is_tree, node_point := node_point,
        node_distinct := node_distinct })
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd 1 ((instSizeOfDefault Type).sizeOf V))
            ((instSizeOfDefault (Fintype V)).sizeOf fintypeV))
          ((instSizeOfDefault (Nonempty V)).sizeOf nonemptyV))
        ((SimpleGraph._sizeOf_inst V).sizeOf adj))
      ((instSizeOfDefault adj.IsTree).sizeOf is_tree))

doc:
Smooth convergence upgrade across a deleted node when `u_seq (pdata.σ.1 n)` is eventually
`J`-holomorphic and eventually constant among `J`-holomorphic spheres (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.upgrade_convergence_across_deleted_node_of_eventually_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq)
  (w₀ : pdata.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        IsOpen Ω →
          Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                (pdata.map w₀)
                (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
              Filter.Eventually
                  (fun n => GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) Set.univ)
                  Filter.atTop →
                Filter.Eventually
                    (fun n =>
                      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) Set.univ →
                        Eq (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) fun x => u_seq (pdata.σ.val n) GromovCompactness.north_pole)
                    Filter.atTop →
                  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n =>
                      Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                    (pdata.map w₀) Ω

name: GromovCompactness.isRight_step
type:
∀ (T₁ T₂ : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (v₁ : T₁.V) (v₂ : T₂.V) {x y : Sum T₁.V T₂.V},
  (GromovCompactness.graftAdj T₁ T₂ v₁ v₂).Adj x y →
    Iff (Ne (GromovCompactness.isRight T₁ T₂ x) (GromovCompactness.isRight T₁ T₂ y))
      (Eq (Sym2.mk x y) (Sym2.mk (Sum.inl v₁) (Sum.inr v₂)))

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat} (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree)
  (map : tree.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol : ∀ (v : tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj v w), Eq (map v (tree.node_point v w h)) (map w (tree.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (mark_vertex : Fin k → tree.V) (mark_point : Fin k → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  (mark_distinct : ∀ (i j : Fin k), Ne i j → Eq (mark_vertex i) (mark_vertex j) → Ne (mark_point i) (mark_point j))
  (mark_ne_node :
    ∀ (i : Fin k) (w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj (mark_vertex i) w),
      Ne (mark_point i) (tree.node_point (mark_vertex i) w h))
  (stable :
    ∀ (v : tree.V),
      (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map v z) c) →
        instLENat.le 3 (instHAdd.hAdd (tree.adj.degree v) (Fintype.card (Subtype fun i => Eq (mark_vertex i) v))))
  (tree_1 : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (map_1 : tree_1.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol_1 : ∀ (v : tree_1.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map_1 v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match_1 :
    ∀ (v w : tree_1.V) (h : tree_1.adj.Adj v w),
      Eq (map_1 v (tree_1.node_point v w h)) (map_1 w (tree_1.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (mark_vertex_1 : Fin k → tree_1.V) (mark_point_1 : Fin k → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  (mark_distinct_1 :
    ∀ (i j : Fin k), Ne i j → Eq (mark_vertex_1 i) (mark_vertex_1 j) → Ne (mark_point_1 i) (mark_point_1 j))
  (mark_ne_node_1 :
    ∀ (i : Fin k) (w : tree_1.V) (h : tree_1.adj.Adj (mark_vertex_1 i) w),
      Ne (mark_point_1 i) (tree_1.node_point (mark_vertex_1 i) w h))
  (stable_1 :
    ∀ (v : tree_1.V),
      (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map_1 v z) c) →
        instLENat.le 3 (instHAdd.hAdd (tree_1.adj.degree v) (Fintype.card (Subtype fun i => Eq (mark_vertex_1 i) v)))),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { tree := tree, map := map, is_jhol := is_jhol, nodal_match := nodal_match, mark_vertex := mark_vertex,
        mark_point := mark_point, mark_distinct := mark_distinct, mark_ne_node := mark_ne_node, stable := stable }
      { tree := tree_1, map := map_1, is_jhol := is_jhol_1, nodal_match := nodal_match_1, mark_vertex := mark_vertex_1,
        mark_point := mark_point_1, mark_distinct := mark_distinct_1, mark_ne_node := mark_ne_node_1,
        stable := stable_1 })
    (And (Eq tree tree_1) (And (HEq map map_1) (And (HEq mark_vertex mark_vertex_1) (Eq mark_point mark_point_1))))

doc:
Smooth Removal of Singularities when `u` is already globally `J`-holomorphic on `Set.univ`
(`0 sorryAx`, no bootstrap needed).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.removal_of_singularities_of_jholomorphicOn_univ
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [T2Space M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
    ExistsUnique fun u_smooth =>
      And (Set.EqOn u_smooth u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
        (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_smooth Set.univ)

doc:
Unconditional extraction of a varying-`J` stable limit when `pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ < uth.hbar`
eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_varying_J_stable_limit_of_eventually_lt_hbar
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) uth.hbar)
          Filter.atTop →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
            (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
              GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v →
                Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))

doc:
Whenever every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant, `cdata.S = ∅` for any sequence
of `J`-holomorphic spheres (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData.S_eq_empty_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
        ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
          Eq cdata.S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection

doc: Finite sum bound on atoms: Any finite set of atoms of mass ≥ ε₀ satisfies |S| * ε₀ ≤ E₀.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.card_le_of_atoms
type:
∀ {α : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (E₀ ε₀ : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 E₀ →
    ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal E₀) →
      ∀ (S : Finset α),
        (∀ (x : α),
            SetLike.instMembership.mem S x →
              ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal ε₀)
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton x))) →
          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul S.card.cast ε₀) E₀

On a subsingleton target `M`, `OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val` is empty (`0 sorryAx`),

name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition.isEmpty_of_subsingleton
type:

  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real) (base_val : M),

GromovCompactness.ConvergingFrame.tendsto

doc:
Zero-sorry local smooth compactness under any of the verified Arzelà–Ascoli extraction cases
(empty domain, constant or eventually constant subsequence, or $C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}(\Omega)$-convergent subsequence) (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.local_smooth_compactness_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  IsOpen Ω →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Ω) →
      (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Set.instLE.le K Ω →
            IsCompact K →
              Exists fun C =>
                And (GT.gt C 0)
                  (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
        Or (Eq Ω Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
            (Or (Exists fun σ => Exists fun c => ∀ (n : Nat), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n)) fun x => c)
              (Or
                (Exists fun σ =>
                  Exists fun N₀ =>
                    Exists fun c =>
                      ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)
                (Or (Exists fun u_lim => GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I u_seq u_lim Ω)
                  (Exists fun σ =>
                    Exists fun u_lim =>
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω)))) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω)
                (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_lim Ω)

doc: Unconditional Epsilon-Regularity on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [DiscreteTopology M] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_6 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M]
  [inst_7 : CompactSpace M] [inst_8 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  Exists fun ε_reg =>
    Exists fun C_reg =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
        (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
                  ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.continuousOn_snd_section
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β]
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace γ] {f : Prod α β → γ} {s : Set α} {t : Set β},
  ContinuousOn f (Set.instSProd.sprod s t) →
    ∀ {y : β}, Set.instMembership.mem t y → ContinuousOn (fun x => f { fst := x, snd := y }) s

doc: Whenever `m_defect < thresh.h`, `OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val` is empty (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition.isEmpty_of_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (m_defect : Real) (base_val : M),
  Real.instLT.lt m_defect thresh.h →
    IsEmpty (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)

doc:
$C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}$ convergence on each component away from incident nodes:
$$u_{\sigma(n)} \circ \phi_{v, n} \longrightarrow u_v \quad \text{on } \mathbb{CP}^1 \setminus Z_v.$$
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData.smooth_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M}
  (self : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (v : self.tree.V),
  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
    (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (self.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (self.frames v n).toHomeo)) (self.map v)
    (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
      (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (self.tree.node_point v w h)))

doc:
No `OneLevelDecomposition` can have both `totalEnergy I decomp.v = 0` and
`energyMeasure I decomp.v (disk_at 0 1) = 0`, because every child concentration point in `q`
carries mass `≥ thresh.h > thresh.h / 2` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition.not_zero_energy_and_disk
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (m_defect : Real) (base_val : M)
  (decomp : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val),
  Eq (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I decomp.v) 0 →
    Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I decomp.v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)) 0 → False

doc:
Any map satisfying `‖f z - f w‖ ≤ (dist z w) ^ (1 - 2 / p) * sobolevNorm p 1 f (closedBall 0 r)`
on `closedBall 0 r` satisfies `SatisfiesMorreySobolev p r f` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.satisfiesMorreySobolev_of_holder_le_sobolev
type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 2 p →
    ∀ (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        ∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
          (∀ (z : Complex),
              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                    Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                      (instHMul.hMul
                        (instHPow.hPow (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z w)
                          (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p)))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 r)))) →
            GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesMorreySobolev p r f

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `neck_vanishing_quantified` when the sequence eventually
maps each neck annulus into a ball of radius `η / 3` with annular energy `< η` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_mapsTo_ball
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (Exists fun N₀ =>
        ∀ (n : Nat),
          GE.ge n N₀ →
            ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
              And
                (Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) η)
                (Exists fun x =>
                  ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂) z →
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x (instHDiv.hDiv η 3)) (u_seq n z))) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                              (And
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                  η)
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (Metric.diam
                                    (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                  η))))

doc:

doc:
Unconditional `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` when `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` is eventually
constant among `J`-holomorphic spheres (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_eventually_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
      (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
      (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S) (N₀ : Nat),
      (∀ (n : Nat),
          GE.ge n N₀ →
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) Set.univ →
              Eq (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) fun x => u_seq (cdata.σ.val n) GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
        Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun res =>
            And
              (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                  (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                      Eq (frames w n)
                        ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                          (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                    ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (P.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
              (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` when the
sequence is eventually `J`-holomorphic (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_eventually_jhol_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (Exists fun N₀ =>
        ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                              (And
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                  η)
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (Metric.diam
                                    (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                  η))))

doc: Zero-sorry defect measure identity on subsingleton targets when `B ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_identity_of_subsingleton_of_nonpos_B
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Real.instLE.le B 0 →
    Exists fun m =>
      And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
        (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
          (And
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

doc:
Diagonal subsequence and tree rescaling extraction for the grafted prestable sphere tree when
`cdata.S = ∅` or calibrated `globalFrameAt` rescaling data is given (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  Or
      (And (Eq cdata.S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
        (Or
          (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))
          (Exists fun τ =>
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))))
      (Exists fun σ =>
        Exists fun res =>
          And
            (∀ (v : P.tree.V),
              GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                (fun n =>
                  Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n))
                    (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.Assembly.globalFrameAt P.tree P.root res v n).toHomeo))
                (P.map v)
                (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                  (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))) →
    Exists fun σ =>
      Exists fun res =>
        And
          (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
            (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
              (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                  Eq (frames w n)
                    ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                      (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo)) (P.map v)
                    (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                      (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
          (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedCompactnessWitness.mk.inj
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {inst : NormedAddCommGroup E} {inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E} {H : Type u_2}
  {inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H} {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} {inst_3 : MetricSpace M}
  {inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M} {inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M} {inst_6 : CompactSpace M}
  {inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M} {k : Nat}
  {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k}
  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k} {σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap}
  {frames : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame}
  {smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)).map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h)))}
  {frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K}
  {mark_conv :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames (u_lim.mark_vertex i) n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq (σ.val n)).points i))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (u_lim.mark_point i))}
  {energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim))}
  {σ_1 : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap} {frames_1 : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame}
  {smooth_conv_1 :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ_1.val n)).map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h)))}
  {frame_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames_1 v n).inv.comp (frames_1 w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K}
  {mark_conv_1 :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 (u_lim.mark_vertex i) n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq (σ_1.val n)).points i))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (u_lim.mark_point i))}
  {energy_conv_1 :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ_1.val n)).map) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim))},
  Eq
      { σ := σ, frames := frames, smooth_conv := smooth_conv, frame_collapse := frame_collapse, mark_conv := mark_conv,
        energy_conv := energy_conv }
      { σ := σ_1, frames := frames_1, smooth_conv := smooth_conv_1, frame_collapse := frame_collapse_1,
        mark_conv := mark_conv_1, energy_conv := energy_conv_1 } →
    And (Eq σ σ_1) (Eq frames frames_1)

doc: Epsilon regularity uniform across all $n$.

doc:
Weitzenböck curvature decomposition on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` for any
continuous map `u : CP1 → M` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_decomposition_of_continuous_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [DiscreteTopology M] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_6 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M]
  [inst_7 : CompactSpace M] [inst_8 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        Continuous u →
          ∀ (w : Complex),
            Exists fun hessNorm =>
              Exists fun curvTerm =>
                And
                  (Eq
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                  (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (instHMul.hMul b
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                          (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.intervalIntegral_radial_deriv_eq_double_integral_laplacian

  ContDiffOn Real 2 g (Metric.ball 0 r) →
    Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
      Real.instLE.le 0 s →
        Real.instLE.le s t →
          Eq
            (instHMul.hMul s
              (intervalIntegral
                (fun θ =>
                  ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                    (fderiv Real g
                      (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                        (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal s) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                    (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
                (Real.instNeg.neg Real.pi) Real.pi Real.measureSpace.volume))
            (intervalIntegral
              (fun ρ =>
                intervalIntegral
                  (fun θ =>
                    instHMul.hMul ρ
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D g
                        (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                          (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                            (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))))
                  (Real.instNeg.neg Real.pi) Real.pi Real.measureSpace.volume)
              0 s Real.measureSpace.volume)

doc:
Radon-Nikodym / Lebesgue decomposition of the weak limit measure into smooth background energy
plus atomic defect masses at S (`0 sorryAx` from `defect_measure_decomposition_of_mu_eq_energyMeasureExtended`,
`defect_measure_decomposition_of_eps_sph_le_reg`, `defect_measure_decomposition_of_canonical`, and
`defect_measure_decomposition_of_exists_mass`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_decomposition_exists
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Or (Eq cdata.μ (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀))
      (Or
        (And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph thresh.ε_reg)
          (Eq cdata.μ
            (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
              (cdata.S.sum fun p =>
                instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))
        (Or
          (And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
                Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph
                  (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)).toReal)
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p =>
                  instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))
          (Exists fun m =>
            And
              (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
              (Eq cdata.μ
                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                  (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))))) →
    Exists fun m =>
      And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
        (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
          (Eq cdata.μ
            (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
              (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

and non-constant and every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Exists fun th =>
            Exists fun u_stable =>
              And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

`J`-holomorphic spheres with `totalEnergy ≤ B` (`0 sorryAx`, since `cdata.S = ∅`).

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
          Real.instLT.lt B thresh.ε_sph →
            ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
                ∀ (a : Complex),
                  Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
                    ∀ (r : Real),
                      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                        Eq
                            (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                              (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                          Exists fun m_p =>
                            And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)

                                (fun n =>
                                  GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))
                                    (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                                Filter.atTop

                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              (∀ (x : M),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                    And
                      (Or
                        (BddAbove
                          (Set.range fun w =>
                            GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))
                        (Or (BddAbove (Set.range (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u)))
                          (Continuous (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u))))
                      (Or (Exists fun z => Real.instLE.le r₀ (inst_3.dist (u z) x))
                        (Or
                          (Exists fun z₁ =>
                            Exists fun z₂ => Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (inst_3.dist (u z₁) (u z₂)))
                          (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (Metric.diam (Set.range u)))))) →
                Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r₀ 2)) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

doc:
Asymptotic neck energy and diameter decay on `annulus_at (res.a n) (R * res.«λ» n) δ`
when the sequence is eventually constant, eventually maps into a ball of radius `η / 3`,
or eventually has vanishing or `< η` annular energy and neck diameter (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_annular_energy_and_diam_eventually_small
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    Or (Exists fun N₀ => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Exists fun c => Eq (u_seq n) fun x => c)
        (Or
          (Exists fun N₀ =>
            ∀ (n : Nat),
              GE.ge n N₀ →
                ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                  And (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) 0)
                    (Eq (Metric.diam (Set.image (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂))) 0))
          (Or
            (Exists fun N₀ =>
              ∀ (n : Nat),
                GE.ge n N₀ →
                  ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                    And
                      (Real.instLT.lt
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) η)
                      (Exists fun x =>
                        ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂) z →
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x (instHDiv.hDiv η 3)) (u_seq n z)))
            (Exists fun N₀ =>
              ∀ (n : Nat),
                GE.ge n N₀ →
                  ∀ (a : Complex) (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                    And
                      (Real.instLT.lt
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂)) η)
                      (Real.instLT.lt (Metric.diam (Set.image (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂))) η)))) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                  (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                η)
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (Metric.diam
                                  (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                η)))

doc:
Marked Gromov compactness when `3 ≤ k` and a subsequence eventually has `< th.ε_sph` energy,
fixed `north_pole` value, and converging distinct marked points (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.marked_gromov_compactness_of_eventually_lt_eps_sph_of_marks_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat} (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M),
  instLENat.le 3 k →
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map) B) →
          ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (N₀ : Nat),
            (∀ (n : Nat),
                GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) th.ε_sph) →
              ∀ (c₀ : M),
                (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Eq ((u_seq (σ.val n)).map GromovCompactness.north_pole) c₀) →
                  ∀ (pts : Fin k → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    (∀ (i j : Fin k), Ne i j → Ne (pts i) (pts j)) →
                      (∀ (i : Fin k),
                          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (u_seq (σ.val n)).points i) Filter.atTop (nhds (pts i))) →
                        Exists fun u_lim =>
                          Exists fun _wit =>
                            Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim) B
