doc:
**Limit Homology for Fixed Homology Sequences (Conditional Reduction)**.
If all curves in the sequence represent a fixed homology class $A \in H_2(M; \mathbb{Z})$,
then the limit stable sphere tree represents the exact same class $A$:
$$\sum_{v \in V(T)} [u_{\infty, v}] = A.$$
Note (Conditional Reduction per COMPLETION_PLAN.md §0 & §2 P0-9):
Conditionally reduces fixed homology class preservation to the neck degeneration homology axiom in `SecondHomology`.
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.tree_homology_eq_fixed_class
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (H_1 : GromovCompactness.Extensions.SecondHomology I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I)
  (wit : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (A : H_1.H₂),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (H_1.cycleClass (u_seq n)) A) →
        Eq (GromovCompactness.Extensions.treeTotalHomologyClass I H_1 u_lim) A

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `marked_gromov_compactness` on sequences admitting a
constant subsequence with `3 ≤ k` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat}
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map) B) →

        Exists fun c =>
          Exists fun pts =>
            Exists fun x =>
              Exists fun x =>
                And (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq ((u_seq (σ.val n)).map z) c)
                  (∀ (n : Nat) (i : Fin k), Eq ((u_seq (σ.val n)).points i) (pts i))) →

doc:
Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when `u_seq n` is eventually non-constant and
eventually has `totalEnergy I (u_seq n) < th.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_eventually_nonconst_and_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) th.ε_sph) →
          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
Unconditional weak energy measure compactness when `u_seq` consists of `J`-holomorphic spheres
that eventually have `totalEnergy < thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.weak_energy_measure_compactness_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (Exists fun N₀ => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) thresh.h) →
      Exists fun σ =>
        Exists fun μ_lim =>
          And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim)
            (GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
              (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ_lim)

name: GromovCompactness.act_mul_frame_w2
type:
∀ (M : GromovCompactness.MoebiusMatrix) (v₁ v₂ v₃ w₂ : Prod Complex Complex)
  (h12 : Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₁ v₂)) (h23 : Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₂ v₃))

doc:

name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.extract_smooth_limit_off_singular_set_of_empty_S
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Eq S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection →
        ∀ (u₀ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀
              (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Set.univ (Finset.instSetLike.coe S)) →
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_lim Set.univ)

type:
∀ (g : Complex → Real) {z₀ : Complex} {r t ρ : Real},
  ContDiffOn Real 2 g (Metric.ball 0 r) →
    Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
      Real.instLE.le 0 ρ →
        Real.instLE.le ρ t →

              (fun θ =>

                    (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe

                        (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                          (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                            (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                      (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
                  (instHMul.hMul ρ
                    (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                      (iteratedFDeriv Real 2 g
                        (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                          (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                            (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                      (Matrix.vecCons
                        (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
                        (Matrix.vecCons
                          (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
                          Matrix.vecEmpty)))))

doc:
General bilinear Dirichlet trace scaling under a C-linear map on ℝ² ≅ ℂ.
The quadratic trace scales by exactly the determinant a² + b² = |φ'(w)|².
name: GromovCompactness.c_linear_dirichlet_trace_scaling
type:
∀ {V : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : Module Real V] (B : V → V → Real),
  (∀ (x y z : V), Eq (B (instHAdd.hAdd x y) z) (instHAdd.hAdd (B x z) (B y z))) →
    (∀ (x y z : V), Eq (B x (instHAdd.hAdd y z)) (instHAdd.hAdd (B x y) (B x z))) →
      (∀ (c : Real) (x y : V), Eq (B (instHSMul.hSMul c x) y) (instHMul.hMul c (B x y))) →
        (∀ (c : Real) (x y : V), Eq (B x (instHSMul.hSMul c y)) (instHMul.hMul c (B x y))) →
          ∀ (T : LinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) V) (a b : Real)
            (K : LinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2))),
            Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e1)
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHSMul.hSMul a GromovCompactness.e1) (instHSMul.hSMul b GromovCompactness.e2)) →
              Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e2)
                  (instHAdd.hAdd (instHSMul.hSMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) GromovCompactness.e1)
                    (instHSMul.hSMul a GromovCompactness.e2)) →
                Eq
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e1))
                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e1)))
                    (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e2))
                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e2))))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow a 2) (instHPow.hPow b 2))
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e1)
                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e1))
                      (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e2)
                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e2))))

doc:
On any ghost component with degree ≥ 3, any pure automorphism fixing the tree structure
must act as the identity on that component, given 3-point Möbius rigidity of frames on CP1.
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.ghost_component_pure_automorphism_trivial
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (v : lim.tree.V),
  GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I lim v →
    ∀ (aut : GromovCompactness.Extensions.PureComponentAutomorphism I lim),
      (∀ (ϕ : GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame) (p₁ p₂ p₃ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Ne p₁ p₂ →
            Ne p₁ p₃ →
              Ne p₂ p₃ →
                Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ.toHomeo p₁) p₁ →
                  Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ.toHomeo p₂) p₂ →
                    Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ.toHomeo p₃) p₃ →
                      Eq ϕ.toHomeo (Homeomorph.refl GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)) →
        Eq (aut.val.frame v).toHomeo (Homeomorph.refl GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)

doc:
Three-point normalization theorem: for any three distinct projective points
v₁, v₂, v₃ and w₁, w₂, w₃, there exists a unique (up to PGL equivalence) Möbius transformation
mapping v_i to w_i.
name: GromovCompactness.exists_unique_moebius_three_points
type:
∀ (v₁ v₂ v₃ w₁ w₂ w₃ : Prod Complex Complex),
  Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₁ v₂) →
    Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₂ v₃) →
      Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv v₁ v₃) →
        Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv w₁ w₂) →
          Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv w₂ w₃) →
            Not (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv w₁ w₃) →
              Exists fun M =>
                And
                  (And (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M.act v₁) w₁)
                    (And (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M.act v₂) w₂) (GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M.act v₃) w₃)))
                  (∀ (M' : GromovCompactness.MoebiusMatrix),
                    GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M'.act v₁) w₁ →
                      GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M'.act v₂) w₂ →
                        GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv (M'.act v₃) w₃ → GromovCompactness.PglEquiv M M')

doc:
Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness when `pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ < uth.hbar`
eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_eventually_lt_hbar
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) uth.hbar)
          Filter.atTop →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
            (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)

constant and `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` is eventually `J`-holomorphic (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat),
      GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
          Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
      Exists fun m =>
        And
          (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
          (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
            (And
              (Eq cdata.μ
                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                  (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
              (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

doc: **Universal Component and Vertex Bounds for the Master Limit** (Zero-sorry integration).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_component_bounds
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (B : Real),
  Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B →
    have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
    have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
    And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
      (And
        (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
          And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
            (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
        (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
          (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2))))

doc:
Subharmonic quadratic mean-value bound when the Laplacian lower bound `-4 * (b + c + 1) * (e z₀)^2 ≤ laplacian2D e w`
holds on `closedBall z₀ t` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_laplacian_lb
type:
∀ (r b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
              ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                  ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                      Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                        (∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                              Real.instLE.le
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (-4) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w)) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                              (MeasureTheory.integral
                                (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                              (instHDiv.hDiv
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                      (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                  (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                8))

      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) B) →
        Real.instLT.lt B uth.h →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
              (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                  (And

                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)

                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast

    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp ((u_seq n).map (comp_map v n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
        (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere

            Or (Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))

    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      let v := u_lim.tree.mark_vertex i;
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq n).tree.mark_point i))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (u_lim.tree.mark_point i)))
  (energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedStableMapTotalEnergy I (u_seq n)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedStableMapTotalEnergy I u_lim))),
  Eq

            ((Finset._sizeOf_inst Complex).sizeOf q))

        ((instSizeOfDefault (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)).sizeOf node_match))

            (Eq

  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
          Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
      ∀ (η : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
          Exists fun R₀ =>
            And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
              (∀ (R : Real),
                GE.ge R R₀ →
                  Exists fun δ₀ =>
                    And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                      (∀ (δ : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                          Exists fun N =>
                            ∀ (n : Nat),
                              GE.ge n N →
                                And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                  (And
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                      η)
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (Metric.diam
                                        (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                      η))))

type:
∀ {tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree} {root : tree.V} {parent : (w : tree.V) → Ne w root → tree.V}
  {parent_adj : ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root), tree.adj.Adj (parent w hw) w} {depth : tree.V → Nat}
  {depth_parent : ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root), instLTNat.lt (depth (parent w hw)) (depth w)}
  {adj_parent_or_child :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V), tree.adj.Adj v w → Or (Exists fun hw => Eq (parent w hw) v) (Exists fun hv => Eq (parent v hv) w)}
  {center : tree.V → Nat → Complex} {scale : tree.V → Nat → Real}
  {scale_pos : ∀ (w : tree.V) (n : Nat), Real.instLT.lt 0 (scale w n)}
  {scale_tendsto : ∀ (w : tree.V), Ne w root → Filter.Tendsto (scale w) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)}
  {center_tendsto :
    ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root),

        (nhds (tree.node_point (parent w hw) w ⋯))}
  {parent_collapse :
    ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root) (h : tree.adj.Adj (parent w hw) w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree.node_point w (parent w hw) ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn
            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (center w n) (scale w n) ⋯).toHomeo)
            (fun x => tree.node_point (parent w hw) w h) Filter.atTop K}
  {child_collapse :
    ∀ (v : tree.V) (hv : Ne v root) (h : tree.adj.Adj v (parent v hv)) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree.node_point (parent v hv) v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn
            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (center v n) (scale v n) ⋯).inv.toHomeo)
            (fun x => tree.node_point v (parent v hv) h) Filter.atTop K}
  {parent_1 : (w : tree.V) → Ne w root → tree.V}
  {parent_adj_1 : ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root), tree.adj.Adj (parent_1 w hw) w} {depth_1 : tree.V → Nat}
  {depth_parent_1 : ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root), instLTNat.lt (depth_1 (parent_1 w hw)) (depth_1 w)}
  {adj_parent_or_child_1 :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V),
      tree.adj.Adj v w → Or (Exists fun hw => Eq (parent_1 w hw) v) (Exists fun hv => Eq (parent_1 v hv) w)}
  {center_1 : tree.V → Nat → Complex} {scale_1 : tree.V → Nat → Real}
  {scale_pos_1 : ∀ (w : tree.V) (n : Nat), Real.instLT.lt 0 (scale_1 w n)}
  {scale_tendsto_1 : ∀ (w : tree.V), Ne w root → Filter.Tendsto (scale_1 w) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)}
  {center_tendsto_1 :

      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (center_1 w n)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (tree.node_point (parent_1 w hw) w ⋯))}
  {parent_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root) (h : tree.adj.Adj (parent_1 w hw) w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree.node_point w (parent_1 w hw) ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn
            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (center_1 w n) (scale_1 w n) ⋯).toHomeo)
            (fun x => tree.node_point (parent_1 w hw) w h) Filter.atTop K}
  {child_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (v : tree.V) (hv : Ne v root) (h : tree.adj.Adj v (parent_1 v hv)) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree.node_point (parent_1 v hv) v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn
            (fun n =>
              EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (center_1 v n) (scale_1 v n) ⋯).inv.toHomeo)
            (fun x => tree.node_point v (parent_1 v hv) h) Filter.atTop K},
  Eq
      { parent := parent, parent_adj := parent_adj, depth := depth, depth_parent := depth_parent,
        adj_parent_or_child := adj_parent_or_child, center := center, scale := scale, scale_pos := scale_pos,

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem when `∀ n, totalEnergy I (u_seq n) ≤ B` and `B < th.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_B_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        Real.instLT.lt B th.h →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
              (Exists fun σ =>
                Exists fun frames =>
                  And
                    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (u_lim.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instLE.le K
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                          IsCompact K →
                            TendstoUniformlyOn
                              (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                              (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:
Pruning operation: removing a degree-1 constant root vertex and promoting its child to root
when singleton convergence holds at the deleted node (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.prune_degree_one_root_of_singleton_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      (∀ (w₀ : pdata.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
            (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
            (pdata.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
        Exists fun pdata' =>
          And (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V) 1) (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V))
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))

doc: The inverse mapping of $f_\lambda$ on $\mathbb{R}^3$ is $f_{1/\lambda}$.
name: GromovCompactness.dil_fun_inv_apply
type:

name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M} {B : Real}
  {th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M}
  {cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th} {m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real}
  {s : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem} (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root : tree.V)
  (map : tree.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol : ∀ (v : tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj v w), Eq (map v (tree.node_point v w h)) (map w (tree.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (root_map : Eq (map root) cdata.u₀)
  (root_nodal_points :
    ∀ (w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj root w), SetLike.instMembership.mem s (tree.node_point root w h))
  (energy_sum :
    Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (map v))
      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (s.sum fun p => m_defect p)))
  (stable_off_root :
    ∀ (v : tree.V),
      Ne v root →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map v z) c) → instLENat.le 3 (tree.adj.degree v))
  (tree_1 : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root_1 : tree_1.V) (map_1 : tree_1.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol_1 : ∀ (v : tree_1.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map_1 v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match_1 :
    ∀ (v w : tree_1.V) (h : tree_1.adj.Adj v w),
      Eq (map_1 v (tree_1.node_point v w h)) (map_1 w (tree_1.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (root_map_1 : Eq (map_1 root_1) cdata.u₀)
  (root_nodal_points_1 :
    ∀ (w : tree_1.V) (h : tree_1.adj.Adj root_1 w), SetLike.instMembership.mem s (tree_1.node_point root_1 w h))
  (energy_sum_1 :
    Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (map_1 v))
      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (s.sum fun p => m_defect p)))
  (stable_off_root_1 :
    ∀ (v : tree_1.V),
      Ne v root_1 →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map_1 v z) c) → instLENat.le 3 (tree_1.adj.degree v)),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { tree := tree, root := root, map := map, is_jhol := is_jhol, nodal_match := nodal_match, root_map := root_map,
        root_nodal_points := root_nodal_points, energy_sum := energy_sum, stable_off_root := stable_off_root }
      { tree := tree_1, root := root_1, map := map_1, is_jhol := is_jhol_1, nodal_match := nodal_match_1,
        root_map := root_map_1, root_nodal_points := root_nodal_points_1, energy_sum := energy_sum_1,
        stable_off_root := stable_off_root_1 })
    (And (Eq tree tree_1) (And (HEq root root_1) (HEq map map_1)))

doc: Unconditional core compactness when `totalEnergy I (u_seq n) ≤ 0` eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_core_of_eventually_nonpos_energy

doc:
Marked point convergence: on component $v(i)$, the pulled-back marked point
$\phi_{v(i), n}^{-1}(z_{\sigma(n), i})$ converges to the limit marked point $m_i \in \mathbb{CP}^1$.
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedCompactnessWitness.mark_conv
GromovCompactness.Extensions.StableMapAutomorphism.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I}
  (tree_iso : GromovCompactness.Extensions.TreeAutomorphism lim.tree)
  (frame : lim.tree.V → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (curve_equiv :
    ∀ (v : lim.tree.V) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Eq (lim.map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe tree_iso.toEquiv v) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frame v).toHomeo z))
        (lim.map v z))
  (node_compat :
    ∀ (v w : lim.tree.V) (h : lim.tree.adj.Adj v w),
      Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frame v).toHomeo (lim.tree.node_point v w h))
        (lim.tree.node_point (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe tree_iso.toEquiv v) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe tree_iso.toEquiv w)
          ⋯))
  (tree_iso_1 : GromovCompactness.Extensions.TreeAutomorphism lim.tree)
  (frame_1 : lim.tree.V → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (curve_equiv_1 :
    ∀ (v : lim.tree.V) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Eq (lim.map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe tree_iso_1.toEquiv v) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frame_1 v).toHomeo z))
        (lim.map v z))
  (node_compat_1 :
    ∀ (v w : lim.tree.V) (h : lim.tree.adj.Adj v w),
      Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frame_1 v).toHomeo (lim.tree.node_point v w h))
        (lim.tree.node_point (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe tree_iso_1.toEquiv v)
          (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe tree_iso_1.toEquiv w) ⋯)),
  Eq
    (Eq { tree_iso := tree_iso, frame := frame, curve_equiv := curve_equiv, node_compat := node_compat }
      { tree_iso := tree_iso_1, frame := frame_1, curve_equiv := curve_equiv_1, node_compat := node_compat_1 })
    (And (Eq tree_iso tree_iso_1) (Eq frame frame_1))

doc:
`CoreSmoothLocalConvergesOn` is invariant under replacing the limit map `u₁` with a map `u₂`
that agrees with `u₁` on an open domain `Ω` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.coreSmoothLocalConvergesOn_congr_lim_of_eqOn_open
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]

doc:
For any constant map `fun _ => c`, the Euclidean ball integral of the chart energy density
vanishes and is bounded above by `energyMeasure I (fun _ => c) (disk_at a r)` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.integral_translated_density_le_energyMeasure_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (c : M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
  Real.instLE.le
    (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
      GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (fun x => c)
        (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (instHAdd.hAdd a w)))
    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (fun x => c) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))

name: GromovCompactness.EnergyBoundedSequence.bound_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M} {B : Real},
  GromovCompactness.EnergyBoundedSequence I u_seq B → Real.instLE.le 0 B

doc:
Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when a subsequence `σ` consists of non-constant maps
and `totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n)) < th.h` eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_subseq_nonconst_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
      ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)) →
          Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) th.h)
              Filter.atTop →
            Exists fun u_stable =>
              And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.deg1Retract_eq_self
type:
∀ (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root w₀ : tree.V) (hw₀_ne : Ne w₀ root) (u : Subtype fun v => Ne v root),
  Eq (GromovCompactness.Assembly.deg1Retract tree root w₀ hw₀_ne u.val) u

doc:
Hofer's lemma applied to gradient blow-up produces moving centers and scales
such that rescaled maps have controlled gradients on expanding disks.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.hofer_gradient_rescaling
type:
∀ (a₀ : Complex) (ε₀ : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε₀ →
    ∀ (ϕ : Complex → Real),
      Continuous ϕ →
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (ϕ z)) →
          Exists fun ε' =>
            Exists fun x =>
              Exists fun a' =>
                And (Real.instLE.le ε' ε₀)
                  (And (Real.instLE.le (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist a' a₀) (instHMul.hMul 2 ε₀))
                    (And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul ε₀ (ϕ a₀)) (instHMul.hMul ε' (ϕ a')))
                      (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Real.instLE.le (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist a' z) ε' →
                          Real.instLE.le (ϕ z) (instHMul.hMul 2 (ϕ a')))))

doc:
Whenever every `J`-holomorphic sphere in `(M, J)` is constant, no component of a stable
sphere tree limit is a principal component (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.not_is_principal_component_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    ∀ (lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (v : lim.tree.V),
      Not (GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I lim v)

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.hasDerivAt_fderiv_eval_rho
type:
∀ (g : Complex → Real) (z₀ : Complex) (ρ θ : Real) (v : Complex),
  DifferentiableAt Real (fderiv Real g)
      (instHAdd.hAdd z₀ (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))) →
    HasDerivAt
      (fun r =>
        ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
          (fderiv Real g
            (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal r) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
          v)
      (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
        (iteratedFDeriv Real 2 g
          (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
            (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
        (Matrix.vecCons (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))) (Matrix.vecCons v Matrix.vecEmpty)))
      ρ

name: GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv.trans
type:
∀ {p q r : Prod Complex Complex},
  Ne q { fst := 0, snd := 0 } →
    GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv p q → GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv q r → GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv p r

doc:
Global Epsilon-Regularity when every `J`-holomorphic sphere has vanishing stereographic chart
energy density (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.epsilon_regularity_of_global_const_chart
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq (fun w => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
          fun x => 0) →
    Exists fun ε_reg =>
      Exists fun C_reg =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
                    ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                        Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc: Total Nodal Degree of Ghost Bubbles is at least 3 (Contract B05).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.ghost_bubble_degree_ge_three
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (m_defect : Real) (base_val : M)
  (decomp : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (decomp.v z) c) →
      Eq (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I decomp.v) 0 →
        Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I decomp.v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)) 0 →
          instLENat.le 3 (instHAdd.hAdd decomp.q.card 1)

doc: Unconditional weak energy measure compactness for `J`-holomorphic spheres when `B ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.weak_energy_measure_compactness_of_nonpos_B
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]

doc:
Whenever the stereographic chart energy density `z ↦ e(stereo_chart.symm z)` is a constant
function `fun _ => c₀` and `b, c ≥ 0`, the Weitzenböck decomposition holds with `hessNorm = 0` and
`curvTerm = 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_decomposition_of_const_chart
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (c₀ : Real),
        (Eq (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
            fun x => c₀) →
          ∀ (w : Complex),
            Exists fun hessNorm =>
              Exists fun curvTerm =>
                And
                  (Eq
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                  (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (instHMul.hMul b
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                          (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `puncture_sobolev_extension` under any of the 6 verified
extension cases (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.puncture_sobolev_extension_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u
      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
    Ne
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
        ENNReal.instTop.top →
      Or
          (Exists fun c =>
            Set.EqOn (fun x => c) u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
          (Or (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ)
            (Or (GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u Set.univ)
              (Or
                (Exists fun u_ext =>
                  And (ContMDiffOn GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I 1 u_ext Set.univ)
                    (And (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
                      (Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u_ext p) 0)))
                (Or
                  (Exists fun u_ext =>
                    And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_ext Set.univ)
                      (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))))
                  (Exists fun u_ext =>
                    And (GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u_ext Set.univ)
                      (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))))))) →
        Exists fun u_ext =>
          And (Continuous u_ext)
            (And (GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u_ext Set.univ)
              (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound` when `thresh.h ≤ m_defect` and some `J`-holomorphic
term `u_seq n₀` has total energy `< thresh.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_ge_h_of_exists_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) thresh.ε_sph →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                        Set.instMembership.mem
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                          Set.instMembership.mem
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                              w →
                                            Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc:
Unconditional `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` when `totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n))`
is eventually `< th.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_eventually_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
      (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
      (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S) (N₀ : Nat),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) th.ε_sph) →
        Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun res =>
            And
              (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                  (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                      Eq (frames w n)
                        ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                          (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                    ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (P.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
              (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M}
  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I} [inst_8 : SizeOf E] [inst_9 : SizeOf H] [inst_10 : SizeOf M]
  (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (frames : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
  (frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))),
  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness._sizeOf_inst I u_seq u_lim).sizeOf
      { σ := σ, frames := frames, smooth_conv := smooth_conv, frame_collapse := frame_collapse,
        energy_conv := energy_conv })
    (instHAdd.hAdd 1 ((instSizeOfDefault GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap).sizeOf σ))

doc:
Master Stabilization Theorem for non-constant `J`-holomorphic spheres given a positive sphere energy gap
and singleton convergence upgrade (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_jhol_gap_and_upgrade
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (Exists fun ε_sph =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
              Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
        (∀ (pdata' : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata'.tree.V)
            (hw₀_adj : pdata'.tree.adj.Adj pdata'.root w₀),
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
              (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata'.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata'.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
              (pdata'.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata'.tree.node_point w₀ pdata'.root ⋯))) →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
              (Exists fun σ =>
                Exists fun frames =>
                  And
                    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (u_lim.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instLE.le K
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                          IsCompact K →
                            TendstoUniformlyOn
                              (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                              (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc: Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `exists_one_level_decomposition` from `extract_rescaled_bubble_and_children` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.exists_one_level_decomposition_of_disk
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (_res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (base_val : M),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => u_seq n (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (_res.a n))) Filter.atTop
          (nhds base_val) →
        Or
            (Exists fun v =>
              And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                (And (Eq m_defect (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v))
                  (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                    (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1))
                      (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))))))
            (Or
              (Exists fun v =>
                And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                  (And (Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (instHSub.hSub m_defect thresh.h))
                    (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                      (Eq
                        (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v)
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)))
                        (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)))))
              (Or
                (Exists fun v =>
                  Exists fun q =>
                    Exists fun m_child =>
                      And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                        (And
                          (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm z) 1)
                          (And (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLE.le thresh.h (m_child z))
                            (And (∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q z) → Eq (m_child z) 0)
                              (And
                                (Eq m_defect
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (q.sum fun z => m_child z)))
                                (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                                  (Eq
                                    (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v)
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)))
                                    (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))))))))
                (Exists fun v =>
                  Exists fun q =>
                    Exists fun m_child =>
                      And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                        (And (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLE.le thresh.h (m_child z))
                          (And (∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q z) → Eq (m_child z) 0)
                            (And
                              (Eq m_defect
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (q.sum fun z => m_child z)))
                              (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                                (Eq
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1))
                                    ((Finset.filter (fun w => Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm w) 1) q).sum
                                      fun z => m_child z))
                                  (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)))))))))) →
          Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)

doc:
Unconditional 2D quadratic-gauge subharmonic mean-value bound in the large-center regime `1 / 4 ≤ e z₀`:
when `1 / 4 ≤ e z₀` and `e w ≤ 4 * e z₀`, we have `e w ≤ 16 * (e z₀)²` on `closedBall z₀ ρ`, so
`-b * (e w)² - c * (e w) ≥ -(b + c) * 16 * (e z₀)²`, and modifying `e` by `K |w - z₀|² / 4` with
`K = 16(b+c+1)e(z₀)²` makes `g` subharmonic on `closedBall z₀ t` (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_one_fourth_le
type:
∀ (r b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
              (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    Real.instLE.le
                      (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                        (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le (1 / 4) (e z₀) →
                    ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                        Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                          (∀ (w : Complex),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) w →
                                Real.instLE.le (e w) (instHMul.hMul 4 (e z₀))) →
                            Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                                (instHDiv.hDiv
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                        (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                    (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                  8))

`v : CP1 → M` with `m_defect = totalEnergy I v` and `v north_pole = base_val` is given (`0 sorryAx`).

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `neck_vanishing_quantified` given asymptotic neck energy
and diameter decay (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_eventually_small
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                  (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                η)
                              (Real.instLT.lt
                                (Metric.diam
                                  (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                η)))) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                              (And
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                  η)
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (Metric.diam
                                    (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                  η))))

name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree.root_nodal_points

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  {varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I} [inst_7 : SizeOf E] [inst_8 : SizeOf H]
  [inst_9 : SizeOf M] (h : Real) (h_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 h) (ε_reg : Real) (ε_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)
  (C_reg : Real) (C_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
  (h_reg :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) u Set.univ →
          Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
            ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                Real.instLE.le
                  (GromovCompactness.Extensions.riemannianEnergyDensityWithJ I tgt.ω (varying_J.J_seq n) u z)
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                    (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))))
  (hbar : Real) (hbar_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 hbar)
  (h_sph :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) u Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le hbar (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u Set.univ))
  (h_le_reg : Real.instLE.le h (instHDiv.hDiv ε_reg 2)) (h_le_sph : Real.instLE.le h hbar),
  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds._sizeOf_inst I varying_J).sizeOf
      { h := h, h_pos := h_pos, ε_reg := ε_reg, ε_reg_pos := ε_reg_pos, C_reg := C_reg, C_reg_pos := C_reg_pos,
        h_reg := h_reg, hbar := hbar, hbar_pos := hbar_pos, h_sph := h_sph, h_le_reg := h_le_reg,
        h_le_sph := h_le_sph })
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (instHAdd.hAdd
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (Real._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf h))
                      ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLT.lt 0 h)).sizeOf h_pos))
                    (Real._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf ε_reg))
                  ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg)).sizeOf ε_reg_pos))
                (Real._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf C_reg))
              ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)).sizeOf C_reg_pos))
            (Real._sizeOf_inst.sizeOf hbar))
          ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLT.lt 0 hbar)).sizeOf hbar_pos))
        ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLE.le h (instHDiv.hDiv ε_reg 2))).sizeOf h_le_reg))
      ((instSizeOfDefault (Real.instLE.le h hbar)).sizeOf h_le_sph))

doc: Unconditional cylinder exponential decay on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cylinder_exponential_decay_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [DiscreteTopology M] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_6 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M]
  [inst_7 : CompactSpace M] [inst_8 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  Exists fun C₀ =>
    Exists fun a_decay =>
      Exists fun ε_neck =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C₀)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay)
            (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck)
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))
                          ε_neck →
                        ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                          Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                            Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                              Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (instHMul.hMul C₀
                                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                                        (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))))

doc: Unconditional Scalar Mean-Value Inequality for `c = 0` (`Δ e ≥ -b e²`).

    have C := instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi;
    And (Real.instLT.lt 0 η)
      (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
        (∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
              (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →

                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →

                      Real.instLT.lt
                          (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                            fun w => e w)
                          η →
                        ∀ (z : Complex),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                            Real.instLE.le (e z)
                              (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))

                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w))))

type:

  [inst_8 : SizeOf E] [inst_9 : SizeOf H] [inst_10 : SizeOf M] (v_equiv : Equiv u₁.tree.V u₂.tree.V)

    ∀ (v w : u₁.tree.V),

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.removal_of_singularities_of_c1_vanishing_at_puncture
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

  (∀ (v : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I v Set.univ →
        ContMDiffOn GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) v Set.univ) →
    ∀ (u u_ext : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
