doc:
Decomposition of the Cauchy–Pompeiu difference `f z - f w` into the boundary circle integral
difference and near/far Pompeiu area integral zones on $D_r \subset D_R$ when `f` is holomorphic
on `ball 0 R` and continuous on `closedBall 0 R` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchy_pompeiu_near_far_decomp_exists
type:
∀ {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
            ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
              DiffContOnCl Complex f (Metric.ball 0 R) →
                ∀ {z w : Complex},
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                      Exists fun I_near =>
                        Exists fun I_far =>
                          And
                            (Eq (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w))
                              (instHSub.hSub
                                (instHSub.hSub
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (Complex.instInv.inv
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                                    (circleIntegral
                                      (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) (f ζ)) 0 R))
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (Complex.instInv.inv
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                                    (circleIntegral
                                      (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ w)) (f ζ)) 0 R)))
                                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (Complex.ofReal Real.pi))
                                  (instHAdd.hAdd I_near I_far))))
                            (And
                              (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_near)
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                      (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                                  (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w))))
                              (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_far)
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                          (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                                      (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                                    (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))

Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when at least one map `u_seq n` is non-constant and
every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
      (Exists fun n => Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

doc:
Conditional Reduction theorem: Target monotonicity and image exit together imply the minimal energy gap.
Note (Conditional Reduction per COMPLETION_PLAN.md §0 & §2 P0-9):
Takes open geometric contract hypotheses (`h_mono`, `h_exit`) and does not count as closing
Contract A07 unconditionally.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_monotonicity_and_exit
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (c r₀ : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                  Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r₀) (u z))) →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (s : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u s) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)) →
            Exists fun ε_sph =>
              And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
                (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                      Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedCompactnessWitness.mk.sizeOf_spec
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat}
  {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k}
  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k} [inst_8 : SizeOf E] [inst_9 : SizeOf H]
  [inst_10 : SizeOf M] (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
  (frames : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)).map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
  (frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (mark_conv :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames (u_lim.mark_vertex i) n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq (σ.val n)).points i))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (u_lim.mark_point i)))
  (energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim))),
  Eq
    ((GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedCompactnessWitness._sizeOf_inst I u_seq u_lim).sizeOf

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Exists fun m =>
    And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
      (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
        (And
          (Eq cdata.μ
            (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
              (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
          (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` when `thresh.h / 2 < m_defect` and some `J`-holomorphic
term `u_seq n₀` has total energy strictly below `thresh.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_gt_half_h_of_exists_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) thresh.ε_sph →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (And
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                          η)
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (Metric.diam
                                            (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                          η))))

doc: Constant functions unconditionally satisfy the interior Cauchy-Riemann estimate with constant $C = 1$.

type:

    ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →

          Real.instLE.le
            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) (fun x => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
            (instHMul.hMul 1
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann fun x => c)
                  (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 0 (fun x => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 R))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Real.instLE.le B 0 →
    (Exists fun c => Eq cdata.u₀ fun x => c) →
      Exists fun m =>
        And
          (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
          (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

doc: Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` when `m_defect < thresh.h / 2` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_lt_half_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) →
    ∀ (η : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
        Exists fun R₀ =>
          And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
            (∀ (R : Real),
              GE.ge R R₀ →
                Exists fun δ₀ =>
                  And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                    (∀ (δ : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                        Exists fun N =>
                          ∀ (n : Nat),
                            GE.ge n N →
                              And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                (And
                                  (Real.instLT.lt
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                    η)
                                  (Real.instLT.lt
                                    (Metric.diam
                                      (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                    η))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.polar_pompeiu_disk_integral_bound
type:
∀ (f : Complex → Complex) (z : Complex) {R M : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 R →
    (∀ (θ : Real),
        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi)) θ →
          ∀ (ρ : Real),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 R) ρ →
              Real.instLE.le
                (Complex.instNorm.norm
                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f
                    (instHAdd.hAdd z
                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))))
                M) →
      Real.instLE.le
        (Complex.instNorm.norm
          (instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (Complex.ofReal Real.pi))
            (intervalIntegral
              (fun θ =>
                intervalIntegral
                  (fun ρ =>
                    instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                      (instHDiv.hDiv
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f
                          (instHAdd.hAdd z
                            (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                              (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                        (instHSub.hSub
                          (instHAdd.hAdd z
                            (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                              (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
                          z)))
                  0 R Real.measureSpace.volume)
              0 (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) Real.measureSpace.volume)))
        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 R) M)

doc: Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence when `B < thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`, since `cdata.S = ∅`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_B_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Real.instLT.lt B thresh.h →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                        Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat}
  {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I k}
  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I k}
  (frames : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (comp_map : u_lim.tree.V → (n : Nat) → (u_seq n).tree.V)
  (smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp ((u_seq n).map (comp_map v n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
        (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z =>
            Or (Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))
              (Exists fun i => And (Eq (u_lim.tree.mark_vertex i) v) (Eq z (u_lim.tree.mark_point i))))))
  (frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (mark_conv :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      let v := u_lim.tree.mark_vertex i;
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq n).tree.mark_point i))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (u_lim.tree.mark_point i)))
  (energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedStableMapTotalEnergy I (u_seq n)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedStableMapTotalEnergy I u_lim)))
  (frames_1 : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (comp_map_1 : u_lim.tree.V → (n : Nat) → (u_seq n).tree.V)
  (smooth_conv_1 :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp ((u_seq n).map (comp_map_1 v n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 v n).toHomeo))
        (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z =>
            Or (Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))
              (Exists fun i => And (Eq (u_lim.tree.mark_vertex i) v) (Eq z (u_lim.tree.mark_point i))))))
  (frame_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames_1 v n).inv.comp (frames_1 w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (mark_conv_1 :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      let v := u_lim.tree.mark_vertex i;
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 v n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq n).tree.mark_point i))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (u_lim.tree.mark_point i)))
  (energy_conv_1 :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedStableMapTotalEnergy I (u_seq n)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedStableMapTotalEnergy I u_lim))),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { frames := frames, comp_map := comp_map, smooth_conv := smooth_conv, frame_collapse := frame_collapse,
        mark_conv := mark_conv, energy_conv := energy_conv }
      { frames := frames_1, comp_map := comp_map_1, smooth_conv := smooth_conv_1, frame_collapse := frame_collapse_1,
        mark_conv := mark_conv_1, energy_conv := energy_conv_1 })
    (And (Eq frames frames_1) (Eq comp_map comp_map_1))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `sphere_energy_gap` when the stereographic chart energy
density is bounded above and there is a pair of points at distance `≥ 2 * r₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_bddAbove_chart_density_and_pair_dist_ge
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              BddAbove
                  (Set.range fun w =>
                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) →
                (Exists fun z₁ => Exists fun z₂ => Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (inst_3.dist (u z₁) (u z₂))) →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r₀ 2)) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

doc: Zero-sorry local smooth compactness when `u_seq` is eventually constant on `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.local_smooth_compactness_of_eventually_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  IsOpen Ω →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Ω) →
      (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Set.instLE.le K Ω →
            IsCompact K →
              Exists fun C =>
                And (GT.gt C 0)
                  (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
        (Exists fun N₀ =>
            Exists fun c => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω)
                (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_lim Ω)

doc:
Zero-sorry interior Sobolev Cauchy-Riemann estimate when `sobolevNorm p (k + 1) f (closedBall 0 r)`
is bounded by `sobolevNorm p k (cauchyRiemann f) (closedBall 0 R) + sobolevNorm p 0 f (closedBall 0 R)` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.interior_cauchy_riemann_estimate_sobolev_of_le_sum
type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
    ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),

                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)
                  (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 0 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R))) →

                  (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv p (instHSub.hSub p 1))
                    (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv R (instHSub.hSub R r)) (instHAdd.hAdd k 1))))

                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)

doc:
Scalar Mean-Value Inequality (Contract A01).
Let `b ≥ 0` and `c = 0`. There exist `η > 0` and `C > 0` such that for any `r > 0` and any non-negative function
`e : ℂ → ℝ` of class $C^2$ satisfying `Δ e ≥ -b e² - c e` on `ball 0 r`, if `∫_{ball 0 r} e < η`, then
`sup_{closedBall 0 (r/2)} e ≤ C r⁻² ∫_{ball 0 r} e` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality
type:
∀ (b : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (c : optParam Real 0),
      autoParam (Eq c 0) GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality._auto_1 →
        Exists fun η =>
          Exists fun C =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 η)
              (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C)
                (∀ (r : Real),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                    ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
                      (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                        ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                          ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                            (∀ (z : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                                  Real.instLE.le
                                    (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                                      (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                              Real.instLT.lt
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w)
                                  η →
                                ∀ (z : Complex),
                                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                                    Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                      (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                        (MeasureTheory.integral
                                          (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
                                          e w))))

doc: Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness when some term has non-positive symplectic area (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (Exists fun n => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) 0) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
            (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc:
Global Weitzenböck curvature bound when every `J`-holomorphic sphere has vanishing differential
everywhere on `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_term_bound_of_global_mfderiv_eq_zero
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) 0) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Exists fun hessNorm =>
                    Exists fun curvTerm =>
                      And
                        (Eq
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                            (fun z =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                            w)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                        (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul b
                              (instHPow.hPow
                                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                2))
                            (instHMul.hMul c
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ → Exists fun x₀ => Eq u fun x => x₀) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)))

A constant root in a prestable limit with a positive lower energy bound `ε > 0` on the subsequence
has degree at least 1 (`0 sorryAx`).

type:

  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) {ε : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le ε (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)))) →
      (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.polar_far_zone_integrand_bound
type:
∀ {g z w : Complex} {M δ ρ θ α : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 M →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 δ →
      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 2 δ) ρ →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
          Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
            Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm g) M →
              Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) δ →
                have ζ :=
                  instHAdd.hAdd z
                    (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))));
                Real.instLE.le
                  (Complex.instNorm.norm
                    (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                      (instHSub.hSub (instHDiv.hDiv g (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) (instHDiv.hDiv g (instHSub.hSub ζ w)))))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 M) (instHPow.hPow δ α))
                    (instHPow.hPow ρ (Real.instNeg.neg α)))

fixed `north_pole` value, and converging distinct marked points (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.marked_gromov_compactness_of_eventually_lt_h_of_marks_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat} (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M),
  instLENat.le 3 k →
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map) B) →
          ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (N₀ : Nat),
            (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) th.h) →
              ∀ (c₀ : M),
                (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Eq ((u_seq (σ.val n)).map GromovCompactness.north_pole) c₀) →
                  ∀ (pts : Fin k → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    (∀ (i j : Fin k), Ne i j → Ne (pts i) (pts j)) →
                      (∀ (i : Fin k),
                          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (u_seq (σ.val n)).points i) Filter.atTop (nhds (pts i))) →
                        Exists fun u_lim =>
                          Exists fun _wit =>
                            Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim) B

doc:
Widman hole-filling contraction on concentric annuli (`0 sorryAx`):
If `E(u; A(r₁, r₂)) ≤ K * (E(u; A(r, R)) - E(u; A(r₁, r₂)))` with `0 ≤ K`, then
`E(u; A(r₁, r₂)) ≤ (K / (1 + K)) * E(u; A(r, R))`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.energyMeasure_annulus_le_of_hole_filling
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex)
  (r r₁ r₂ R K : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 K →
    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
        (instHMul.hMul K
          (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))
            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂)))) →
      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
        (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv K (instHAdd.hAdd 1 K))
          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)))

doc:
Smooth convergence upgrade across a deleted node when `u_seq` has total energy bounded by
`B ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.upgrade_convergence_across_deleted_node_of_nonpos_B
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
    ∀ (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata.tree.V)
      (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
      Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
          ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
            IsOpen Ω →
              Set.instMembership.mem Ω (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯) →
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n =>
                      Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                    (pdata.map w₀)
                    (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
                  Real.instLE.le B 0 →
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n =>
                        Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
                      (pdata.map w₀) Ω

`J`-holomorphic spheres with `totalEnergy ≤ B` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        Real.instLT.lt B thresh.h →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun μ_lim =>
              And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim)
                (GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
                  (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ_lim)

doc: The $m$-th derivative $\alpha$-Hölder seminorm on `ball 0 R` is bounded by `sup ‖D^{m+1} g‖ * (2 R)^{1-α}` (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.derivHolderSeminorm_ball_le_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ (m : Nat) {g : Complex → Complex} {R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 R →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
      Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
        ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd m.cast 1) g (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.derivHolderSeminorm m α g (Metric.ball 0 R))
            (instHMul.hMul
              (Real.instSupSet.sSup
                (Set.image
                  (fun ζ => ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm (iteratedFDeriv Real (instHAdd.hAdd m 1) g ζ))
                  (Metric.ball 0 R)))
              (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 R) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))

doc: Zero-sorry local smooth compactness when `u_seq` admits a subsequence of constant maps (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.local_smooth_compactness_of_const_subseq
type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  IsOpen Ω →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Ω) →
      (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Set.instLE.le K Ω →
            IsCompact K →

                  (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
        (Exists fun σ => Exists fun c => ∀ (n : Nat), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n)) fun x => c) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω)
                (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_lim Ω)

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  instLENat.le 3 k →
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),

type:

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
      (Exists fun N₀ =>
          ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) 0) →
        Exists fun m =>
          And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
            (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)

                  (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

`totalEnergy < th.ε_sph` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        (Exists fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) th.ε_sph) →
          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
When each atom `p ∈ S` has `(μ {p}).toReal ≥ ε_sph` and `μ` equals the background energy
measure plus the atomic sum `∑ p ∈ S, μ {p} • δ_p`, `canonicalDefectMass` witnesses the defect
measure decomposition (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_decomposition_of_canonical
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)).toReal) →
    Eq cdata.μ
        (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
          (cdata.S.sum fun p =>
            instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
              (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))) →
      Exists fun m =>
        And
          (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
          (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))))

doc:
For `k = 3`, whenever every `J`-holomorphic sphere in `(M, J)` is constant, if all components
of every `u : BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 A.omega_eval` evaluate to the same point `c : M` at `north_pole`
and `MoebiusFrame` acts transitively on the marked point triples of `MarkedStableMap I 3`, then
`ModuliSpaceInClass I 3 A` is compact (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.moduli_space_in_class_compact_three_of_all_jhol_const_of_eq_val_of_trans
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    ∀ (A : GromovCompactness.Extensions.HomologyClass2 M) (c : M),
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 A.omega_eval) (v : u.val.tree.V),
          Eq (u.val.map v GromovCompactness.north_pole) c) →
        (∀ (u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableMap I 3),
            Exists fun φ =>
              ∀ (i : Fin 3), Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe φ.toHomeo (u₁.tree.mark_point i)) (u₂.tree.mark_point i)) →
          CompactSpace (GromovCompactness.Extensions.ModuliSpaceInClass I 3 A)

doc:
Subharmonic quadratic mean-value bound when `e` is classically subharmonic (`0 ≤ laplacian2D e w`)
on `Metric.closedBall z₀ t` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_laplacian_nonneg
type:
∀ (r b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
              ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                  ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                      Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                        (∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                              Real.instLE.le 0 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w)) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                              (MeasureTheory.integral
                                (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                              (instHDiv.hDiv
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                      (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                  (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                8))

doc:
Marked Gromov compactness when `3 ≤ k` and a subsequence eventually has `≤ 0` energy,
fixed `north_pole` value, and converging distinct marked points (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.marked_gromov_compactness_of_eventually_nonpos_energy_of_marks_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat} (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M),
  instLENat.le 3 k →
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map) B) →
          ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (N₀ : Nat),
            (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) 0) →
              ∀ (c₀ : M),
                (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Eq ((u_seq (σ.val n)).map GromovCompactness.north_pole) c₀) →
                  ∀ (pts : Fin k → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    (∀ (i j : Fin k), Ne i j → Ne (pts i) (pts j)) →
                      (∀ (i : Fin k),
                          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (u_seq (σ.val n)).points i) Filter.atTop (nhds (pts i))) →
                        Exists fun u_lim =>
                          Exists fun _wit =>
                            Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim) B

doc:
Unconditional weak energy measure compactness when `u_seq` consists of `J`-holomorphic spheres
that eventually have `totalEnergy ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.weak_energy_measure_compactness_of_eventually_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)

          And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim)

doc: Real-valued energy measure is monotone on nested annuli (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.energyMeasure_annulus_at_mono
type:

doc:
Weak compactness of a sequence of uniformly bounded finite Borel measures on `CP1` that
already converges weakly to `μ_lim` (`0 sorryAx`, deducing `IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim` from `h_bdd`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.prokhorov_weak_compactness_of_conv_bdd
type:
∀ (μ_seq : Nat → MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  [∀ (n : Nat), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ_seq n)],

      And (GT.gt B 0)
        (∀ (n : Nat),
          ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (μ_seq n) Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B))) →
    ∀ (μ_lim : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence μ_seq μ_lim →
        Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun μ_lim' =>
            And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim')

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.interior_cauchy_riemann_estimate_succ_of_dir_schauder
type:
∀ {k : Nat} {α r R C₀ C₁ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 C₀ →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 C₁ →
      ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
        Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
            (instHMul.hMul C₀
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α
                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))) →
          (∀ (z : Complex),
              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                Real.instLE.le
                  (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                    (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f) z) 1))
                  (instHMul.hMul C₁
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))) →
            (∀ (z : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                      (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f) z)
                        Complex.I))
                    (instHMul.hMul C₁
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))) →
              (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    ∀ (w : Complex),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                        Real.instLE.le
                          (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                            (instHSub.hSub
                              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                                (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f) z) 1)
                              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                                (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f) w) 1)))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHMul.hMul C₁
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                            (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                (∀ (z : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                      ∀ (w : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                              (instHSub.hSub
                                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                                  (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f) z) Complex.I)
                                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                                  (fderiv Real (iteratedFDeriv Real (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f) w) Complex.I)))
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHMul.hMul C₁
                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                              (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                  Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 2) α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                    (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd C₀ (instHMul.hMul 4 C₁))
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α

If $\bar\partial f = 0$, then $\bar\partial(\Delta_{h, v} f) = 0$.

      Eq (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f z) 0 →

doc: The $\alpha$-Hölder seminorm on `ball 0 R` is bounded by `sup ‖fderiv‖ * (2 R)^{1-α}` for $C^1$ maps (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm_ball_le_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ {g : Complex → Complex} {R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 R →

      Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
        ContDiffOn Real 1 g (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm α g (Metric.ball 0 R))

              (Real.instSupSet.sSup
                (Set.image (fun ζ => ContinuousLinearMap.hasOpNorm.norm (fderiv Real g ζ)) (Metric.ball 0 R)))
              (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 R) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))

doc: Local Darboux-chart minimal surface / target monotonicity bound at a boundary hit point (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_at_boundary_hit
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLE.le r 1 →
      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
        GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
          Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
            ∀ (_z_hit : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Set.instMembership.mem (frontier (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r))) _z_hit →
                Eq (inst.dist (u _z_hit) x) r →
                  Or
                      (Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow r 2)
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r))))
                      (Exists fun s =>
                        And (Set.instLE.le s (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))
                          (And
                            (Ne
                              (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
                                (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))
                              ENNReal.instTop.top)
                            (Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow r 2) (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u s)))) →
                    Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 1 (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))

Euclidean ball integral is `0 ≤ energyMeasure I u (disk_at a r)` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:

doc:
Uniqueness of smooth $J$-holomorphic extensions across punctures on $\mathbb{CP}^1$:
If two smooth $J$-holomorphic curves agree on $\mathbb{CP}^1 \setminus \{p\}$,
they are identical everywhere on $\mathbb{CP}^1$.
Proved with ZERO `sorry` via Mathlib's `Continuous.ext_on`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.removal_of_singularities_unique
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [T2Space M] (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  Dense (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
    ∀ (u u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      And (Set.EqOn u₁ u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
          (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₁ Set.univ) →
        And (Set.EqOn u₂ u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
            (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u₂ Set.univ) →
          Eq u₁ u₂

doc:
For `k = 3` and `B < th.h`, any sequence `reps` with a constant subsequence
extracts a Gromov-convergent subsequence with `0 sorryAx`.
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_bounded_marked_stable_subseq_of_const_three_of_lt_threshold
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {B : Real} (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M),
  Real.instLT.lt B th.h →
    ∀ (reps : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 B) (φ : Nat → Nat),
      StrictMono φ →
        ∀ (lim_rep : GromovCompactness.Extensions.BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 B),
          (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (reps (φ n)) lim_rep) →

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchy_pompeiu_holder_seminorm_le
type:
∀ {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
            (∀ (z : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                  ∀ (w : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                      Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul R (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                                (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 2))
                              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHMul.hMul 4
                                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                  (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                    (instHSub.hSub 1 α))))
                              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                          (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
              Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                (instHAdd.hAdd
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul R (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                      (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 2))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (instHMul.hMul 4
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                        (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                      (Metric.ball 0 R))))

doc: Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when `B ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        Real.instLE.le B 0 →
          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  {varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I} (h : Real) (h_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 h)
  (ε_reg : Real) (ε_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg) (C_reg : Real) (C_reg_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg)
  (h_reg :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) u Set.univ →
          Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
            ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                Real.instLE.le
                  (GromovCompactness.Extensions.riemannianEnergyDensityWithJ I tgt.ω (varying_J.J_seq n) u z)
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                    (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))))
  (hbar : Real) (hbar_pos : Real.instLT.lt 0 hbar)
  (h_sph :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) u Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le hbar (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u Set.univ))
  (h_le_reg : Real.instLE.le h (instHDiv.hDiv ε_reg 2)) (h_le_sph : Real.instLE.le h hbar) (h_1 : Real)
  (h_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 h_1) (ε_reg_1 : Real) (ε_reg_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg_1) (C_reg_1 : Real)
  (C_reg_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg_1)
  (h_reg_1 :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
        GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) u Set.univ →
          Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg_1 →
            ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                Real.instLE.le
                  (GromovCompactness.Extensions.riemannianEnergyDensityWithJ I tgt.ω (varying_J.J_seq n) u z)
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg_1 (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                    (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))))
  (hbar_1 : Real) (hbar_pos_1 : Real.instLT.lt 0 hbar_1)
  (h_sph_1 :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) u Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le hbar_1 (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u Set.univ))
  (h_le_reg_1 : Real.instLE.le h_1 (instHDiv.hDiv ε_reg_1 2)) (h_le_sph_1 : Real.instLE.le h_1 hbar_1),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { h := h, h_pos := h_pos, ε_reg := ε_reg, ε_reg_pos := ε_reg_pos, C_reg := C_reg, C_reg_pos := C_reg_pos,
        h_reg := h_reg, hbar := hbar, hbar_pos := hbar_pos, h_sph := h_sph, h_le_reg := h_le_reg, h_le_sph := h_le_sph }
      { h := h_1, h_pos := h_pos_1, ε_reg := ε_reg_1, ε_reg_pos := ε_reg_pos_1, C_reg := C_reg_1,

        h_le_reg := h_le_reg_1, h_le_sph := h_le_sph_1 })

doc:
When `B < th.ε_reg`, `cdata.S = ∅` automatically, so `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv`
holds with `0 sorryAx` whenever total energy converges along `cdata.σ` (or `cdata.σ.comp τ`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_lt_eps_reg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  Real.instLT.lt B th.ε_reg →
    Or
        (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))
        (Exists fun τ =>
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p)))) →
      Exists fun σ =>
        Exists fun res =>
          And
            (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
              (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                    Eq (frames w n)
                      ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                        (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                  ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (P.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))
