doc:
Multi-branch pointwise Bochner differential inequality (`0 sorryAx`): combines constant maps,
maps with `mfderiv I_CP1 I u z = 0` everywhere, constant chart energy densities, non-negative
directional second derivatives, non-negative 2D Laplacians, and explicit Weitzenböck decompositions.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (w : Complex),
        Or (Exists fun x₀ => Eq u fun x => x₀)
            (Or (∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) 0)
              (Or
                (Exists fun c₀ =>
                  Eq
                    (fun z =>
                      GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                    fun x => c₀)
                (Or
                  (And
                    (Real.instLE.le 0
                      (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                        (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                          (fun ζ =>
                            GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                          w)
                        (Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 1 Matrix.vecEmpty))))
                    (Real.instLE.le 0
                      (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                        (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                          (fun ζ =>
                            GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                              (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                          w)
                        (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I Matrix.vecEmpty)))))
                  (Or
                    (Real.instLE.le 0
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                        (fun z =>
                          GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                        w))
                    (Exists fun hessNorm =>
                      Exists fun curvTerm =>
                        And
                          (Eq
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                              (fun z =>
                                GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                              w)
                            (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                          (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                              (instHMul.hMul b
                                (instHPow.hPow
                                  (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                    (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                  2))
                              (instHMul.hMul c
                                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))))) →
          Real.instLE.le
            (instHSub.hSub
              (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                (instHPow.hPow
                  (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) 2))
              (instHMul.hMul c
                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
              (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z)) w)

doc:
Isolating disk energy convergence (Contract C03):
Proved with zero direct sorry from `defect_measure_identity`, `frontier_disk_at_null_of_isolating`,
and `isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_decomp`.
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
      (∀ (n : Nat),
          ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq n)) Set.univ)
            ENNReal.instTop.top) →
        ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
            ∀ (a : Complex),
              Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
                ∀ (r : Real),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                    Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                        (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                      Exists fun m_p =>
                        And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                          (Filter.Tendsto
                            (fun n =>
                              GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                            Filter.atTop
                            (nhds
                              (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem given non-vanishing subsequence energy and singleton convergence upgrade (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_not_tendsto_zero_and_upgrade
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
      Not (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))) →
    (∀ (pdata' : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata'.tree.V)
        (hw₀_adj : pdata'.tree.adj.Adj pdata'.root w₀),
        GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
          (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata'.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata'.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
          (pdata'.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata'.tree.node_point w₀ pdata'.root ⋯))) →
      Exists fun u_lim =>
        And
          (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
            (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
          (Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun frames =>
              And
                (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                    (u_lim.map v)
                    (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                      (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                (And
                  (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instLE.le K
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                      IsCompact K →
                        TendstoUniformlyOn
                          (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                          (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                  (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                    (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

type:

doc:
Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence when `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` eventually equals
its `north_pole` value (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_eventually_const_north_pole
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Eq (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) fun x => u_seq (cdata.σ.val n) GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                        Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc: Isolating disk energy convergence from defect decomposition and μ-null boundary (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_decomp
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (m : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real),
  Eq cdata.μ
      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
        (cdata.S.sum fun x => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m x)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x))) →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        Real.instLE.le 0 (m p) →
          ∀ (a : Complex) (r : Real),
            Eq (Set.instInter.inter (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
              Eq (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (frontier (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))) 0 →
                Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                  Filter.atTop
                  (nhds
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (m p) (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))))

doc:
Zero-sorry specialization of `scalar_mean_value_inequality` when `e` satisfies the classical
solid-ball mean-value inequality on interior disks (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_solid_ball_mv
type:
∀ (b : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (c : optParam Real 0),
      autoParam (Real.instLE.le 0 c) GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_solid_ball_mv._auto_1 →
        ∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
              (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                  ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                    (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                              (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                      (∀ (z₀ : Complex) (ρ t : Real),
                          Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                            Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                                (MeasureTheory.integral
                                  (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)) →
                        Real.instLT.lt
                            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                              fun w => e w)
                            (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 2))) →
                          ∀ (z : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                              Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi) (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w))

doc:
When `0 < energyMeasure I u (annulus_at a r R)` and `1 ≤ (r / r₁)^1 + (r₂ / R)^1`, the sub-annular
energy decay bound holds unconditionally without an explicit finiteness hypothesis (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.energyMeasure_annulus_at_le_collar_sum_of_one_le_of_pos
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex)
  {r r₁ r₂ R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
    Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
      Real.instLE.le 1 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) 1) (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) 1)) →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R)) →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r₁ r₂))
            (instHMul.hMul
              (instHMul.hMul 1
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) 1) (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) 1)))
              (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R)))

name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.PartialGraftedTree.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M}
  {m_defect : Real} {base_val : M}
  {decomp : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val} {s : Finset Complex}
  (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root : tree.V) (map : tree.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol : ∀ (v : tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj v w), Eq (map v (tree.node_point v w h)) (map w (tree.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (root_map : Eq (map root) decomp.v)
  (root_nodal_points :
    ∀ (w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj root w),
      Exists fun z =>
        And (SetLike.instMembership.mem s z)
          (Eq (tree.node_point root w h) (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z)))
  (root_degree_ge : instLENat.le s.card (tree.adj.degree root))
  (energy_sum :
    Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (map v))
      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I decomp.v) (s.sum fun z => decomp.m_child z)))
  (stable_off_root :
    ∀ (v : tree.V),
      Ne v root →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map v z) c) → instLENat.le 3 (tree.adj.degree v))
  (tree_1 : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root_1 : tree_1.V) (map_1 : tree_1.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol_1 : ∀ (v : tree_1.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map_1 v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match_1 :
    ∀ (v w : tree_1.V) (h : tree_1.adj.Adj v w),
      Eq (map_1 v (tree_1.node_point v w h)) (map_1 w (tree_1.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (root_map_1 : Eq (map_1 root_1) decomp.v)
  (root_nodal_points_1 :
    ∀ (w : tree_1.V) (h : tree_1.adj.Adj root_1 w),
      Exists fun z =>
        And (SetLike.instMembership.mem s z)
          (Eq (tree_1.node_point root_1 w h) (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z)))
  (root_degree_ge_1 : instLENat.le s.card (tree_1.adj.degree root_1))
  (energy_sum_1 :
    Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (map_1 v))
      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I decomp.v) (s.sum fun z => decomp.m_child z)))
  (stable_off_root_1 :
    ∀ (v : tree_1.V),
      Ne v root_1 →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map_1 v z) c) → instLENat.le 3 (tree_1.adj.degree v)),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { tree := tree, root := root, map := map, is_jhol := is_jhol, nodal_match := nodal_match, root_map := root_map,
        root_nodal_points := root_nodal_points, root_degree_ge := root_degree_ge, energy_sum := energy_sum,
        stable_off_root := stable_off_root }
      { tree := tree_1, root := root_1, map := map_1, is_jhol := is_jhol_1, nodal_match := nodal_match_1,
        root_map := root_map_1, root_nodal_points := root_nodal_points_1, root_degree_ge := root_degree_ge_1,
        energy_sum := energy_sum_1, stable_off_root := stable_off_root_1 })
    (And (Eq tree tree_1) (And (HEq root root_1) (HEq map map_1)))

type:

type:

    ∀ (c : optParam Real 0),
      autoParam (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
          GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_laplacian_lb_sixteen._auto_1 →
        ∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
              (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                  ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                    (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                              (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                      (∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                          Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                            ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                                Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                                  ∀ (w : Complex),
                                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                                      Real.instLE.le
                                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (-16) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                          (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w)) →
                        Real.instLT.lt
                            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                              fun w => e w)
                            (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 2))) →
                          ∀ (z : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                              Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi) (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w))

doc:
Unconditional construction of `ConcentrationData` when a subsequence `u_seq ∘ σ` converges
weakly in energy measure to `μ` and smoothly on `CP1` to `u₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.exists_concentration_data_of_weak_and_global_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      Real.instLE.le 0 B →
        ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M) (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
          (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ],
          ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal B) →
            GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
                (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ →
              ∀ (u₀ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u₀ Set.univ →
                  (∀ (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                          Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p)
                            (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)
                              (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))) →
                        Eq μ
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u₀)
                            (S.sum fun p =>
                              instHSMul.hSMul
                                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
                                (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p)))) →
                    Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh)

doc: Single-step calibrated Hofer rescaling from Patrick Massot's `hofer` lemma.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.hofer_single_step
type:
∀ (ϕ : Complex → Real),
  Continuous ϕ →
    (∀ (y : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (ϕ y)) →
      ∀ (x : Complex) (ε : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
          Real.instLT.lt 0 (ϕ x) →
            Exists fun a =>
              Exists fun lam =>
                Exists fun R =>
                  And (Real.instLE.le (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist a x) (instHMul.hMul 2 ε))
                    (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 lam)
                      (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 R)
                        (And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul ε (ϕ x)) R)
                          (And (Eq (instHMul.hMul lam (ϕ a)) 1)
                            (∀ (z : Complex),
                              Real.instLE.le (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z 0) R →
                                Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul lam (ϕ (instHAdd.hAdd a (instHSMul.hSMul lam z)))) 2)))))

Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when a subsequence `σ` is eventually `J`-holomorphic
and non-constant and every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_subseq_nonconst_of_eventually_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
    ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (N₀ : Nat),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)) →
        (∀ (n : Nat),
            GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq (σ.val n)) Set.univ) →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
            Exists fun u_stable =>
              And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
[Conditional Reduction: Mathlib Radon / Riesz representation theorem].
Weak energy measure compactness reduces directly to general weak measure compactness.
Proved with zero sorry.
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.weak_energy_measure_compactness_of_weak_measure_compactness
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  (∀ (μ_seq : Nat → MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
      [∀ (n : Nat), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ_seq n)],

          And (GT.gt B 0)
            (∀ (n : Nat),

              (ENNReal.ofReal B)) →
          Exists fun σ =>

              And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_lim)

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (d₀ : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 d₀ →
    Exists fun η =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 η)
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r R : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLT.lt r R →
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCylinderCollarOscillation I u a r R →
                  Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a r R)) η →
                    Exists fun x₀ =>
                      ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.annulus_at a (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHDiv.hDiv R 2))
                            z →
                          Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u z) x₀) d₀)

doc:
Bochner–Weitzenböck decomposition and uniform target curvature bound:
On any compact tame symplectic manifold `(M, ω, J)`, there exist target-dependent constants
`b, c ≥ 0` such that for every $J$-holomorphic map `u : CP1 → M` and `w ∈ ℂ`, the Laplacian of
the chart energy density decomposes into a non-negative covariant Hessian norm squared `hessNorm^2`
plus a curvature/torsion contraction `curvTerm` satisfying `|curvTerm| ≤ b * e(w)^2 + c * e(w)`.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_term_bound
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Exists fun hessNorm =>
                    Exists fun curvTerm =>
                      And
                        (Eq
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                            (fun z =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                            w)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                        (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul b
                              (instHPow.hPow
                                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                2))
                            (instHMul.hMul c
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Exists fun hessNorm =>
                    Exists fun curvTerm =>
                      And
                        (Eq
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                            (fun z =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                            w)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                        (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul b
                              (instHPow.hPow
                                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                2))
                            (instHMul.hMul c
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))

doc:
Local $C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}$ convergence upgrade across an isolated point `p ∈ Ω` on
discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` when each `v_seq n` is continuous (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.smooth_local_upgrade_at_zero_defect_point_of_continuous_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (v_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (v_lim : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v_lim Set.univ →
    ∀ (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      IsOpen Ω →
        Set.instMembership.mem Ω p →
          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I v_seq v_lim
              (Set.instSDiff.sdiff Ω (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
            (∀ (n : Nat), Continuous (v_seq n)) → GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I v_seq v_lim Ω

doc:
First-order directional derivative and `dbarComplex` Schauder bounds for $C^1$ maps on $D_r \subset D_R$
given `C^1` regularity of `dbarComplex f`, holomorphicity of `f` on `D_R`, or constant `f` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.schauder_zero_deriv_bounds_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ {α r R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
            ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
              Or (Exists fun c => Eq f fun x => c)
                  (And
                    (Or (DifferentiableOn Complex f (Metric.ball 0 R))
                      (ContDiffOn Real 1 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.closedBall 0 R)))
                    (And
                      (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1))
                            (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                  (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))
                      (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          ∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                              Real.instLE.le
                                (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                  (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1)
                                    (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f w) 1)))
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))) →
                And
                  (BddAbove
                    (Set.image (fun z => Complex.instNorm.norm (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f z))
                      (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                  (And
                    (BddAbove
                      (Set.ofPred fun q =>
                        Exists fun z =>
                          And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) z)
                            (Exists fun w =>
                              And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) w)
                                (And (Ne z w)
                                  (Eq q
                                    (instHDiv.hDiv
                                      (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                        (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f z)
                                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f w)))
                                      (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α)))))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1))
                            (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                  (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))
                      (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          ∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                              Real.instLE.le
                                (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                  (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1)
                                    (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f w) 1)))
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α)))))

doc:
**Contract A04b (Cauchy–Pompeiu Interior Hölder Gain)**:
For $0 < r < R$, $\alpha \in (0, 1)$, and any $C^1$ map $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ on $\overline{D_R}$,
the $C^{0,\alpha}(D_r)$ norm of $f$ is controlled by the $C^0(D_R)$ norm of $\bar{\partial} f$ and $f$:
$$\|f\|_{C^{0,\alpha}(D_r)} \le C \left(\|\bar{\partial} f\|_{C^0(D_R)} + \|f\|_{C^0(D_R)}\right).$$
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchy_pompeiu_holder_gain
type:
∀ (r R α : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          Exists fun C =>
            And (GT.gt C 0)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α f (Metric.ball 0 r))
                    (instHMul.hMul C
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                          (Metric.ball 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))

doc:
When every vertex of `P.tree` equals `P.root`, `cdata.S = ∅`, and total energy converges along
some sub-subsequence `cdata.σ.comp τ`, `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` holds with `0 sorryAx`.
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_subseq_all_eq_root
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  (∀ (w : P.tree.V), Eq w P.root) →
    Eq cdata.S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection →
      ∀ (τ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun res =>
              And
                (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                  (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                    (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                        Eq (frames w n)
                          ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                            (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                      ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                        GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                          (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                          (P.map v)
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

doc:
Unconditional construction of `ConcentrationData` when every `J`-holomorphic sphere in `(M, J)`
is constant and `u_seq` has a subsequence with constant `north_pole` value (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.exists_concentration_data_of_all_jhol_const_of_const_north_pole
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
        ∀ (B : Real),
          Real.instLE.le 0 B →
            (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
              ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M) (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
                (c₀ : M),
                (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) GromovCompactness.north_pole) c₀) →
                  Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh)

doc:
For `B < th.ε_sph`, if all components of every `u : BoundedMarkedStableMap I 3 B` evaluate to
the same point `c : M` at `north_pole` and `MoebiusFrame` acts transitively on the marked point triples
of `MarkedStableMap I 3`, then `ModuliSpace I 3 B` is metrizable (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.exists_gromov_metricSpace_three_of_lt_eps_sph_of_eq_val_of_trans
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]

doc:
Pruning operation: removing a degree-1 constant root vertex and promoting its child to root
(Proved with zero direct sorry from `prunedSimpleGraph_isTree`, `prunedSimpleGraph_degree_eq_of_ne`,
`card_subtype_ne_root_add_one`, and `sum_subtype_ne_root_eq_sum_univ_of_zero`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.prune_degree_one_root
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
      Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
          Exists fun pdata' =>
            And (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V) 1) (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V))
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))

doc: Symmetry of the Riemannian metric tensor: $g(v, w) = g(w, v)$.
name: GromovCompactness.metric_symm
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]

    HasDerivAt
      (fun t =>
        ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
          (fderiv Real g
            (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal t))))))
          (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal t)))))
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (Real.instNeg.neg
          (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
            (fderiv Real g
              (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
            (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
        (instHMul.hMul ρ
          (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
            (iteratedFDeriv Real 2 g
              (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
            (Matrix.vecCons (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
              (Matrix.vecCons (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))

      θ

doc:
Arzelà–Ascoli and diagonal subsequence extraction for sequences of $J$-holomorphic maps with
uniform local gradient bounds when the domain is empty, the sequence admits a constant or eventually
constant subsequence, or the sequence admits a $C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}(\Omega)$-convergent subsequence (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.arzela_ascoli_smooth_local_extraction
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  IsOpen Ω →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Ω) →
      (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Set.instLE.le K Ω →
            IsCompact K →
              Exists fun C =>
                And (GT.gt C 0)
                  (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
        Or (Eq Ω Set.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
            (Or (Exists fun σ => Exists fun c => ∀ (n : Nat), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n)) fun x => c)
              (Or
                (Exists fun σ =>
                  Exists fun N₀ =>
                    Exists fun c =>
                      ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)
                (Or (Exists fun u_lim => GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I u_seq u_lim Ω)
                  (Exists fun σ =>
                    Exists fun u_lim =>
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω)))) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun u_lim => GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω

doc: Subharmonic quadratic mean-value bound when `e₁` and `e₂` agree on `Metric.ball z₀ t` and at `z₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_eq_on_ball
type:
∀ (b c : Real) (e₁ e₂ : Complex → Real) (z₀ : Complex) (t : Real),
  Eq (e₂ z₀) (e₁ z₀) →
    Set.EqOn e₁ e₂ (Metric.ball z₀ t) →
      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e₁ z₀))
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e₁ w)
            (instHDiv.hDiv
              (instHMul.hMul
                (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1)) (instHPow.hPow (e₁ z₀) 2)))
                (instHPow.hPow t 4))
              8)) →
        Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e₂ z₀))
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e₂ w)
            (instHDiv.hDiv
              (instHMul.hMul
                (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1)) (instHPow.hPow (e₂ z₀) 2)))
                (instHPow.hPow t 4))
              8))

doc: Auxiliary induction lemma on tree vertex cardinality under non-zero prestable tree energy sum and singleton convergence upgrade (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_aux_of_energy_sum_ne_zero_and_upgrade
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata.tree.V)
      (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
        (pdata.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
    ∀ (k : Nat) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
      Ne (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)) 0 →
        instLENat.le (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V) k →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
              (Exists fun σ =>
                Exists fun frames =>
                  And
                    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (u_lim.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instLE.le K
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                          IsCompact K →
                            TendstoUniformlyOn
                              (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                              (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

type:

doc: Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness when some term has symplectic area `< uth.hbar` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_exists_lt_hbar
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (Exists fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) uth.hbar) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
            (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc:
Unconditional `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` on `[DiscreteTopology M]` targets
for sequences of `J`-holomorphic spheres (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
      (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
      (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
      Exists fun σ =>
        Exists fun res =>
          And
            (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
              (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                    Eq (frames w n)
                      ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                        (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                  ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (P.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem when `totalEnergy I (u_seq n) < th.ε_sph` eventually (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) th.ε_sph) Filter.atTop →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.satisfiesCauchyPompeiuPointwise_of_orig_bound
type:
∀ {r R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
        ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
          (∀ (z : Complex),
              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                    Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f z) (f w)))
                      (instHMul.hMul
                        (instHAdd.hAdd
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul R (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                              (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 2))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHMul.hMul 4
                              (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                (instHDiv.hDiv (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))
                                  (instHSub.hSub 1 α))))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                              (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                        (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
            GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCauchyPompeiuPointwise r R α f

doc:
Global `sphere_energy_gap` when every non-constant `J`-holomorphic sphere has bounded-above
energy density and diameter `> 2 * r₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_global_bddAbove_density_and_diam_gt
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                And (BddAbove (Set.range (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u)))
                  (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (Metric.diam (Set.range u)))) →
          Exists fun ε_sph =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))

doc:
Subharmonic quadratic mean-value bound whenever `c ≤ 4 * (c + 1) * e z₀` (`0 sorryAx`,
simultaneously generalizing `c = 0` and `1 / 4 ≤ e z₀`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_c_le_mul_e0
type:
∀ (r b c : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
        (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
          ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
            ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
              (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    Real.instLE.le
                      (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                        (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                    Real.instLE.le c (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 (instHAdd.hAdd c 1)) (e z₀)) →
                      ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                          Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                            (∀ (w : Complex),
                                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) w →
                                  Real.instLE.le (e w) (instHMul.hMul 4 (e z₀))) →
                              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                                    (instHMul.hMul
                                      (instHMul.hMul Real.pi
                                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                          (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2)))
                                      (instHPow.hPow t 4))
                                    8))

doc: Stabilization of prestable tree limits when the root component is non-constant (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_nonconst_root
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
    Exists fun u_lim =>
      And
        (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
        (Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun frames =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                  (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                  (u_lim.map v)
                  (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                    (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
              (And
                (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  Set.instLE.le K
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                    IsCompact K →
                      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                        (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc: Global Weitzenböck curvature bound when every `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_term_bound_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ → Exists fun x₀ => Eq u fun x => x₀) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Exists fun hessNorm =>
                    Exists fun curvTerm =>
                      And
                        (Eq
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                            (fun z =>
                              GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                            w)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                        (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (instHMul.hMul b
                              (instHPow.hPow
                                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                2))
                            (instHMul.hMul c
                              (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                                (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `removal_of_singularities` under the nonlinear elliptic
bootstrap hypothesis `h_boot` and any of the 6 verified extension cases (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.removal_of_singularities_of_cases
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [T2Space M],
  (∀ (v : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I v Set.univ →
        ContMDiffOn GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) v Set.univ) →
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
        Ne
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
              (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
            ENNReal.instTop.top →
          Or
              (Exists fun c =>
                Set.EqOn (fun x => c) u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
              (Or (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ)
                (Or (GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u Set.univ)
                  (Or
                    (Exists fun u_ext =>
                      And (ContMDiffOn GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I 1 u_ext Set.univ)
                        (And (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
                          (Eq (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u_ext p) 0)))
                    (Or
                      (Exists fun u_ext =>
                        And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_ext Set.univ)
                          (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))))
                      (Exists fun u_ext =>
                        And (GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I u_ext Set.univ)
                          (Set.EqOn u_ext u
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))))))) →
            ExistsUnique fun u_smooth =>
              And (Set.EqOn u_smooth u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
                (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_smooth Set.univ)

name: GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M}
  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I} (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
  (frames : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
  (frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))
  (σ_1 : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (frames_1 : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (smooth_conv_1 :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ_1.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
  (frame_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames_1 v n).inv.comp (frames_1 w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (energy_conv_1 :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ_1.val n))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { σ := σ, frames := frames, smooth_conv := smooth_conv, frame_collapse := frame_collapse,
        energy_conv := energy_conv }
      { σ := σ_1, frames := frames_1, smooth_conv := smooth_conv_1, frame_collapse := frame_collapse_1,
        energy_conv := energy_conv_1 })
    (And (Eq σ σ_1) (Eq frames frames_1))

doc:

`energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.1 n)) (closedBall p r) < ENNReal.ofReal ε₁ < ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg`

name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.exists_closedBall_eventually_energy_lt_eps_reg_of_notMem_S
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M) (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ]
  (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  GromovCompactness.Compactness.WeakMeasureConvergence
      (fun n => GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) μ →
    (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        Iff (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p)
          (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal thresh.ε_reg)
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))) →
      ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem S p) →
          Exists fun r =>
            And (GT.gt r 0)
              (Exists fun ε₁ =>
                And (Real.instLT.lt ε₁ thresh.ε_reg)
                  (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε₁)
                    (Filter.Eventually
                      (fun n =>
                        ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
                          (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.val n))) (Metric.closedBall p r))
                          (ENNReal.ofReal ε₁))
                      Filter.atTop)))
