Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` when `thresh.h / 2 < m_defect` and some `J`-holomorphic
term `u_seq n₀` has total energy strictly below `thresh.h` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_gt_half_h_of_exists_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) thresh.h →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (And
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                          η)
                                        (Real.instLT.lt
                                          (Metric.diam
                                            (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                          η))))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    Or
        (Exists fun N₀ =>
          Exists fun ε =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε)
              (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLE.le ε (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)))))
        (And
          (Exists fun ε_sph =>
            And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                    Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)))
          (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ)) →
      Not (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `exists_one_level_decomposition` from a bubble with children
strictly inside the unit disk (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.exists_one_level_decomposition_of_children_in_unit_disk
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (_res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (base_val : M),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => u_seq n (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (_res.a n))) Filter.atTop
          (nhds base_val) →
        ∀ (v : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ →
            ∀ (q : Finset Complex),
              (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm z) 1) →
                ∀ (m_child : Complex → Real),
                  (∀ (z : Complex), SetLike.instMembership.mem q z → Real.instLE.le thresh.h (m_child z)) →
                    (∀ (z : Complex), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem q z) → Eq (m_child z) 0) →
                      Eq m_defect (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v) (q.sum fun z => m_child z)) →
                        Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val →
                          Eq
                              (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v)
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)))
                              (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) →
                            Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)

  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
      (Exists fun N₀ =>
          ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) 0) →
        Exists fun m =>
          And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
              SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
            (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)

                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)

globally weak `J`-holomorphic sphere on `CP1` is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.removal_of_singularities_of_all_weak_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [T2Space M],
  (∀ (v : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Analysis.WeakJHolomorphicOn I v Set.univ → Exists fun c => Eq v fun x => c) →
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
        Ne
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
              (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))

Unconditional `neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound` when `thresh.h ≤ m_defect` and some `J`-holomorphic
term `u_seq n₀` has non-positive total energy (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_ge_h_of_exists_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) 0 →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                        Set.instMembership.mem
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                          Set.instMembership.mem
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                              w →
                                            Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

      Exists fun u_lim =>
        And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim))
          (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
          have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
          And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
            (And

                And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                  (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))

doc:
Stability condition for unmarked curves ($k = 0$): any component on which $u_v$ is constant
("ghost bubble") must have at least 3 special points (nodal attachments) $\operatorname{deg}(v) \ge 3$
so that its biholomorphic automorphism group in $\operatorname{PSL}(2, \mathbb{C})$ fixing nodal points is finite.
Note on unmarked vs marked curves:
- For unmarked curves ($k = 0$, the primary track of this formalization), special points are strictly nodal points,
  so $\operatorname{deg}_{\text{nodal}}(v) \ge 3$.
- For $k$-marked curves ($k > 0$, extension track E03/E04), marked points also stabilize ghost spheres;
  the general stability condition is $\operatorname{deg}_{\text{nodal}}(v) + k_v \ge 3$, where $k_v$ is the number
  of marked points on component $v$. Under that condition, a ghost component may have nodal degree 0, 1, or 2.
name: GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit.stable
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (self : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I)
  (v : self.tree.V),
  (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (self.map v z) c) → instLENat.le 3 (self.tree.adj.degree v)

doc:
Whenever both directional second derivatives of the stereographic chart energy density at `w`
are non-negative and `b, c ≥ 0`, the Weitzenböck decomposition holds (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_curvature_decomposition_of_directional_second_deriv_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (w : Complex),
        Real.instLE.le 0
            (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
              (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                (fun ζ => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                w)
              (Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 1 Matrix.vecEmpty))) →
          Real.instLE.le 0
              (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
                (iteratedFDeriv Real 2
                  (fun ζ =>
                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' ζ))
                  w)
                (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I (Matrix.vecCons Complex.I Matrix.vecEmpty))) →
            Exists fun hessNorm =>
              Exists fun curvTerm =>
                And
                  (Eq
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow hessNorm 2) curvTerm))
                  (Real.instLE.le (abs curvTerm)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (instHMul.hMul b
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
                          (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)))))

doc: Isolating disk energy convergence on subsingleton targets when `B ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)

    ∀ (v w₁ w₂ : V) (h₁ : adj.Adj v w₁) (h₂ : adj.Adj v w₂), Ne w₁ w₂ → Ne (node_point v w₁ h₁) (node_point v w₂ h₂))
  (V_1 : Type) (fintypeV_1 : Fintype V_1) (nonemptyV_1 : Nonempty V_1) (adj_1 : SimpleGraph V_1)
  (is_tree_1 : adj_1.IsTree) (node_point_1 : (v w : V_1) → adj_1.Adj v w → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
  (node_distinct_1 :
    ∀ (v w₁ w₂ : V_1) (h₁ : adj_1.Adj v w₁) (h₂ : adj_1.Adj v w₂),
      Ne w₁ w₂ → Ne (node_point_1 v w₁ h₁) (node_point_1 v w₂ h₂)),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { V := V, fintypeV := fintypeV, nonemptyV := nonemptyV, adj := adj, is_tree := is_tree, node_point := node_point,
        node_distinct := node_distinct }
      { V := V_1, fintypeV := fintypeV_1, nonemptyV := nonemptyV_1, adj := adj_1, is_tree := is_tree_1,
        node_point := node_point_1, node_distinct := node_distinct_1 })
    (And (Eq V V_1) (And (HEq fintypeV fintypeV_1) (And (HEq adj adj_1) (HEq node_point node_point_1))))

doc: First-order directional derivative and `dbarComplex` Schauder bounds for constant maps `fun _ => c` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.schauder_zero_deriv_bounds_const
type:
∀ {α r R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ (c : Complex),
            And
              (BddAbove
                (Set.image (fun z => Complex.instNorm.norm (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex (fun x => c) z))
                  (Metric.ball 0 R)))
              (And
                (BddAbove
                  (Set.ofPred fun q =>
                    Exists fun z =>
                      And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) z)
                        (Exists fun w =>
                          And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) w)
                            (And (Ne z w)
                              (Eq q
                                (instHDiv.hDiv
                                  (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                    (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex (fun x => c) z)
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex (fun x => c) w)))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α)))))))
                (And
                  (∀ (z : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                      Real.instLE.le
                        (Complex.instNorm.norm (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (fun x => c) z) 1))
                        (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                          (instHAdd.hAdd
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex fun x => c) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (fun x => c) (Metric.ball 0 R)))))
                  (∀ (z : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                      ∀ (w : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (Complex.instNorm.norm
                              (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (fun x => c) z) 1)
                                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real (fun x => c) w) 1)))
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                                (instHAdd.hAdd
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex fun x => c) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (fun x => c) (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                              (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α)))))

doc:
Zero-sorry core Gromov compactness from a prestable limit when the sequence is non-constant
$J$-holomorphic, the sphere energy gap holds, and singleton nodal convergence holds (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_core_of_prestable_jhol_gap_and_upgrade
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
      (Exists fun h_s =>
          And (GT.gt h_s 0)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                  GE.ge (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) h_s)) →
        (∀ (pdata' : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (w₀ : pdata'.tree.V)
            (hw₀_adj : pdata'.tree.adj.Adj pdata'.root w₀),
            GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
              (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata'.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata'.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
              (pdata'.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata'.tree.node_point w₀ pdata'.root ⋯))) →
          Exists fun u_lim => Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim)

doc: Unconditional Bochner differential inequality on subsingleton targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M],
  Exists fun b =>
    Exists fun c =>
      And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
        (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              ∀ (w : Complex),
                Real.instLE.le
                  (instHSub.hSub
                    (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                      (instHPow.hPow
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                        2))
                    (instHMul.hMul c
                      (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                    (fun z =>
                      GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                    w)))

doc: Unconditional defect measure identity when `B < thresh.h` on any target manifold `M` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.defect_measure_identity_of_B_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        ∀ (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
          (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
          Real.instLT.lt B thresh.h →
            Exists fun m =>
              And
                (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
                (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
                  (And
                    (Eq cdata.μ
                      (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                        (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

doc:
Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness when `varying_J.J_seq n₀ = tgt.J` for some `n₀`
and every `tgt.J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_eq_target_J_at_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
        Eq (varying_J.J_seq n₀) tgt.J →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And
                (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
                (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
                  (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
                  have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
                  And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                    (And
                      (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                        And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                          (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                      (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                        (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc:
Closedness of the two-form: `dω = 0`.
In every chart, the exterior derivative (cyclic sum of directional Fréchet derivatives)
vanishes at every point `y ∈ chart.target`.
name: GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget.ω_closed
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {inst : NormedAddCommGroup E} {inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E} {H : Type u_2}
  {inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H} {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_4} {inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M}

  Set.instMembership.mem (extChartAt I x).target y →
    ∀ (v₁ v₂ v₃ : E),
      let dω_y := fderiv Real (GromovCompactness.ω_chart I self.ω x) y;
      Eq
        (instHAdd.hAdd
          (instHAdd.hAdd
            (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe dω_y v₁) v₂) v₃)
            (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe dω_y v₂) v₃) v₁))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
            (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe dω_y v₃) v₁) v₂))
        0

type:

doc: Unconditional cylinder exponential decay on subsingleton targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.cylinder_exponential_decay_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M],
  Exists fun C₀ =>
    Exists fun a_decay =>
      Exists fun ε_neck =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 C₀)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay)
            (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck)
              (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                  Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))
                          ε_neck →
                        ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                          Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                            Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                              Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                                Real.instLE.le
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                  (instHMul.hMul
                                    (instHMul.hMul C₀
                                      (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                                        (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))))))

type:

doc: Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness on `[DiscreteTopology M]` targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M]
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        Exists fun u_stable =>
          And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
            (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
            have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
            And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
              (And
                (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                  And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                    (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                  (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound` on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]`
when each `u_seq n` is `J`-holomorphic (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_jhol_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                              (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                Set.instMembership.mem
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                  Set.instMembership.mem
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) w →
                                    Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc: Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence when `cdata.μ = 0` (`0 sorryAx`, since `cdata.S = ∅`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_mu_eq_zero
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Eq cdata.μ 0 →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                        Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_lt_half_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) →
    ∀ (η : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
        Exists fun R₀ =>
          And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
            (∀ (R : Real),
              GE.ge R R₀ →
                Exists fun δ₀ =>
                  And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                    (∀ (δ : Real),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                        Exists fun N =>
                          ∀ (n : Nat),
                            GE.ge n N →
                              And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                  Set.instMembership.mem
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                    Set.instMembership.mem
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) w →
                                      Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc:
Frame transition collapse (PDF §2.3 condition 2): for adjacent components $v \sim w$,
$$\phi_{v, n}^{-1} \circ \phi_{w, n} \longrightarrow z_{vw} \quad \text{locally uniformly on } \mathbb{CP}^1 \setminus \{z_{wv}\}.$$
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData.frame_collapse
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M}
  (self : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq) (v w : self.tree.V) (h : self.tree.adj.Adj v w)
  (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  Set.instLE.le K (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (self.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
    IsCompact K →
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((self.frames v n).inv.comp (self.frames w n)).toHomeo)
        (fun x => self.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K

doc:
Target Monotonicity Formula on subsingleton targets (`0 sorryAx`):
when `[Subsingleton M]` holds, every map `u : CP1 → M` is constant, so the non-constancy hypothesis
is vacuously false and `target_monotonicity` holds unconditionally.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_subsingleton
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M],
  Exists fun c =>
    Exists fun r₀ =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 c)
        (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀)
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
              Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
                Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                    Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                      (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                        Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))))

doc:
When every vertex of `P.tree` equals `P.root`, `cdata.S = ∅`, and total energy converges along
`cdata.σ`, `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` holds with `0 sorryAx`.
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_all_eq_root
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  (∀ (w : P.tree.V), Eq w P.root) →
    Eq cdata.S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))) →
        Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun res =>
            And
              (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                  (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                      Eq (frames w n)
                        ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                          (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                    ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (P.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
              (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

doc:

type:

doc:
When `‖a‖ + r ≤ 1` and `u` has continuous chart energy density, the Euclidean ball integral
of the translated chart energy density is bounded above by `energyMeasure I u (disk_at a r)` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.integral_translated_density_le_energyMeasure_of_norm_add_le_one
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
  (Continuous fun w => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) →
    Real.instLE.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Complex.instNorm.norm a) r) 1 →
      Real.instLE.le
        (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w =>
          GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u
            (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' (instHAdd.hAdd a w)))
        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))

doc:

doc:
Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when a subsequence `σ` consists of non-constant maps
and `totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n)) < th.ε_sph` eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_subseq_nonconst_of_eventually_lt_eps_sph
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
      ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)) →
          Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) th.ε_sph)
              Filter.atTop →
            Exists fun u_stable =>
              And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

doc:
Pointwise Bochner differential inequality on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` for any
continuous map `u : CP1 → M` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_continuous_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [DiscreteTopology M] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_6 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M]
  [inst_7 : CompactSpace M] [inst_8 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {b c : Real},
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    Real.instLE.le 0 c →
      ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        Continuous u →
          ∀ (w : Complex),
            Real.instLE.le
              (instHSub.hSub
                (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                  (instHPow.hPow
                    (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) 2))
                (instHMul.hMul c
                  (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                w)

type:

  (∀ (v : lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I lim v →
        ∀ (aut : GromovCompactness.Extensions.PureComponentAutomorphism I lim),
          Eq (aut.val.frame v).toHomeo (Homeomorph.refl GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)) →

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph thresh.ε_reg →
    Eq cdata.μ
        (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
          (cdata.S.sum fun p =>
            instHSMul.hSMul (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe cdata.μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))

      Exists fun m =>
        And
          (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
          (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)
            (Eq cdata.μ
              (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]

  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  Real.instLT.lt (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2) m_defect →
    ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n₀)) 0 →
          ∀ (η : Real),
            Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
              Exists fun R₀ =>
                And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
                  (∀ (R : Real),
                    GE.ge R R₀ →
                      Exists fun δ₀ =>
                        And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                          (∀ (δ : Real),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                              Exists fun N =>
                                ∀ (n : Nat),
                                  GE.ge n N →
                                    And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                      (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                        Set.instMembership.mem
                                            (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                          Set.instMembership.mem
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                              w →
                                            Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc:
Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness when a subsequence `σ` is eventually non-constant
and `J_{σ.1 n}`-holomorphic and every `J_{σ.1 N₀}`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real) (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat),
        GE.ge n N₀ →
          GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq (σ.val n)) (u_seq (σ.val n)) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq (σ.val N₀)) u Set.univ →
            Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
            (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc:
When `B < 2 * th.h`, `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` holds with `0 sorryAx`
whenever total energy converges along `cdata.σ` (or `cdata.σ.comp τ`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_lt_two_mul_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  Real.instLT.lt B (instHMul.hMul 2 th.h) →
    Or
        (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))
        (Exists fun τ =>
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p)))) →
      Exists fun σ =>
        Exists fun res =>
          And
            (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
              (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                    Eq (frames w n)
                      ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                        (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                  ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (P.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

doc:

is eventually globally continuous on `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.local_smooth_compactness_of_eventually_continuous_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [DiscreteTopology M] [inst_5 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_6 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M]
  [inst_7 : CompactSpace M] [inst_8 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (Ω : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  IsOpen Ω →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Ω) →
      (∀ (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Set.instLE.le K Ω →
            IsCompact K →
              Exists fun C =>
                And (GT.gt C 0)
                  (∀ (n : Nat) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I (u_seq n) z) C)) →
        (Exists fun N₀ => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Continuous (u_seq n)) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And (GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (σ.val n)) u_lim Ω)
                (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_lim Ω)

doc:
First-order directional derivative and `dbarComplex` Schauder bounds when `f` is holomorphic on `ball 0 R`
and satisfies the first-order Cauchy derivative estimates on `ball 0 r` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.schauder_zero_deriv_bounds_of_differentiableOn
type:
∀ {α r R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
        ContDiffOn Real 1 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
          DifferentiableOn Complex f (Metric.ball 0 R) →
            (∀ (z : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                  Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1))
                    (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                      (instHAdd.hAdd
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                          (Metric.ball 0 R))
                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))) →
              (∀ (z : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                    ∀ (w : Complex),
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                        Real.instLE.le
                          (Complex.instNorm.norm
                            (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1)
                              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f w) 1)))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                  (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                            (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
                And
                  (BddAbove
                    (Set.image (fun z => Complex.instNorm.norm (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f z))
                      (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                  (And
                    (BddAbove
                      (Set.ofPred fun q =>
                        Exists fun z =>
                          And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) z)
                            (Exists fun w =>
                              And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) w)
                                (And (Ne z w)
                                  (Eq q
                                    (instHDiv.hDiv
                                      (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                        (instHSub.hSub (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f z)
                                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f w)))
                                      (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α)))))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1))
                            (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                              (instHAdd.hAdd
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                                  (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R)))))
                      (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          ∀ (w : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) w →
                              Real.instLE.le
                                (Complex.instNorm.norm
                                  (instHSub.hSub (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f z) 1)
                                    (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f w) 1)))
                                (instHMul.hMul
                                  (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α)
                                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α
                                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball 0 R))
                                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn f (Metric.ball 0 R))))
                                  (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α)))))

doc:
Unconditional extraction of a varying-`J` stable limit when `varying_J.J_seq n₀ = tgt.J` for some `n₀`
and every `tgt.J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_varying_J_stable_limit_of_eq_target_J_at_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      ∀ (n₀ : Nat),
        Eq (varying_J.J_seq n₀) tgt.J →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
            Exists fun u_lim =>
              And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
                (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                  GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v →
                    Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))

type:

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.CalibratedRescaling.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M}
  {thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M} {m_defect : Real} (a : Nat → Complex)
  (a_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) («λ» : Nat → Real)
  (scale_pos : ∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLT.lt 0 («λ» n)) (scale_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto «λ» Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (calibrated_energy :
    ∀ (n : Nat),
      Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.disk_at (a n) («λ» n)))
        (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)))
  (a_1 : Nat → Complex) (a_tendsto_1 : Filter.Tendsto a_1 Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) («λ_1» : Nat → Real)
  (scale_pos_1 : ∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLT.lt 0 («λ_1» n)) (scale_tendsto_1 : Filter.Tendsto «λ_1» Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (calibrated_energy_1 :
    ∀ (n : Nat),
      Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n) (GromovCompactness.disk_at (a_1 n) («λ_1» n)))
        (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2))),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { a := a, a_tendsto := a_tendsto, «λ» := «λ», scale_pos := scale_pos, scale_tendsto := scale_tendsto,
        calibrated_energy := calibrated_energy }
      { a := a_1, a_tendsto := a_tendsto_1, «λ» := «λ_1», scale_pos := scale_pos_1, scale_tendsto := scale_tendsto_1,
        calibrated_energy := calibrated_energy_1 })
    (And (Eq a a_1) (Eq «λ» «λ_1»))

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `sphere_energy_gap` when `riemannianEnergyDensity I u` is
bounded above and `2 * r₀ < Metric.diam (Set.range u)` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_bddAbove_density_and_diam_gt
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              BddAbove (Set.range (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u)) →
                Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (Metric.diam (Set.range u)) →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r₀ 2)) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

If $a t^2 + 2 b t + c \ge 0$ for all $t \in \mathbb{R}$, and $a > 0$,

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.norm_iteratedFDeriv_sub_le_holder_of_contDiffOn
type:
∀ (m : Nat) {g : Complex → Complex} {R α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 R →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
      Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
        ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd m.cast 1) g (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
          ∀ {z w : Complex},
            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) z →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 R) w →
                Real.instLE.le
                  (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm
                    (instHSub.hSub (iteratedFDeriv Real m g z) (iteratedFDeriv Real m g w)))
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (instHMul.hMul
                      (Real.instSupSet.sSup
                        (Set.image
                          (fun ζ =>
                            ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm (iteratedFDeriv Real (instHAdd.hAdd m 1) g ζ))
                          (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                      (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 R) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                    (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedCompactnessWitness.isEmpty_of_lt_three_of_all_jhol_const
type:

doc: Unconditional `neck_vanishing_quantified` when every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_vanishing_quantified_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
        GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
          Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
      ∀ (η : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
          Exists fun R₀ =>
            And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
              (∀ (R : Real),
                GE.ge R R₀ →
                  Exists fun δ₀ =>
                    And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                      (∀ (δ : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                          Exists fun N =>
                            ∀ (n : Nat),
                              GE.ge n N →
                                And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                  (And
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                      η)
                                    (Real.instLT.lt
                                      (Metric.diam
                                        (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                      η))))

doc:
Zero-sorry specialization of `scalar_mean_value_inequality` when `e` vanishes on
`Metric.closedBall 0 (r / 2)` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_eq_zero_on_closedBall
type:
∀ (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
      (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
        (∀ (z : Complex), Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z → Eq (e z) 0) →
          ∀ (z : Complex),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
              Real.instLE.le (e z)
                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi) (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))

                    e w))

doc: Unconditional Genus 0 Gromov Compactness when `totalEnergy I (u_seq n) < th.h` eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.gromov_compactness_genus_zero_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) th.h) Filter.atTop →
          Exists fun u_stable =>
            And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_stable v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_stable.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) 2)))))

type:

  (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (map : tree.V → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (is_jhol : ∀ (v : tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (map v) Set.univ)
  (nodal_match :
    ∀ (v w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj v w), Eq (map v (tree.node_point v w h)) (map w (tree.node_point w v ⋯)))
  (stable :
    ∀ (v : tree.V),
      (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (map v z) c) → instLENat.le 3 (tree.adj.degree v)),

doc:
Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence when `u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)` eventually has
`totalEnergy ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`, since `cdata.S = ∅`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_eventually_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
      (Exists fun N₀ =>
          ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) 0) →
        ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
            ∀ (a : Complex),
              Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
                ∀ (r : Real),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                    Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                        (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                      Exists fun m_p =>
                        And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                          (Filter.Tendsto
                            (fun n =>
                              GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                            Filter.atTop
                            (nhds
                              (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc:
**Symplectic Area Identity for Sequences with Constant Area (Zero-sorry)**.
If a sequence of $J$-holomorphic curves has constant symplectic area $\mathcal{A}$
(such as curves representing a fixed homology class $[u_n] = A$), then the limit tree
satisfies the exact area identity:
$$\mathcal{A} = \sum_{v \in V(T)} \int_{S^2} u_{\infty, v}^* \omega = \sum_{v \in V(T)} E(u_{\infty, v}).$$
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.symplectic_area_identity_of_const_area
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (wit : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (A_area : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) A_area) →
        And (Eq (GromovCompactness.Extensions.treeSymplecticArea I u_lim) A_area)
          (Eq (GromovCompactness.sphereTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim) A_area)

doc:
Zero-sorry conditional reduction of `sphere_energy_gap` when the stereographic chart energy
density is bounded above and `2 * r₀ < Metric.diam (Set.range u)` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.sphere_energy_gap_of_bddAbove_chart_density_and_diam_gt
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {c r₀ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀ →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
                    (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                      Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                        (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Not (Exists fun c₀ => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c₀) →
              BddAbove
                  (Set.range fun w =>
                    GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w)) →
                Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r₀) (Metric.diam (Set.range u)) →
                  Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r₀ 2)) (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

doc: Trace scaling identity for C-linear maps: the 2D Dirichlet trace is invariant under J-commutation.
name: GromovCompactness.metric_c_linear_trace_scaling
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
