doc: Master Stabilization Theorem when some input map `u_seq n` has non-positive energy (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_exists_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (Exists fun n => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) 0) →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
            (Exists fun σ =>
              Exists fun frames =>
                And
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                      (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                      (u_lim.map v)
                      (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                        (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                      Set.instLE.le K
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                        IsCompact K →
                          TendstoUniformlyOn
                            (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                    (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc: Target Monotonicity Formula when every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere `u : CP1 → M` is constant (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
    Exists fun c =>
      Exists fun r₀ =>
        And (Real.instLT.lt 0 c)
          (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r₀)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Real.instLE.le r r₀ →
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                        (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul c (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))))

is constant (`0 sorryAx`, since `cdata.S = ∅`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_all_jhol_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
        ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
            ∀ (a : Complex),
              Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
                ∀ (r : Real),
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                    Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                        (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                      Exists fun m_p =>
                        And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                          (Filter.Tendsto
                            (fun n =>
                              GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                            Filter.atTop
                            (nhds
                              (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                                (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))

doc:
Zero-sorry specialization of `scalar_mean_value_inequality` when every interior maximum
satisfies `1 / 4 ≤ e z₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_one_fourth_le
type:
∀ (b : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (c : optParam Real 0),
      autoParam (Real.instLE.le 0 c) GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_one_fourth_le._auto_1 →
        ∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
              (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                  ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                    (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                              (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                      (∀ (z₀ : Complex), Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) → Real.instLE.le (1 / 4) (e z₀)) →
                        Real.instLT.lt
                            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                              fun w => e w)
                            (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 2))) →
                          ∀ (z : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                              Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi) (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w))

doc:
Conditional reduction of Contract A12 to Contract A11 (`puncture_sobolev_extension`) +
continuous-to-smooth bootstrap step (`h_bootstrap_ext`).
Note (Conditional Reduction per COMPLETION_PLAN.md §0 & §2 P0-9):
Takes open statements (`h_sobolev_ext`, `h_bootstrap_ext`) as explicit hypotheses and does not count
as closing Contract A12 until the hypotheses are discharged.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.removal_of_singularities_reduction
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [T2Space M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
        Ne
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
              (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
            ENNReal.instTop.top →
          Exists fun u_ext =>
            And (Continuous u_ext)
              (Set.EqOn u_ext u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))) →
    (∀ (u_ext : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
        Continuous u_ext →
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_ext
              (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_ext Set.univ) →
      (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Dense (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u
              (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)) →
            Ne
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
                  (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
                ENNReal.instTop.top →
              ExistsUnique fun u_smooth =>
                And (Set.EqOn u_smooth u (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p)))
                  (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u_smooth Set.univ)

doc:
Global Bochner differential inequality when every `J`-holomorphic sphere has constant
stereographic chart energy density (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.bochner_differential_inequality_of_global_const_chart
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Exists fun c₀ =>
          Eq (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
            fun x => c₀) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)))

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh),
  (Exists fun N₀ => ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Exists fun c => Eq (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) fun x => c) →
    (Exists fun c₀ => Eq cdata.u₀ fun x => c₀) →
      Exists fun m =>
        And
          (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p → Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph (m p))
          (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)

                (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀)
                  (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))

      ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq (σ.val n) z) c)) →
          (Exists fun n => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) 0) →
            Exists fun u_stable =>
              And (Nonempty (GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_stable))
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_stable v);

∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat}
  {u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k}
  {u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k} (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
  (frames : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (smooth_conv :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)).map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
  (frame_collapse :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (mark_conv :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames (u_lim.mark_vertex i) n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq (σ.val n)).points i))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (u_lim.mark_point i)))
  (energy_conv :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n)).map) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim)))
  (σ_1 : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (frames_1 : u_lim.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame)
  (smooth_conv_1 :
    ∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ_1.val n)).map (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 v n).toHomeo)) (u_lim.map v)
        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
  (frame_collapse_1 :
    ∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      Set.instLE.le K
          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
        IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames_1 v n).inv.comp (frames_1 w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
  (mark_conv_1 :
    ∀ (i : Fin k),
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames_1 (u_lim.mark_vertex i) n).inv.toHomeo ((u_seq (σ_1.val n)).points i))
        Filter.atTop (nhds (u_lim.mark_point i)))
  (energy_conv_1 :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ_1.val n)).map) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim))),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { σ := σ, frames := frames, smooth_conv := smooth_conv, frame_collapse := frame_collapse, mark_conv := mark_conv,
        energy_conv := energy_conv }
      { σ := σ_1, frames := frames_1, smooth_conv := smooth_conv_1, frame_collapse := frame_collapse_1,
        mark_conv := mark_conv_1, energy_conv := energy_conv_1 })
    (And (Eq σ σ_1) (Eq frames frames_1))

doc: Coordinate and chart invariance of $J$-holomorphicity under biholomorphic reparametrization.
name: GromovCompactness.jholomorphic_coordinate_invariance
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  {E_dom : Type u_4} [inst_7 : NormedAddCommGroup E_dom] [inst_8 : NormedSpace Real E_dom] {H_dom : Type u_5}
  [inst_9 : TopologicalSpace H_dom] (I_dom : ModelWithCorners Real E_dom H_dom) {«Σ» : Type u_6}
  [inst_10 : TopologicalSpace «Σ»] [inst_11 : ChartedSpace H_dom «Σ»]
  [inst_12 : IsManifold I_dom (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) «Σ»] [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  [dom : GromovCompactness.RiemannDomain E_dom H_dom I_dom «Σ»] (u : «Σ» → M) (s : Set «Σ»),
  GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I I_dom u s →
    ∀ (ψ : Homeomorph «Σ» «Σ»),
      ContMDiff I_dom I_dom (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ψ) →
        (∀ (z : «Σ») (v : TangentSpace I_dom z),
            Eq
              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv I_dom I_dom (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ψ) z)
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (dom.j z) v))
              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (dom.j (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ψ z))
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv I_dom I_dom (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ψ) z) v))) →
          (∀ (z : «Σ»), Set.instMembership.mem s z → MDifferentiableAt I_dom I u z) →
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I I_dom (Function.comp u (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ψ))
              (Set.preimage (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ψ) s)

doc:
Unconditional resolution of a single defect into a `LocalDefectTree` when `u_seq` admits a
`CalibratedRescaling` at `m_defect` and every globally `J`-holomorphic sphere equals its `north_pole` value (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.resolve_single_defect_tree_of_calibrated_of_all_jhol_eq_north_pole
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 m_defect →
    ∀ (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (base_val : M) (n₀ : Nat),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n₀) Set.univ →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Eq u fun x => u GromovCompactness.north_pole) →
          Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.LocalDefectTree I thresh m_defect base_val)

doc: Denominator product cancellation identity: $D_l(t) \cdot D_{1/l}(t') = 4$.
name: GromovCompactness.dil_denom_mul
type:
∀ (l : Real),
  Ne l 0 →
    ∀ (t : Real),
      Ne (GromovCompactness.D_val l t) 0 →
        Eq
          (instHMul.hMul (GromovCompactness.D_val l t)
            (GromovCompactness.D_val (Real.instInv.inv l)
              (instHDiv.hDiv
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHPow.hPow l 2))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHAdd.hAdd 1 (instHPow.hPow l 2)) t))
                (GromovCompactness.D_val l t))))
          4

doc: Nonnegativity of the Riemannian energy density with respect to any tamed $J$ (Zero-sorry).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.riemannianEnergyDensityWithJ_nonneg
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (ω :
    (x : M) →
      ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x)
        (ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) Real))
  (J : (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x)),

doc:
Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness when `pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ < uth.h`
eventually (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_eventually_lt_h
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Filter.Eventually (fun n => Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) uth.h)
          Filter.atTop →
        Exists fun u_lim =>
          And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
            (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
              (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
              have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
              And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                (And
                  (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                    And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                      (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                  (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                    (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]

  (ω :
    (x : M) →
      ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x)
        (ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) Real))
  (J : (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x))
  (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.boundary_circleIntegral_scaled_holder_est
type:
∀ {r R α M : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          Real.instLE.le 0 M →
            ∀ {f : Complex → Complex},
              ContinuousOn f (Metric.sphere 0 R) →
                (∀ (ζ : Complex),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.sphere 0 R) ζ → Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (f ζ)) M) →
                  ∀ {z w : Complex},
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
                      Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                        Real.instLE.le
                          (Complex.instNorm.norm
                            (instHSub.hSub
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (Complex.instInv.inv
                                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                                (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) (f ζ))
                                  0 R))
                              (instHMul.hMul
                                (Complex.instInv.inv
                                  (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                                (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ w)) (f ζ))
                                  0 R))))
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHMul.hMul
                              (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul R (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))
                                (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 2))
                              M)
                            (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))

doc:
Closure of the Cauchy-Riemann equation under $C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}$ convergence:
If $u_n \to u$ in $C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}(\Omega)$ and each $u_n$ is $J$-holomorphic on $\Omega$,
then the limit map $u$ is $J$-holomorphic on $\Omega$.

              (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)

                    (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

type:

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) thresh.ε_sph) →
      ∀ (η : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
          Exists fun R₀ =>
            And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
              (∀ (R : Real),
                GE.ge R R₀ →
                  Exists fun δ₀ =>
                    And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                      (∀ (δ : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                          Exists fun N =>
                            ∀ (n : Nat),

                                And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                  (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                    Set.instMembership.mem
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                      Set.instMembership.mem
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) w →
                                        Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.polar_pompeiu_radial_slice_bound

  Real.instLE.le 0 R →
    ∀ (θ : Real),
      (∀ (ρ : Real),
          Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 R) ρ →

                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f

                    (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))))
              M) →
        Real.instLE.le
          (Complex.instNorm.norm
            (intervalIntegral
              (fun ρ =>
                instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ)
                  (instHDiv.hDiv
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f
                      (instHAdd.hAdd z
                        (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHAdd.hAdd z
                        (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))

doc:
Master Stabilization Theorem on discrete targets `[DiscreteTopology M]` when each `u_seq n`
is `J`-holomorphic on `CP1` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_jhol_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Exists fun u_lim =>
        And
          (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
            (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
          (Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun frames =>
              And
                (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                  GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                    (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                    (u_lim.map v)
                    (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                      (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                (And
                  (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instLE.le K
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                      IsCompact K →
                        TendstoUniformlyOn
                          (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                          (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                  (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                    (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.SecondHomology.mk.injEq
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners Real E H} {M : Type u_4} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (H₂ : Type) [addCommGroup : AddCommGroup H₂]
  (cycleClass : (GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) → H₂)
  (homotopy_invariant :
    ∀ (u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Extensions.ContinuousHomotopic u₁ u₂ → Eq (cycleClass u₁) (cycleClass u₂))
  (omegaPairing : AddMonoidHom H₂ Real)
  (omegaPairing_eq_area :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      Eq (AddMonoidHom.instFunLike.coe omegaPairing (cycleClass u))
        (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u Set.univ))
  (cycleClass_neck_degeneration :
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I)
      (wit : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
        Filter.Eventually
          (fun n => Eq (cycleClass (u_seq (wit.σ.val n))) (Finset.univ.sum fun v => cycleClass (u_lim.map v)))
          Filter.atTop)
  (H₂_1 : Type) (addCommGroup_1 : AddCommGroup H₂_1) (cycleClass_1 : (GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) → H₂_1)
  (homotopy_invariant_1 :
    ∀ (u₁ u₂ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.Extensions.ContinuousHomotopic u₁ u₂ → Eq (cycleClass_1 u₁) (cycleClass_1 u₂))
  (omegaPairing_1 : AddMonoidHom H₂_1 Real)
  (omegaPairing_eq_area_1 :
    ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      Eq (AddMonoidHom.instFunLike.coe omegaPairing_1 (cycleClass_1 u))
        (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I u Set.univ))
  (cycleClass_neck_degeneration_1 :
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I)
      (wit : GromovCompactness.CompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
        Filter.Eventually
          (fun n => Eq (cycleClass_1 (u_seq (wit.σ.val n))) (Finset.univ.sum fun v => cycleClass_1 (u_lim.map v)))
          Filter.atTop),
  Eq
    (Eq
      { H₂ := H₂, addCommGroup := addCommGroup, cycleClass := cycleClass, homotopy_invariant := homotopy_invariant,
        omegaPairing := omegaPairing, omegaPairing_eq_area := omegaPairing_eq_area,
        cycleClass_neck_degeneration := cycleClass_neck_degeneration }
      { H₂ := H₂_1, addCommGroup := addCommGroup_1, cycleClass := cycleClass_1,
        homotopy_invariant := homotopy_invariant_1, omegaPairing := omegaPairing_1,
        omegaPairing_eq_area := omegaPairing_eq_area_1,
        cycleClass_neck_degeneration := cycleClass_neck_degeneration_1 })
    (And (Eq H₂ H₂_1)
      (And (HEq addCommGroup addCommGroup_1) (And (HEq cycleClass cycleClass_1) (HEq omegaPairing omegaPairing_1))))

doc: Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness on `[DiscreteTopology M]` targets (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_discrete
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      Exists fun u_lim =>
        And (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
          (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
            (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
            have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
            And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
              (And
                (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                  And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                    (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                  (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc:
Unconditional `neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound` when the sequence is eventually `J`-holomorphic with
`totalEnergy I (u_seq n) ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound_of_eventually_nonpos_energy
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (N₀ : Nat),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) 0) →
      ∀ (η : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
          Exists fun R₀ =>
            And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
              (∀ (R : Real),
                GE.ge R R₀ →
                  Exists fun δ₀ =>
                    And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                      (∀ (δ : Real),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                          Exists fun N =>
                            ∀ (n : Nat),
                              GE.ge n N →
                                And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                                  (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                    Set.instMembership.mem
                                        (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                      Set.instMembership.mem
                                          (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) w →
                                        Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc: Master Stabilization Theorem when `∀ n, totalEnergy I (u_seq n) ≤ B` and `B ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.stabilize_prestable_tree_of_nonpos_B
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n)) B) →
        Real.instLE.le B 0 →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
              (Exists fun σ =>
                Exists fun frames =>
                  And
                    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (u_lim.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instLE.le K
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                          IsCompact K →
                            TendstoUniformlyOn
                              (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                              (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

doc:
Target Monotonicity Formula from boundary-hit energy lower bound (`0 sorryAx` conditional reduction).
Combines `exists_boundary_hit` (via connectedness of `CP1`) with the local boundary-hit monotonicity bound.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.target_monotonicity_of_boundary_hit_energy
type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace M] {E : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : NormedSpace Real E]
  {H : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (x : M) (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLE.le r 1 →
      Set.instMembership.mem (Set.range u) x →
        GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
          Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
            (Exists fun z => Not (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball x r) (u z))) →
              (∀ (z_hit : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (frontier (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r))) z_hit →
                    Eq (inst.dist (u z_hit) x) r →
                      Or
                        (Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow r 2)
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r))))
                        (Exists fun s =>
                          And (Set.instLE.le s (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))
                            (And
                              (Ne
                                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u)
                                  (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))
                                ENNReal.instTop.top)
                              (Real.instLE.le (instHPow.hPow r 2) (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u s))))) →
                Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul 1 (instHPow.hPow r 2))
                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (Set.preimage u (Metric.ball x r)))

type:
∀ {E_sub E_tot B C₀ r r₁ r₂ R a_decay η : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 C₀ →
    Real.instLE.le 0 E_tot →
      Real.instLE.le E_tot B →
        Real.instLE.le E_sub
            (instHMul.hMul
              (instHMul.hMul C₀
                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                  (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
              E_tot) →

doc:
Companion Pointwise Distance Oscillation Bound on Neck Annuli (Contract B03, `0 sorryAx` conditional reduction).
The pointwise distance between any two points on the neck annulus vanishes asymptotically.
This is proved as a direct corollary of the diameter bound in `neck_vanishing_quantified`.
name: GromovCompactness.Bubbling.neck_pointwise_oscillation_bound
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : Real)
  (res : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.CalibratedRescaling I u_seq thresh m_defect) (η : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 η →
    (Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                              (And
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq n)
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ))
                                  η)
                                (Real.instLT.lt
                                  (Metric.diam
                                    (Set.image (u_seq n)
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)))
                                  η))))) →
      Exists fun R₀ =>
        And (GT.gt R₀ 1)
          (∀ (R : Real),
            GE.ge R R₀ →
              Exists fun δ₀ =>
                And (GT.gt δ₀ 0)
                  (∀ (δ : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioo 0 δ₀) δ →
                      Exists fun N =>
                        ∀ (n : Nat),
                          GE.ge n N →
                            And (Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ)
                              (∀ (z w : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                                Set.instMembership.mem
                                    (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) z →
                                  Set.instMembership.mem
                                      (GromovCompactness.annulus_at (res.a n) (instHMul.hMul R (res.«λ» n)) δ) w →
                                    Real.instLT.lt (inst_3.dist (u_seq n z) (u_seq n w)) η)))

doc:
Zero-sorry specialization of `scalar_mean_value_inequality` when `e` satisfies the local
Laplacian lower bound `-4 * (b + c + 1) * (e z₀)^2 ≤ laplacian2D e w` on concentric interior disks (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_laplacian_lb
type:
∀ (b : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (c : optParam Real 0),
      autoParam (Real.instLE.le 0 c) GromovCompactness.Analysis.scalar_mean_value_inequality_of_laplacian_lb._auto_1 →
        ∀ (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
              (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
                ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
                  ContDiffOn Real 2 e (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                    (∀ (z : Complex),
                        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                          Real.instLE.le
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b) (instHPow.hPow (e z) 2))
                              (instHMul.hMul c (e z)))
                            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e z)) →
                      (∀ (z₀ : Complex),
                          Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀) →
                            ∀ (ρ t : Real),
                              Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                                Set.instLE.le (Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ) (Metric.ball 0 r) →
                                  ∀ (w : Complex),
                                    Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall z₀ t) w →
                                      Real.instLE.le
                                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (-4) (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))
                                          (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                                        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w)) →
                        Real.instLT.lt
                            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r))
                              fun w => e w)
                            (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 2))) →
                          ∀ (z : Complex),
                            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                              Real.instLE.le (e z)
                                (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 32 Real.pi) (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                                  (MeasureTheory.integral
                                    (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w))

type:

doc:
Conditional reduction theorem: Given the geometric modules A03, A07, and A10,
the universal positive bubbling threshold exists constructively.
Note (Conditional Reduction per COMPLETION_PLAN.md §0 & §2 P0-9):
Takes open geometric contract hypotheses and does not count as closing Contract B01 unconditionally.
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.exists_target_thresholds_of_modules
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (ε_reg C_reg : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_reg →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 C_reg →
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (a : Complex) (r : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
            Set.instLE.le (Metric.ball a r) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) →
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) ε_reg →
                  ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (GromovCompactness.disk_at a (instHDiv.hDiv r 2)) z →
                      Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u z)
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul C_reg (instHPow.hPow r (-2)))
                          (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))) →
        ∀ (ε_sph : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph →
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                    Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)) →
              ∀ (C_neck a_decay ε_neck : Real),
                Real.instLT.lt 0 C_neck →
                  Real.instLT.lt 0 a_decay →
                    Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_neck →
                      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (center : Complex) (r R : Real),
                          Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                            Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul 2 r) R →
                              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                                Real.instLT.lt
                                    (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R))
                                    ε_neck →
                                  ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Real),
                                    Real.instLT.lt r r₁ →
                                      Real.instLT.lt r₁ r₂ →
                                        Real.instLT.lt r₂ R →
                                          Real.instLE.le
                                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                              (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r₁ r₂))
                                            (instHMul.hMul
                                              (instHMul.hMul C_neck
                                                (instHAdd.hAdd (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r r₁) a_decay)
                                                  (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv r₂ R) a_decay)))
                                              (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I u
                                                (GromovCompactness.annulus_at center r R)))) →
                        Nonempty (GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)

type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        ∀ (w : Complex),
          Real.instLE.le 0
            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
              (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
              w)) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                ∀ (w : Complex),
                  Real.instLE.le
                    (instHSub.hSub
                      (instHMul.hMul (Real.instNeg.neg b)
                        (instHPow.hPow
                          (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                          2))
                      (instHMul.hMul c
                        (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D
                      (fun z =>
                        GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
                      w)))

doc: Unconditional Varying-`J` Gromov Compactness when `B ≤ 0` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.gromov_compactness_varying_J_of_nonpos_B
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_seq n z) c)) →
    (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
      (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.pullbackOmegaMeasure I (u_seq n) Set.univ) B) →
        Real.instLE.le B 0 →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_lim.map v) Set.univ)
              (And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
                (have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
                have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
                And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast uth.h) B)
                  (And
                    (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
                      And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
                        (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
                    (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast
                      (Int.instMax.max 1 (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B uth.h))) 2))))))

doc: Smoothness of the chart energy density for any constant map `fun _ => x₀` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Analysis.contDiff_energy_density_chart_const
type:

doc:
Single-component reduction for `extract_varying_J_stable_limit` when `u_seq` converges in
$C^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{CP}^1)$ to a non-constant limit map `u₀`: $J_\infty$-holomorphicity
of `u₀` follows automatically from `jholomorphic_limit_of_varying_J` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.extract_varying_J_stable_limit_of_smooth_conv
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (varying_J : GromovCompactness.Extensions.VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I)
  (uth : GromovCompactness.Extensions.UniformTargetThresholds I varying_J)
  (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.Extensions.JHolomorphicWithJ I (varying_J.J_seq n) (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (u₀ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I u_seq u₀ Set.univ →
        Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u₀ z) c) →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u₀) B →
            Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u₀) →
              Exists fun u_lim =>
                And (Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B)
                  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                    GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v →
                      Real.instLE.le uth.h (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))

doc:
On a subsingleton target `M`, if `MoebiusFrame` acts transitively on the marked point triples of
`MarkedStableMap I 3`, then `ModuliSpace I 3 B` is compact Hausdorff (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Extensions.moduli_space_compact_hausdorff_three_of_subsingleton_of_trans
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [Subsingleton M] (B : Real),

      (T2Space (GromovCompactness.Extensions.ModuliSpace I 3 B))

doc: `canonicalDefectMass` equals `(μ {p}).toReal` on `S` (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Compactness.canonicalDefectMass_of_mem
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]

  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),

doc:
Any map whose Riemannian energy density is bounded below by a positive constant
on an open chart ball has strictly positive total energy.
name: GromovCompactness.totalEnergy_pos_of_exists_ball
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (w₀ : Complex) (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    ∀ (c : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
        (∀ (w : Complex),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball w₀ r) w →
              Real.instLE.le c
                (GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))) →
          ENNReal.instPartialOrder.lt
              (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.energyMeasureExtended I u) Set.univ)
              ENNReal.instTop.top →
            Real.instLT.lt 0 (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u)

doc:
Unconditional `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` when every globally `J`-holomorphic
sphere has a constant value (`0 sorryAx`).
name: GromovCompactness.Assembly.extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_all_jhol_exists_const
type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
      (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
      (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
      (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
          GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
            Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
        Exists fun σ =>
          Exists fun res =>
            And
              (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                  (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                      Eq (frames w n)
                        ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                          (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                    ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (P.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
              (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

doc: Translation invariance of Lebesgue integrals over Euclidean metric balls on ℂ.
